chronology.rule: Base game through Maliketh, entire Shadow of the Erdtree, then base-game endgame.

steps.instruction: Pick any origin you want. If unsure, I recommend the Vagabond or Samurai, as they have good starting stats for most builds.

The Lands Between Rune (unique) and Fanged Imp Ashes (used for a puzzle) are the most valuable keepsakes. For beginners, the Golden Seed can help in the first two sections. Avoid the Stonesword Keys; the walkthrough is routed so that you'll never need to buy any.
steps.linkedRaw: Lands Between Rune; Fanged Imp Ashes; Golden Seed; Stonesword Keys

steps.instruction: Begin your playthrough and watch the intro cutscene.

If playing online, you can add up to five group passwords (case sensitive). Summon signs, messages, and bloodstains from your groups are highlighted, and player phantoms appear golden instead of white. Each time someone in your group defeats a Shardbearer or becomes Elden Lord, you gain a 5% stacking rune buff. ERSHEET is this website's group password and these are the ones I use.
steps.linkedRaw: these are the ones I use

links.label: these are the ones I use

steps.instruction: The Ring gesture is automatically obtained if you preordered the game.
Similarly, the Ring of Miquella gesture is obtained if you preordered the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC.
Pick up Tarnished's Wizened Finger from the deceased maiden.
Exit the chapel and die to the Grafted Scion.
After respawning in a cave, drop down the hole and grab the Cave of Knowledge grace.
There are no items in the cave, so once you're through, kill Soldier of Godrick for 400 runes.
Pick up the Strength! gesture before you drop down.
Activate the Stranded Graveyard grace just past the door.
Pick up Finger Severer and Tarnished's Furled Finger from the corpse in the corner.
Take the lift up and enter Limgrave!
Step outside and activate The First Step grace.
Exhaust Varre's dialogue in front of the grace.
Pick up the Small Golden Effigy on the martyr effigy just east below the grace.
Run for the church past the Tree Sentinel and pick up the Golden Rune [2] in front of the entrance.
Activate the Church of Elleh grace and pick up the Smithing Stone [1] on the anvil.
Talk to Kale and buy the Crafting Kit for 300 runes to unlock Item Crafting. Optionally, talk to him about himself.
Head toward the ruin east of the church to pick up a Golden Rune [1] near three gibbets.
Explore the woods on the opposite side of the ruin to find Kukri x4 in front of a broken-down wagon.
Follow the dirt path through the woods to a ruins site, then head toward the large gate on the left to discover the Gatefront grace.
Rest at the Gatefront grace to meet Melina. Accept her request to receive the Spectral Steed Whistle (your mount) and the ability to level up.
Fast travel to the Church of Elleh to meet Ranni, presenting herself as Renna. Tell her you can call the spectral steed to receive Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ranni; Spirit Calling Bell; Lone Wolf Ashes

steps.instruction: Note: If missed, they can be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.
Exhaust Melina's dialogue while resting at the Church of Elleh grace.
Return to Gatefront and talk to Melina at the grace to learn about her purpose.
Head through the gate and grab the Lump of Flesh on the road and the Golden Rune [1] behind some spiked barricades on the right.
Continue up the road until you see a Golden Seed on the right.
On the grassy hillside east-northeast of the tree, you'll find some chairs with Smithing Stone [1] x3.
Continue toward the gibbets near the cliff east-southeast from the chairs. Behind the second last gibbet, you'll find Smoldering Butterfly x5.
North of the gibbets lies a cemetery with 4x Golden Rune [1], 2x Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [3], and a Golden Rune [5].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: From the cemetery, head west to find a shack by the road. Grab the Stormhill Shack grace, then pick up the Stonesword Key on the elevated platform.
Talk to Roderika in the shack to learn the Sitting Sideways gesture, then exhaust her dialogue for the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.
steps.linkedRaw: Roderika; Sitting Sideways; Spirit Jellyfish Ashes

steps.instruction: Head up the slope to the left of a half-buried ruin near the shack to find Strength-knot Crystal Tear guarded by a Troll.
Return to the grace and follow the dirt path to the right of the ruin to a corpse with Fire Arrow x5.
Continue into the woods and activate the Warmaster's Shack grace on the right.
Talk to Bernahl in the shack to unlock his inventory; it doesn't matter what you answer. Optionally, select "Talk".
Behind the shack is a hillside with five Trolls. Pick up Beast Liver in front of the Troll near a ruin.
Bait the troll into attacking the statue in the middle to obtain Smithing Stone [1] x5, and a Smithing Stone [2].
Continue east from the statue and jump down the spiritspring below the cliff. Turn north at the bottom to find a Smithing Stone [1] on a ledge.
Return to Warmaster's Shack and ride northeast through the woods to a camp with Exalted Flesh and a chest containing the Beast Crest Heater Shield.
steps.linkedRaw: Exalted Flesh; Beast Crest Heater Shield

steps.instruction: Exit the camp and head up the right ledge to find Alexander. Select "Help him out", then free him for the Triumphant Delight gesture. Talk to him afterward to receive an Exalted Flesh.
Return to the path below the ledge and continue downhill to discover the Saintsbridge grace.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x2 in front of a broken statue on the bridge.
On the right side past the bridge, you'll find the Nomadic Merchant (North Limgrave).
Head south from the merchant to find a Golden Rune [1] beneath some gibbets near the cliff.
Return to the merchant and continue along the path to encounter D, Hunter of the Dead on the left side.
Continue down the path to discover the Summonwater Village Outskirts grace on the right side.
Unlock the imp seal near some turtles in the right side of the village. Loot the chest in the cellar to obtain the Green Turtle Talisman.
Head toward the cliff south of the seal. Drop down near the scarab to reach a cemetery with 5x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [5].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Follow the northeast wall to a spiritspring and use it while facing northeast to find a tunnel entrance. Go inside and grab the Rear Gael Tunnel Entrance grace.
Talk to Alexander in the tunnel, then pick up the Smithing Stone [4] on the wall behind him.
Exit the tunnel and follow the downhill path to a broken-down wagon. Pick up the Neutralizing Boluses next to it.
Continue downhill and kill the scarab near a spiritspring to obtain Ash of War: Sacred Blade.
Enter the church at the bottom and activate the Third Church of Marika grace.
Pick up the Crimson Crystal Tear and Flask of Wondrous Physick from the stone basin, then the Sacred Tear in front of the statue.
steps.linkedRaw: Crimson Crystal Tear; Flask of Wondrous Physick; Sacred Tear

steps.instruction: Talk to Melina at the grace and add some Crystal Tears to your Physick flask.
Follow the river outside the church to a Smithing Stone [2] in the middle of a fight between wolves and a Runebear.
Use the sending gate hidden in a bush at the opposite end of the river. After you arrive, open the door and grab the Bestial Sanctum grace, but don't rest at it.
Talk to Gurranq. He doesn't have any dialogue yet, but interacting with him unlocks D, Hunter of the Dead's inventory early.
Rest at the Bestial Sanctum grace and accept Melina's invitation to Roundtable Hold.
Now that you've arrived at the main hub, you can talk to the NPCs that are here:
Meet Gideon Ofnir and exhaust his dialogue.
Talk to Corhyn and answer "I see it" to learn the Prayer gesture.
Talk to D, Hunter of the Dead. Optionally, talk to him about himself if you interacted with Gurranq earlier.
Talk to Diallos.
Talk to Hewg. Ask him about the chains on his legs, then ask if he's a prisoner.
Talk to Fia and let her hold you twice. During the second embrace, choose to talk in secret.

Note: Each time you let her hold you, you'll receive a Baldachin's Blessing. While carrying this item, your maximum HP is reduced by 5%, so make sure to use it after every interaction with her to remove its debuff.
Reload the area, then interact with Ensha outside Gideon's study to learn the What Do You Want? gesture.
Exhaust Gideon Ofnir's dialogue in his study.
Find the Twin Maiden Husks and buy any items you need from them.
Return to Bestial Sanctum and pass time until morning at the grace. Follow the downhill path past the Black Blade Kindred and pick up the Golden Seed along the path.
Head east from the golden tree to find a stone astrolabe with Starlight Shards on your right side, near the cliff edge.
Drop down the cliff south of the astrolabe, then head down the slope near the cliff. Across the bridge at the bottom, you'll find the Lenne's Rise grace.
Use the spiritspring next to the tower while facing west to reach a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [6], and a Golden Rune [8].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [6]; Golden Rune [8]

steps.instruction: Use the spiritspring while facing east to enter the tower from its balcony. Loot the chest at the top level to obtain a Memory Stone.
You can do the Lenne's Rise rune farm if you need some quick runes for an item or upgrade.
Travel to the Third Church of Marika and follow the path past the Troll to an arched ruin. Under it sits a wagon with Magic Grease.
Talk to Kenneth Haight on top of the arched ruin.
On the cliff accessible from the top of the ruin lies a cemetery with 3x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [4], Golden Rune [6], and Fevor's Cookbook [1].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [6]; Fevor's Cookbook [1]

steps.instruction: Return to the church and head along the beach until you reach a Giant Crab feasting on a corpse with Strip of White Flesh x3.
Climb the rocky ledges at the end of the beach and enter the round building southwest into the woods. Take the lift down and activate the Siofra River Well Depths grace.
Return to the church again (it's faster) and follow the south path into the woods to a stele with Map: Limgrave, East on the left side.
Pick up the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [4] below the Runebear (it only attacks if you get too close).
Next to a wagon farther along the path is a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x3.
Continue west from the wagon to find a Golden Rune [1] at the base of a gibbet guarded by bats.
Up the slope southeast of the gibbet is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Ground Slam.
Pick up Spiked Cracked Tear and Greenspill Crystal Tear from the basin in front of the Minor Erdtree.
steps.linkedRaw: Spiked Cracked Tear; Greenspill Crystal Tear

steps.instruction: Go back down the slope and follow the howling to Mistwood Ruins:
Pick up the Golden Rune [2] in a corner of the ruins.
In the tower in the middle sits a chest with a Smithing Stone [2].
Go down the cellar by the sleeping Runebear for a chest containing the Axe Talisman.
Return to the path and follow it to a glowing message, then head northeast into the woods to find the Nomadic Merchant (East Limgrave).
Return to the path again and follow it until you see the Fort Haight West grace.
Head up the slope to the fort and pick up the Golden Seed near the entrance.
On the small beach southwest of the fort, you'll find a Golden Rune [1].
Continue southwest to a cemetery with 4x Golden Rune [1], 2x Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [3], and a Golden Rune [4].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]

steps.instruction: From the cemetery, head north-northwest until you come to a graveyard. In front of the largest gravestone is a Sacrificial Twig.
Travel to Gatefront and explore the ruins:
Pick up Lordsworn's Greatsword from the chest in the nearby carriage.
In the ruins opposite the carriage sits a corpse with Ruin Fragment x3.
Loot Map: Limgrave, West from the stele in the middle.
In the lower south part of the ruins lies a cellar with Ash of War: Storm Stomp and Whetstone Knife.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Storm Stomp; Whetstone Knife

steps.instruction: Pick up Flail from the chest in the second carriage.
Follow the road through the ruins downhill to discover the Agheel Lake North grace on the left side.
Pass time until morning, then continue along the road to find an Arteria Leaf to the left of a telescope.
Roll into the yellow shrub to reveal Boc. Exhaust his dialogue to receive Mushroom x10.
Continue along the road to find a scarab that drops Ash of War: Determination.
On the right side of the bridge lies a Smithing Stone [1].
Cross the bridge, then follow the cliff edge on the right to a chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
On a ledge overlooking the tip of the lake, past some Giant Crabs, you'll find the Agheel Lake South grace.
A small campsite with Sliver of Meat lies just west of the grace.
From the campsite, head southwest past the clashing enemies and down a rocky slope to find Crab Eggs on the cliff edge.
Go back up the slope, then head right until the area splits in two paths. Follow the downward slope first to a corpse with Ruin Fragment x3.
Head back and follow the upper path to a ledge with the Large Club, surrounded by Demi-Humans.
Use the spiritspring near the cliff while facing southeast to land on a broken pillar. Up the ledge, you'll reach the Bridge of Sacrifice grace.
Loot the Stonesword Key and Smithing Stone [1] x3 on the bridge.
Head back across to find Irina next to the road. Exhaust her dialogue, then agree to deliver her letter to receive Irina's Letter.
Continue down the road and pick up the Strip of White Flesh guarded by three dogs and a Troll.
Loot the Morning Star in the carriage, then the Golden Rune [2] and Smithing Stone [2] from the nearby corpses.
steps.linkedRaw: Morning Star; Golden Rune [2]; Smithing Stone [2]

steps.instruction: Kill the scarab on the road to obtain Ash of War: Mighty Shot.
When the road opens into a field, you'll discover the Castle Morne Rampart grace on the left side.
The Nomadic Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) sits just near the grace.
Pass time until morning at the grace, then follow the road through the hole in the rampart to a stele with Map: Weeping Peninsula.
Pick up Golden Seed from a ledge on the right side, just past the map stele.
Kill the Archer Golem (doesn't respawn). Then head toward the southeast beach to find Somber Smithing Stone [2] and Arteria Leaf near some hostile jellyfish.
Northeast of the beach is a poison swamp. Climb the tallest boulder in the swamp for a Golden Rune [4].
In the woods past the swamp, you'll see a teleporting scarab. Kill it with a Kukri to obtain Poison Mist.
At the top of the slope past the woods is a Smithing Stone [1] guarded by a Scaly Misbegotten.
Return to Castle Morne Rampart and follow the slope west of the grace to a cottage with Yellow Ember in front.
Continue northwest from the cottage and descend the gravestones in the cliff. Kill the scarab at the bottom to obtain Lightning Strike.
Return to the cottage and follow the dirt path to a village. Turn left before entering to find a campfire by the cliff and a Golden Rune [2].
Continue along the cliff edge to discover the Ailing Village Outskirts grace up on a ledge.
Pick up Flame Crest Wooden Shield from an empty cottage in the village.
Head into the church near the village. Loot The Flame of Frenzy and Sacred Tear, but be wary of the rats.
steps.linkedRaw: The Flame of Frenzy; Sacred Tear

steps.instruction: Return to Castle Morne Rampart and head up the north-northwest slope. In front of a gibbet on the cliff, you'll find Rainbow Stone x5.
Grab the South of the Lookout Tower grace on the ledge behind the pond with dogs around it.
Follow the rocky path west and across a bridge until you reach the church at the top. Grab the Church of Pilgrimage grace and Sacred Tear inside.
Talk to Melina at the Church of Pilgrimage grace.
Pick up Gilded Iron Shield and Blood Grease x2 from the small graveyard outside the church.
steps.linkedRaw: Gilded Iron Shield; Blood Grease x2

steps.instruction: Head down the slope toward the mausoleum, keeping along the cliff wall on the left until you reach the Tombsward grace on a ledge.
Enter the church at the top of the slope near the mausoleum to grab the Fourth Church of Marika grace and Sacred Tear inside.
steps.linkedRaw: Fourth Church of Marika; Sacred Tear

steps.instruction: Go back down the slope, then head southwest toward a shack near the beach to grab the Isolated Merchant's Shack grace.
Buy a Lantern from the Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) if you can spare the runes. If not, you can buy it later.
On the beach, you can find a Golden Rune [5], and a Golden Rune [1] behind a fallen tree.
Continue along the beach for a Golden Rune [2] surrounded by Land Octopuses.
Travel to the Church of Elleh and talk to Kale about the howling in Mistwood to learn the Finger Snap gesture.
Locate Blaidd at the top of Mistwood Ruins. Use the Finger Snap gesture below him, then talk to him after he jumps down.
Return to Kale and talk to him about Blaidd.
Travel to Agheel Lake South and pick up the Golden Rune [2] in front of a gibbet just south of the grace.
Enter the evergaol at the top of the slope, then kill Bloodhound Knight Darriwil for Bloodhound's Fang and 1,900 runes.
Blaidd's summon sign can be found in the evergaol if you spoke to him in Mistwood Ruins. (Summoning NPCs is generally not needed to progress questlines and will result in 25% fewer runes.)
After the fight, talk to Blaidd to receive a Somber Smithing Stone [2], then speak with him again to unlock a talisman for sale later.
From Stormhill Shack, follow the uphill road to a scarab and kill it for Ash of War: Wild Strikes.
On a ledge under the leftmost arch of the massive bridge, you'll find a Lump of Flesh.
Past the massive bridge is a broken span that once connected to Liurnia. At the end of it sits a corpse with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7].
Drop down to the area below the span and kill the scarab near the right edge to obtain Ash of War: Storm Wall.
Continue up the nearby slope until you reach the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace.
Head inside the church to the southwest to pick up a Sacred Tear.
Talk to Thops and spare him 10 runes. Optionally, select "Talk", then speak to him about the academy glintstone key.
Outside the church is a ravine path. At the end of the upper left side of the ravine, you'll find Warming Stone x3.
In front of a gravestone on the opposite hill across the ravine, you'll pick up the Academy Scroll.
Head down the ravine path to a camp with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1] and Smoldering Butterfly x6 (in a tent).
steps.linkedRaw: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]; Smoldering Butterfly x6

steps.instruction: Continue downhill and activate the Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
Climb the slanted rock next to the grace and jump onto the gravestones in the cliff face to reach a Sacrificial Twig.
Buy a Lantern from the Nomadic Merchant (South Liurnia) if you didn't get it earlier.
Follow the watery path lined with broken arcades and fences until you reach a stele with Map: Liurnia, East.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, you'll find the Idus Sword next to a tree west-southwest of the stele.
Continue along the watery path until you notice the Laskyar Ruins grace on your right side.
Pick up Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2] from the corpse near the grace.
Grab the Smithing Stone [3] beside the stairs to the building with spires northwest of the grace, then use the sending gate inside.
After arriving, head up to grab the South Raya Lucaria Gate grace and Meeting Place Map.
steps.linkedRaw: South Raya Lucaria Gate; Meeting Place Map

steps.instruction: Head down the bridge and pick up the Smithing Stone [3] to the left of the enemies past the spiked barricades.
Continue down the nearby stairs, then head southeast at the bottom to find a Golden Seed.
From the golden tree, head southeast until the town is on your left, then continue along the outskirts to find the Academy Gate Town grace.
Pick up Map: Liurnia, North from the stele near the grace.
West of the grace is a larger tree. From that tree, go north to find Diallos on the northern outskirts and talk to him.
On a church roof just northwest of Diallos is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Use the sending gate in the isolated building north-northwest of the scarab. After arriving, pick up Map: Liurnia, West from the stele.
Just southwest of the map stele lies the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
Follow the dirt path north-northeast through Kingsrealm Ruins and hit the illusory wall at the end to discover the Road to the Manor grace behind it.
Exhaust Iji's dialogue, then select "Please take care" and "Talk".

If you exhausted Blaidd's dialogue after killing Darriwil, tell him that Blaidd sent you to unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest for purchase. Otherwise, it'll be available after entering Ranni's service.
Note: Don't buy any Somberstones from him; you'll have one of each by the end of this section.
Return to the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and head east-southeast across the lake. A chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [3] sits past the leftmost bridge pillar.
Head south from the chair until you reach the Gate Town North grace on the remains of some roofs.
Continue east-southeast toward a round building, then once you reach it, go east into the woods to find a building with Smithing Stone [3] x3 inside.
On the shore east of the building, you'll discover the Eastern Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
From the grace, head south-southwest to find Smithing Stone [3] x3 behind the magic Miranda Blossom on your right.
Return to the grace and follow the dirt path to a fork. Take the right path downhill to grab the Study Hall Entrance grace inside a building.
Below the tip of a slanted rock outside the building is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Return to the fork and follow the other path uphill until you reach the church at the top. Activate the Church of Vows grace in front of it.
Talk to Miriel in the church. Optionally, exhaust his dialogue about Radagon, then about Rennala.

Note: Give him the Academy Scroll and any future scrolls or prayerbooks to unlock their spells for purchase. Scrolls can also be given to Sellen or Seluvis (and prayerbooks to Corhyn or Miriel), but Miriel never moves and is the only NPC to accept both types.
Pick up the Gold Sewing Needle and Golden Tailoring Tools from the chest in the church.
steps.linkedRaw: Gold Sewing Needle; Golden Tailoring Tools

steps.instruction: At the edge of the cliff behind the church sits a corpse with Stormhawk Feather x5.
Pick up the Grave Violet in front of a dead tree at the top of the hillside.
Talk to Varre at The First Step, answer "I'll fly straight and true!", then exhaust his dialogue.
Head around the building south of Varre and drop down next to the broken pillar to find Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x2 on a ledge below the cliff.
Drop down and head toward the gibbets to find a Smithing Stone [1] next to a bottomless pit.
Just east-northeast of the pit lies the Dragon-Burnt Ruins:
Use Torrent to get inside the rightmost ruin and open the chest in the cellar to obtain the Twinblade.
In a corner just east past the rightmost ruin lies a corpse with Crab Eggs.
Go inside the ruined tower to find a Stonesword Key guarded by a rat.
Pick up the Golden Rune [2] next to the tower.
Head down the cellar full of rats and open the trap chest to be transported to Sellia Crystal Tunnel.
After arriving in Sellia, open the chest in front of you for Gravity Stone Fan x6 and Gravity Stone Chunk x3.
steps.linkedRaw: Gravity Stone Fan x6; Gravity Stone Chunk x3

steps.instruction: Crouch down and exit the hut toward the right side. Continue downward while crouched to reach the Sellia Crystal Tunnel grace.
Pick up Rot Grease from the corner of the room.
Exit the tunnel and head south-southwest toward the glowing footprints. Kill the invisible scarab to obtain Poison Armament.

Note: An easy way to deal with invisible scarabs is to mount up on Torrent and holding R2 or Shift + Left Click to charge a Heavy Attack along its path. When timed right, it should die running into your weapon.
Pick up Rune Arc from the small island with a thin tree in the rot swamp.
Continue southwest from the island to discover the Inner Aeonia grace.
Head toward the large scarab northwest of the grace, then go through the ravine to find a Somber Smithing Stone [5] in front of some glintstone crystals.
Exit the ravine, then follow the west wall to the corner of the swamp. On a root in the corner is a corpse with Sacramental Bud.
Just south-southeast of the corner lies the Street of Sages Ruins:
Head down the cellar in the ruin closest to the corner for a chest with Rock Sling.
Loot the Perfumer Traveler's Set and Perfume Bottle from the ruin in the middle.
In the ruined tower, you'll find the Meteorite Staff and a Golden Rune [4].
Head around the wall southeast of the ruined tower to discover the Aeonia Swamp Shore grace on a ledge near the shore.
Ride southeast from the grace to find a teleporting scarab on a small island in the rot. Kill it to obtain Ash of War: Poisonous Mist.
Southwest of the island, in the distance, is a small mushroom-covered mountain. Head around it to find a Golden Rune [3] guarded by putrid Miranda Sprouts.
Climb the mushroom-covered mountain to find a Golden Rune [4] at the top, overlooking the swamp.
East-southeast below the mountain lies a small campsite. Destroy the wagon there to find Crab Eggs x4 underneath.
Continue east from the campsite to discover the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace behind a mushroom-covered branch.
Pass time until morning, then head southwest to find the Nomadic Merchant (South Caelid) by the road.
Pick up Map: Caelid from the stele next to the road.
Follow the southeast path near the stele to a Golden Seed.
Return to the grace and head northwest to find Smithing Stone [4] x3, Sacramental Bud x2, and a Rune Arc on some chairs at the shore.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [4] x3; Sacramental Bud x2; Rune Arc

steps.instruction: Ride north-northeast from the chairs to pick up Aeonian Butterfly and Somber Smithing Stone [4] from the corpses between two trees in the swamp.
Continue up the nearby slope and kill the exploding scarab for Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light

links.label: Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light

steps.instruction: Travel to Roundtable Hold and talk to Roderika in front of the fireplace.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika.
Return to Roderika and tell her what the blacksmith said.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika, then ask if he'll watch over her; your answer doesn't matter.
Reload the area to find them in the same room. Roderika will now offer to upgrade your spirit ashes.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika now that she's become a spirit tuner.
Talk to Diallos, who is now back at Roundtable Hold.

Note: At this point, you should have eight flasks upgraded to +5 and enough materials to upgrade any Somber weapon to +5. For beginners, I'd go with the Bloodhound's Fang (requires 18 Strength and 17 Dexterity) until you find a weapon you like.
Here are some steps I didn't include. I wouldn't bother with them unless you know what you're doing:
Get the Gold Scarab for 20% more runes from enemies. You'll need to kill the duo boss in Abandoned Cave in Caelid to obtain it.
Cheese the Night's Cavalry on the bridge near Lenne's Rise to ride off the cliff.
Grab the Dectus Medallion (Right) and Radagon's Soreseal from Fort Faroth.
Kill Elder Dragon Greyoll with a bleed weapon and use a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot (and Gold Scarab) before she dies.

Obtain the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] in Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel and Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] in Sealed Tunnel (note that going for the latter will trigger the festival in Caelid, which will progress quite a few questlines).
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]; Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]

steps.instruction: With Roderika now at Roundtable Hold, pick up the Golden Seed she left at Stormhill Shack.
Travel to Fort Haight West and make your way into Fort Haight:
Pick up Bloodrose x3 from the corpse on the ground.
In the room up the first set of stairs is the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6].
Kill the Godrick Knight on the upper level to receive Ash of War: Bloody Slash, then pick up the Bloodrose x5 behind him.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Bloody Slash; Bloodrose x5

steps.instruction: Head down the wooden staircase to the right of the ladder to find a Smithing Stone [1].
Climb the ladder to the top for a chest with the Dectus Medallion (Left).
Return to Kenneth Haight on top of the arched ruin to receive the Erdsteel Dagger. Exhaust his dialogue and pledge service to him.
Re-enter the fort and talk to Kenneth Haight where the knight was.
Travel to the Church of Elleh and head north to find the entrance to Groveside Cave:
Activate the Groveside Cave grace inside and equip your lantern.
Below the ledge in the room is a Cracked Pot.
Pick up the Glowstone x3 and Golden Rune [1] in the water.
Kill the Beastman of Farum Azula for Flamedrake Talisman and 1,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Beastman of Farum Azula; Flamedrake Talisman

steps.instruction: Travel to Agheel Lake North and head northeast toward a camp with Kaiden Sellswords. Pick up the Armorer's Cookbook [1] in front of some pots.
Just past the camp you'll see a pack of wolves. Pick up the Golden Rune [2] below the pack leader.
Below the ledge east of the wolves, you'll discover the Murkwater Coast grace.
Drop down northeast of the grace, where the edge of the ruin meets the cliff, and pick up the Poisonbloom x2 on a boulder in the water.
Use the spiritspring while facing southeast to reach a shack. Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] next to it and interact with the painting inside for the "Homing Instinct" Painting.
Grab the Artist's Shack grace just outside the shack.
On the rocky ledge near the grace is an exploding scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Return to the spiritspring, then follow the water northwest to reach Murkwater Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Murkwater Catacombs grace.
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [1] in the first corridor.
In the room straight ahead is a corpse with Root Resin x5 and a lever that, when pulled, unlocks the door to the boss.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [1] on the way to the boss.
Kill the Grave Warden Duelist for Banished Knight Engvall and 1,700 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Warden Duelist; Banished Knight Engvall

steps.instruction: Return to the catacomb entrance and head along the water until you get invaded by Bloody Finger Nerijus. Kill him to obtain the Reduvia.
Head back along the water after killing Nerijus and talk to Yura below a ruin, where the jellyfish were.
Look for a cave opening along the western cliff, where you got invaded, to find Murkwater Cave:
Head inside and grab the Murkwater Cave grace.
Loot Mushroom x5 from the chest straight ahead.
Open the chest in the boss room to obtain Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers.
After opening the chest, you'll be ambushed by Patches. Bring his HP below 50% without killing him and he'll surrender, giving you Golden Rune [1] x2 and the Grovel for Mercy gesture.
steps.linkedRaw: Patches; Golden Rune [1] x2; Grovel for Mercy

steps.instruction: Talk to the now friendly Patches after the fight; your answer doesn't matter.

Remove your weapon and punch him until he becomes hostile. Let him hit you until you're almost dead and he'll give you the Extreme Repentance gesture. Either use it in front of him, or let him kill you.
Reload the area and talk to Patches about the bandits, then about the new chest.
After opening the new chest, turn around and grab the Gold-Tinged Excrement x5, Golden Rune [5], and Throwing Dagger x5 in the pond.
steps.linkedRaw: Gold-Tinged Excrement x5; Golden Rune [5]; Throwing Dagger x5

steps.instruction: Ride west-northwest past the sleeping Runebear to find the Mistwood Outskirts grace near a road.
Rest at the grace, then follow the cliff edge west-southwest of the grace to a ruin. Pick up the Golden Rune [1] hanging from its edge.
Return to Patches to learn the Calm Down! gesture.

Note: I strongly recommend buying Margit's Shackle from Patches. It can reveal illusory walls, trigger fire-breathing pillars, and (in the DLC) unlock sealed spiritsprings and break pots hanging from cliffs, all from a safe distance.
Exit the cave and continue along the water to find a corpse with Fire Grease under a bridge.
Head south-southwest past the bridge for a corpse with Arteria Leaf surrounded by Land Squirts behind a stone coffin.
Kill the scarab southeast of the coffin for Ash of War: Unsheathe, but be wary of the Giant Crabs burrowed in the water.
Pick up Crab Eggs from the nearby corpse surrounded by smaller crabs.
Head toward the ruin west of the crabs and pick up the Slumbering Egg on top of it.
Talk to Yura under the ruin.
Grab the Seaside Ruins grace next to the cliff just west of the ruin.
On top of a rock north-northwest of the grace is a Golden Rune [1] guarded by some bats.
Continue northwest along the ledge, then drop down to see the Incantation Scarab appear in front of some gravestones (painting reward).
Kill Flying Dragon Agheel in the lake for Dragon Heart and 5,000 runes.
If you die, you can return to Yura and exhaust his dialogue. His summon sign will then be available near a flat ruin in the lake.
In the northern corner of the lake lies the entrance to Limgrave Tunnels:
Instead of taking the lift, drop down to the left of it for a Golden Rune [4] in a narrow tunnel.
Drop down all the way and activate the Limgrave Tunnels grace at the bottom.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] on the wall next to the first miner.
On the wall next to the miner down the first set of stairs is another Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] in an alcove on the ground level.
Follow the southwest tunnel to a room with a Smithing Stone [1] and some rats.
Take the other tunnel to a lift and ride it to the bottom. Loot Large Glintstone Scrap x5 inside a hut.
In the area around the hut, you'll find 2x Smithing Stone [1].
Take the lift back up, then drop off while facing southeast to continue. On the wall between the two paths is a Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up Glintstone Scrap x3 from the right path.
Take the other path for a Smithing Stone [1] next to the miner near the lift.
Drop down to the left of the lift for a Golden Rune [1] on a ledge, then drop to the ledge below it for a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Grab a final Smithing Stone [1] from the right wall before the boss.
Kill the Stonedigger Troll for Roar Medallion and 1,800 runes.
Travel to Agheel Lake North and pass time until nightfall. Follow the road southeast and kill the Night's Cavalry on the bridge for Ash of War: Repeating Thrust and 2,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Repeating Thrust

steps.instruction: On top of the cliff east of the bridge, at the base of a gibbet, you'll find a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Stop the caravan traveling the road below, then loot the Greataxe in the back of the carriage.
Continue along the road until it meets a large ruin blocking the path. Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x4 nearby.
On the hill near the blocked road lies Waypoint Ruins:
In a small alley in the back of the ruins is a corpse with Glowstone x2.
Loot the Immunizing Cured Meat and Golden Rune [1] around the Miranda Blossom in the center.
Hanging off the wall above the Miranda Blossom is a corpse with Trina's Lily x4.
Head down the cellar visible from the top of the wall and kill the Mad Pumpkin Head for 1,100 runes.
Grab the Waypoint Ruins Cellar grace and talk to Sellen. Answer "I want to learn sorcery", then "I still want to learn" to receive the Nod In Thought gesture.
steps.linkedRaw: Waypoint Ruins Cellar; Sellen; Nod In Thought

steps.instruction: Kill the lone Noble Sorcerer on the hillside south of Waypoint Ruins, below the ruin, to obtain the Glintstone Staff (first time).
Loot 3x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [3] from the nearby cemetery.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]

steps.instruction: Head toward the camp on the slope just south of the cemetery. In front of a tent on the left side sits a chest containing the Great Epee.
Continue up the slope for a Golden Rune [1], then pick up the Royal House Scroll on top of the ruin next to it.
An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the edge of a small cliff south-southeast of the ruin.
On a lower ledge, west-southwest of the astrolabe, is a gibbet with a Golden Rune [1] next to it.
Drop onto the road and follow it northwest while hugging the right wall to a slope. Kill the lone enemy on the slope and he'll turn into a Runebear that drops a Larval Tear.
Talk to Yura under the ruin just west of the slope.
Travel to The First Step and head west-northwest toward the beach. Down the slope with a Troll, you'll find an invisible scarab that drops Ash of War: Stamp (Sweep).
Pick up the Strip of White Flesh next to a campfire at the north end of the beach.
Follow the shoreline to a corpse with Land Octopus Ovary beside a fallen tree.
Continue along the shoreline to find the Nomadic Merchant (West Limgrave) under a ruin.
Near the waterfall at the end of the beach is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Head back along the beach while hugging the cliff to discover the entrance to Coastal Cave:
Grab the Coastal Cave grace, then talk to Boc next to it.
The only item in this cave is a Land Octopus Ovary just outside the boss room.
Kill the two Demi-Human Chiefs for Tailoring Tools, Sewing Needle and 1,200 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Demi-Human Chiefs; Tailoring Tools; Sewing Needle

steps.instruction: Old Knight Istvan's summon sign can be found just outside the room.
A corpse with Smoldering Butterfly lies in the tunnel past the boss.
Continue through the tunnel to emerge on a small island, then head uphill and grab the Church of Dragon Communion grace.
Examine the altar in the church and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Climb the slanted ruin next to the church to find Exalted Flesh at the top.
Northwest of the ruin, next to some trees at the edge, lies a corpse with Great Dragonfly Head x4.
Follow the cliff edge south-southeast to a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Continue along the edge to find a Smithing Stone [2].
Return to Boc in Coastal Cave and give him the sewing needle.
Travel to The First Step and kill the Tree Sentinel for Golden Halberd and 3,200 runes.
At the base of the cliff northwest of the Church of Elleh lies the entrance to Stormfoot Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Stormfoot Catacombs grace.
Pick up Root Resin x2 from the room straight ahead.
Take the other path to a Grave Glovewort [1] in the boss door room.
Behind an unlit brazier in the next room is a Grave Glovewort [1].
Head past the first fire-breathing pillar and attack it to deactivate it, or just use Margit's Shackle if you have it. Pick up Prattling Pate "Hello" behind the pillar.
Go past the second pillar and loot the Smoldering Butterfly x3 and Ghost Glovewort [1] behind it, guarded by several Imps.
Climb the ladder in the corridor to a Grave Glovewort [1] immediately to the left.
In the room at the end, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [1] and Wandering Noble Ashes.
Drop to the ledge outside the room for a Grave Glovewort [1] and the boss lever.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Noble Sorcerer Ashes and 1,300 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Burial Watchdog; Noble Sorcerer Ashes

steps.instruction: Travel to Stormhill Shack and head south-southwest to a cliff wall, then follow it to a slope near the edge. A Smithing Stone [1] is in the graveyard up the slope.
Continue east-southeast to find another graveyard, but with Magic Grease x3, Godrick Soldier Ashes, and Bloodrose x3 (next to a gibbet).
steps.linkedRaw: Magic Grease x3; Godrick Soldier Ashes; Bloodrose x3

steps.instruction: At the cliff edge south of the second graveyard, you'll find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
On top of the nearby ruin is a corpse with the Crossed Legs gesture.
Kill the Crucible Knight in the evergaol east of the ruin for Aspects of the Crucible: Tail and 2,100 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Crucible Knight; Aspects of the Crucible: Tail

steps.instruction: Enter the gate just northeast of the evergoal for a chest containing the Arrow's Reach Talisman.
Return to the evergaol, then head north toward the cliff edge and drop onto the ruin with a Troll. Pick up the Golden Rune [2] hanging off its edge.
Travel to Warmaster's Shack and follow the path north-northwest of the grace until you get invaded by Recusant Henricus. Kill him for the Hammer Talisman.
Pick up Small Red Effigy and Duelist's Furled Finger from the corpse in front of the colosseum.
steps.linkedRaw: Small Red Effigy; Duelist's Furled Finger

steps.instruction: Enter the colosseum to access it from the Marika statue in Roundtable Hold.
Go around the ledge of the farthest bridge pillar east of the colosseum to find Soporific Grease x3.
Jump back onto the cliff and head toward the ruin south-southwest. Kill the mounted Godrick Knight near it to receive Ash of War: Golden Vow.
Kill the scarab on top of the ruin to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Below the cliff edge south of the ruin with the scarab is another ruin. Jump onto it and grab the Lance hanging off its edge.
Drop to the camp below and head northeast, this time going up the left ledge to find the entrance to Deathtouched Catacombs on your left:
Head inside and activate the Deathtouched Catacombs grace.
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [1] in the first room.
Go through the narrow passageway beside the staircase for a Grave Glovewort [1].
Take the other passageway to a ledge with Uchigatana and a Grave Glovewort [1].
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [1] in the room below.
Pull the boss lever in the final room, then turn around for a corpse with Bloodrose x3.
Kill the injured Black Knife Assassin for Assassin's Crimson Dagger and 1,600 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Black Knife Assassin; Assassin's Crimson Dagger

steps.instruction: Open the chest in the boss room to obtain a Deathroot.
Exit the catacombs and head north-northeast toward a field of Golem remains. Pick up the Lance Talisman on the remains of a Golem near the cliff.
Head south toward some gibbets near the edge for a Golden Rune [3] beneath one of them.

Travel to Saintsbridge and jump down the gap to the right of the bridge while on horseback, landing near the spiritspring. Then, head up north and drop down near the cliff to find a campsite with Turtle Neck Meat.
In the cliff just below the campsite lies the entrance to Highroad Cave:
Head inside and activate the Highroad Cave grace.
After dropping down once, go through the northeast tunnel for a Golden Rune [1] guarded by some wolves.
Drop down the hole in the middle, follow the downward path to some wolves, then take the left path up to a ledge with Arteria Leaf.
Below the ledge lies a corpse with Fire Grease x2.
When the cave opens up, drop down at the end of a ledge, then turn around to find Smithing Stone [1] x3.
Follow the tunnel at the top of the waterfall to a Smithing Stone [2], then a Golden Rune [4] farther in.
Drop down the waterfall and cross the pillar in the water to pick up Shamshir next to some bats.
Continue across and through a tunnel until you reach the Furlcalling Finger Remedy hanging off a ledge.
Go through the tunnel under a waterfall and kill the Guardian Golem for Blue Dancer Charm and 1,700 runes.
Travel to Warmaster's Shack, pass time until nightfall, and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter in the shack for Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing and 2,700 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Bell Bearing Hunter; Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing

steps.instruction: While it's still night, kill the Deathbird on the flat ruin east of Warmaster's Shack for Blue-Feathered Branchsword and 2,800 runes.
Travel to Summonwater Village Outskirts and kill the Tibia Mariner in the village for Deathroot, Skeletal Militiaman Ashes and 2,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Tibia Mariner; Deathroot; Skeletal Militiaman Ashes

steps.instruction: Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] in front of some gravestones in the water.
In the ruined structure near the gravestones is a corpse with Mushroom x3.
Head toward the part of the ruins up on the hill to find a Golden Rune [4] in a small tower.
In front of the church where Limgrave meets Caelid, you'll be invaded by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater. Kill her for the Sacred Scorpion Charm.
Grab the Smoldering Church grace and loot the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14] and Missionary's Cookbook [3] next to it.
steps.linkedRaw: Smoldering Church; Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14]; Missionary's Cookbook [3]

steps.instruction: Next to some dogs and a wagon southeast of the grace is a corpse with Drawstring Lightning Grease x2.
Beyond the smoldering fence at the end of the road lies the Rotview Balcony grace.
Pick up the Nascent Butterfly x2 in front of the grace.
Loot the Golden Rune [3] and Preserving Boluses x5 from the shacks near the grace.
Climb the ledge south-southwest of the grace to discover a cemetery with a Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [3].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]

steps.instruction: Travel to Bestial Sanctum and feed Gurranq the two Deathroots you got earlier to receive Bestial Sling, Clawmark Seal, and Beast Eye.
steps.linkedRaw: Bestial Sling; Clawmark Seal; Beast Eye

steps.instruction: Offer the Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing and any future bell bearings to the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold to unlock new items.
From the South of the Lookout Tower grace, head northeast up the slope, then turn left to find 2x Golden Rune [1] x3 on the stretch leading to the tower.
Climb the ladders in the lookout tower for a chest at the top containing Hand Ballista and Ballista Bolt x5.
Return to South of the Lookout Tower and head north down the cliff. After dropping down, pick up a Rainbow Stone from the campsite.
Follow the downward slope north of the campsite to enter Earthbore Cave:
Head inside and activate the Earthbore Cave grace.
Avoid the crack in the floor that collapses when stepped on, and open the chest behind it for Pickled Turtle Neck x3.
Follow the tunnel to a Golden Rune [1].
Continue ahead to pick up Glowstone x5 and Kukri x8 from two corpses next to each other.
Drop down and kill the Runebear for Spelldrake Talisman and 2,600 runes.
Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x5 and Trina's Lily at the end of the room.
Head back up the slope outside the cave, then follow the cliff edge above it northwest to a basin with the Faith-knot Crystal Tear.
Just south of the basin lies Demi-Human Forest Ruins:
Kill the Demi-Human Queen near the entrance for Demi-Human Queen's Staff and Crystal Burst.
Pick up Arteria Leaf x2 from the corpse near the queen.
Head down the cellar in the southernmost part of the ruins for a chest containing Shield of the Guilty
Among the flowers southeast of the ruins, you'll find Gold-Tinged Excrement x2 and String x5.
Head south from the patch of flowers to find a Golden Rune [2] next to some Miranda Blossoms.
Follow the dirt path south of the Miranda Blossoms to Morne Tunnel:
Drop down to the left of the lift for a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall.
Activate the Morne Tunnel grace at the bottom.
Climb the ladder at the end of the first room for a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall.
Head into the next room without falling, and pick up the Golden Rune [2] down the first set of stairs.
In the alcove just northeast of the rune is an outcrop with Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] near the bottom of the stairs.
Follow the south tunnel to a hut with a Golden Rune [4] and a chest with Exalted Flesh.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] behind the hut, then the Large Glintstone Scrap x2 in the nearby alcove.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [1]; Large Glintstone Scrap x2

steps.instruction: In the area below the stairs in the previous room, you'll find a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall and Stanching Boluses on a corpse.
Follow the west tunnel to a large room. At the west end of it, you'll find a smaller room with Soft Cotton.
Pick up the 4x Smithing Stone [1], Somber Smithing Stone [1], and Arteria Leaf x2 in the large room.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [1]; Somber Smithing Stone [1]; Arteria Leaf x2

steps.instruction: On the wall to the right before the boss is a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Kill the Scaly Misbegotten for Rusted Anchor and 2,000 runes.
From the Church of Pilgrimage, head south toward a stone arch against a cliff. Behind it lies the entrance to Tombsward Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Tombsward Catacombs grace.
Unlock the imp seal for a corpse with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9].
Pick up Grave Glovewort [1] and Grave Glovewort [2] from the first room.
Go down the stairs for a Grave Glovewort [1] to the right and a Ghost Glovewort [1] in the back.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [1] in the corridor.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar, then pick up the Human Bone Shard x5 on the ground.
In the room east of the pillar, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [2] and Prattling Pate "Thank you".
Activate the pillar while standing on top of it to reach the Golden Rune [2] on the ledge.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] in front of a coffin, then pull the lever ahead.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Lhutel the Headless and 2,200 runes.
Exit the catacombs and kill the Erdtree Avatar in front of the Minor Erdtree for Opaline Bubbletear, Crimsonburst Crystal Tear, and 3,600 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Avatar; Opaline Bubbletear; Crimsonburst Crystal Tear

steps.instruction: Kill the Operatic Bat below the cliff past the Erdtree for a Golden Rune [6] (first time), then pick up the nearby Sliver of Meat.

Head west-northwest from the bats to a large ruin, then go north-northeast toward a stone arch and drop to the ledge below it. On a pillar below the ledge sits a corpse with Eclipse Crest Heater Shield.
Travel to the Tombsward grace and head north-northwest toward Tombsward Ruins:
Pick up Beast Liver next to a rat in the middle of the ruins.
Open the chest in the cellar to obtain Winged Scythe.
Kill the scarab at the top of the large ruin next to the ruins for Divine Fortification.
Unlock the evergaol west of the ruins, then kill the Ancient Hero of Zamor for Radagon's Scarseal and 5,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ancient Hero of Zamor; Radagon's Scarseal

steps.instruction: On a lower ledge south of the evergaol lies the entrance to Tombsward Cave:
Go inside and grab the Tombsward Cave grace.
Pick up the Golden Rune [2] right before the poison swamp.
On the opposite end of the swamp is a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Follow the northeast tunnel past some rats to pick up Immunizing White Cured Meat and Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8].
steps.linkedRaw: Immunizing White Cured Meat; Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8]

steps.instruction: Head back and take the path on the right side to an Arteria Leaf on a ledge.
Drop down to find a corpse in the poison with Poisonbone Dart x6.
Kill Miranda the Blighted Bloom for Viridian Amber Medallion and 2,100 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Miranda the Blighted Bloom; Viridian Amber Medallion

steps.instruction: Exit the cave and take down the Wandering Mausoleum by hacking away at the skull formations on its feet until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map so that you can easily come back when you want to duplicate a remembrance.
In the area next to the slope that leads to the church lies Witchbane Ruins:
Pick up Great Dragonfly Head from a corpse in the back of the ruins.
Head down the cellar to find Ambush Shard next to Sellen's body.
Head south from the cellar to discover a cemetery on your left with 4x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [3].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]

steps.instruction: On top of the slope northeast of the cemetery, in front of some gibbets, you'll find Great Dragonfly Head x3.
Drop below the cliff southeast of the gibbets to discover a corpse in a chair with Mushroom x4.
Return to the gibbets and climb the lookout tower to open the trap chest at the top. After arriving, grab the Divine Bridge grace just ahead.
Open the chest to the right of the Golem for the Blessed Dew Talisman.
Travel to Castle Morne Rampart and use the nearby spiritspring while facing south to reach the top of a tower with Great Turtle Shell and Warming Stone x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Great Turtle Shell; Warming Stone x2

steps.instruction: An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the cliff edge east of the tower.
Head toward Oridys's Rise and examine the book in front of it. You'll need to hit three "Wise Beasts" to gain entry:
#1: On the road leading to the tower. Just look behind you after interacting with the book. [Location 1]
#2: In a bush to the left of the stairs. In front of you as you interact with the book. [Location 2]
#3: In a pond to the right of the tower. It's invisible so aim where the water splashes. [Location 3]
Enter the tower and loot the chest at the top to obtain a Memory Stone.
Exit the tower and go north to find the Beside the Crater-Pocked Glade grace next to a ruin.
Head north past the craters until you reach the cliff's edge, where you'll find a corpse in a chair with Stonesword Key.
Down the slope below the cliff southeast of the chair lies the entrance to Impaler's Catacombs:
Head inside to grab the Impaler's Catacombs grace.
On a coffin in the first room is a Grave Glovewort [1].
Follow the path straight ahead to a Grave Glovewort [2].
Momentarily step inside the room down the other path. When the floor rises to impale you, drop down beneath it for a Ghost Glovewort [2].
Loot the Grave Glovewort [2], Prattling Pate "Please help", Root Resin x3, and 2x Grave Glovewort [1] from the sewage area with respawning enemies.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [2]; Prattling Pate "Please help"; Root Resin x3; Grave Glovewort [1]

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder in the back, pull the lever, and pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] in the corner guarded by an Imp.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Demi-Human Ashes and 2,400 runes.
Travel to Castle Morne Rampart, pass time until nightfall, and kill the Night's Cavalry there for Ash of War: Barricade Shield, Nightrider Flail, and 3,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Barricade Shield; Nightrider Flail

steps.instruction: Head southwest through the rampart and kill the Deathbird behind a large ruin for Sacrificial Axe and 3,900 runes.
Continue southwest toward a beach to find a Golden Rune [1] in front of a gibbet.
Enter Castle Morne and activate the Castle Morne Lift grace.
After taking the lift, go up the stairs on the left for a Smithing Stone [2].
To the left of a tree at the southwest end of the area is a corpse with Smithing Stone [1] x3.
Pick up Fire Grease x2 from a ledge next to the mound of corpses in the courtyard.
Enter the room accessible from the ledge for a chest by the entrance containing the Claymore.
Go down the stairs and climb the ladder. On the rampart you'll find a Furlcalling Finger Remedy and the Steel-Wire Torch.
Climb the ladder on the rampart, then drop down for a Golden Rune [2] hanging off the edge of a bridge.
On the right side past the bridge is a ladder that leads to a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Descend the ladder on the left side past the bridge for a Golden Rune [2] near the clashing enemies.
Go up the wooden stairs and talk to Edgar to receive a Sacrificial Twig, then deliver him Irina's Letter.
Head back down and step on the brick rubble at the end of the rampart, then jump over the fence to grab the Behind the Castle grace.
Drop to the top of a rampart, then drop down southwest to land on a wooden platform with a Stonesword Key.
Enter the room below to find a corpse with Pickled Turtle Neck.
Climb the ladder across the bridge for a chest containing the Twinblade Talisman.
Drop onto the rooftop below the bridge and pick up the Tarnished Golden Sunflower x3 next to a tree.
Continue down until you reach a castle platform, then drop onto a wooden beam down the hole to pick up Smithing Stone [2].
In the room at the bottom sits a corpse with the Whip.
Turn left outside the room to discover the Beside the Rampart Gaol grace.
Cross the wooden bridge to pick up Throwing Dagger x8.
Descend the ladder, then head around the side of the structure to find a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
In the narrow passage north-northeast of the ladder is a corpse with Fire Arrow x15.
Kill Leonine Misbegotten for Grafted Blade Greatsword and 3,800 runes.
Edgar's summon sign can be found outside the entrance if you gave him Irina's Letter.
There are no items in the arena, so go ahead and activate the Morne Moangrave grace.
Return to Edgar and exhaust his dialogue.
Travel to the Bridge of Sacrifice and talk to Edgar beside Irina's corpse.
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Weeping Peninsula.
steps.linkedRaw: non-respawning crafting materials in Weeping Peninsula

links.label: non-respawning crafting materials in Weeping Peninsula

steps.instruction: From Stormhill Shack, follow the uphill road to the castle entrance. Head inside and grab the Castleward Tunnel grace in an alcove.
Defeat Margit, the Fell Omen for Talisman Pouch and 12,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Margit, the Fell Omen; Talisman Pouch

steps.instruction: Rogier's summon sign can be found outside the entrance.
Activate the Margit, the Fell Omen grace, then grab the Stormveil Main Gate grace in front of the gate.
steps.linkedRaw: Margit, the Fell Omen; Stormveil Main Gate

steps.instruction: Descend the stairs northeast of the grace for a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Drop to the wooden platform below the stairs to find Fire Grease x2 at the end of a small tunnel.
Return to the gate and talk to Gostoc. Don't worry about the main gate, you can open it yourself later.
Go through the hole in the wall and pick up the Golden Rune [1] immediately on the left, then the Ruin Fragment x3 on the nearby ledge.
Continue to a broken wall but instead of dropping down, climb it up to discover a corpse with Smithing Stone [2].
After dropping down, head south-southeast and down the slope to find Bolt x10 at the end.
Head up the slope for a Smithing Stone [3] guarded by Stormhawks on the left side.
Continue north and drop down to discover the Stormveil Cliffside grace.
Pick up Marred Leather Shield from the corpse up the first set of stairs.
Before you enter the castle, pick up the Golden Rune [2] on the scaffolding around the entrance.
Head inside and loot the Hookclaws in a corner on the first floor.
Note: Gostoc will now steal 30% of your runes each time you die inside the castle.
Go up the stairs and pick up the Throwing Dagger x5 in a narrow passage next to a locked door.
Pick up St. Trina's Arrow x10 from a hole in the wall covered with vines.
Back inside, jump to the ledge east-southeast of the hole for a Golden Rune [2], then back across to grab the Smoldering Butterfly x3 in front of the barrels.
Enter the room at the top. Kill the knight to unlock the door, then loot the corpse for Rusty Key and the chest for Curved Sword Talisman.
Unlock the earlier door and step through the doorway at the top of the ladder. This will trigger Gostoc to spawn on the first floor. Talk to him to receive a Grace Mimic. [Location 2]
Kill the greataxe-wielding soldier next to him, then return to the top of the ladder. Head northwest first for a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Head outside and go around the ledge below the stairs to find Mushroom x3.
Ascend the outside stairs, then the first set of stairs inside. Grab the Rampart Tower grace in the north room, but do not rest at it.

Head out the north exit and run for the downward staircase that leads to a rooftop past the Stormhawks. Either kill them or lose their aggro, then fast travel to the Rampart Tower grace. You should now see Gostoc behind a nearby lift. Talk to him and he'll stop stealing your runes. Also pick up the Drawstring Fire Grease x2 beside him.

Note: If he's not there, check to see if he's stuck at his earlier location. Clear his path of enemies, run to the stairs past the Stormhawks without resting, then teleport to the Rampart Tower and he should appear. [Location 4]
Descend the stairs with a Banished Knight close by and look for thorny vines outside. Drop to the ledge below the vines and follow it to a hole in the wall with Arteria Leaf x3.
Drop onto the wooden platform inside, then go across the plank for a corpse with Fire Grease.
Jump to the elevated platform near the plank and head down the outside scaffolding to pick up the Brick Hammer.
Travel to the Rampart Tower and head outside toward the Stormhawks. Drop down below the left side balcony and pick up the Marred Wooden Shield below a narrow ledge.
Continue down until the platform collapses. After landing, take out the scarab to obtain Ash of War: Storm Assault.
Kill the Crucible Knight for Aspects of the Crucible: Horns. If you want to play it safe, you could run a short distance past him to grab a shortcut lift.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [2] in the alcove near the Crucible Knight.
Take the shortcut lift back to the Rampart Tower and go up the stairs. Jump across the lift's wheels to pick up Throwing Dagger x5.
Continue outside to pick up a Golden Rune [2] from a wooden platform.
Jump onto the stone fence and follow it to the southeast tower. Then, jump to the ledge around the east tower and drop down inside it for a Stonesword Key.
Pick up the Dozing Cross-Legged gesture from the corpse on the rooftop below.
Head around the narrow ledge of the tower west of the gesture to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Go back to the rooftops, then go around the ledge up a slanted pillar. Climb the ladder in front of a tower and pick up the Claw Talisman at the top.
Return to the Rampart Tower and loot the Smithing Stone [2] at the end of the rampart with the Stormhawks.
A corpse with Golden Rune [2] lies on the rooftop down the stairs.
From the corpse, turn southeast and jump to the lower part of the roof for Kukri x5.
Enter through the window and talk to Rogier next to the altar. Answer that you're here to defeat Godrick.
Exit the church and continue to a room with Golden Rune [2] x2.
Continue until you reach a room with a Banished Knight, then open the chest next to a table for Mimic's Veil.
Exit the room the way you entered, then climb the sacks against the fence to an area with a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Head up the wooden platform and climb the ladder at its end. Drop down straight ahead and enter the dark room for a Stonesword Key and a chest with Pickled Turtle Neck x3.
steps.linkedRaw: Stonesword Key; Pickled Turtle Neck x3

steps.instruction: Turn back and open the shortcut door, then descend the stairs to the dark room. Below the staircase lies an Exalted Flesh.
Loot the Highland Axe and Stanching Boluses from the room with the Grafted Scion (won't respawn if killed).
At the west-southwest end of the room is a shortcut lift back to the Rampart Tower if you need to rest.
Enter the south-southeast room to pick up Crimson Hood, Lump of Flesh, and Golden Rune [1] around a pile of corpses.
steps.linkedRaw: Crimson Hood; Lump of Flesh; Golden Rune [1]

steps.instruction: Note: If Roderika still hasn't moved to Roundtable Hold, you'll find the Chrysalid's Memento instead of the hood. You'll need to follow her questline at the roundtable until she becomes a spirit tuner. She'll then throw away her hood, which replaces the memento.
Enter the north-northwest room and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [2] beneath the statue on the right.
Unlock the imp seal and loot the Hawk Crest Wooden Shield, Misericorde, and Iron Whetblade in the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield; Misericorde; Iron Whetblade

steps.instruction: Head through the remaining doorway in the dark room. Immediately on the left is a staircase that leads to Arrow x10 on a wooden platform.
Enter the courtyard, then immediately head left to find a cellar entrance. Pick up the Fireproof Dried Liver beside a table.
Unlock the imp seal and open the two chests to obtain Godslayer's Seal and Godskin Prayerbook.
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the outside ledge. Remember this ledge, because you'll return here to drop down later.
For now, climb the ladder to the left of the cellar exit and pick up Arrow x10 from behind a barrel.
Continue to another ladder. At the top of it lies a corpse with Festering Bloody Finger x3.

Note: Skip this step until you've received the Festering Bloody Fingers from Varre during South Liurnia. Picking it up now makes About Invasion Multiplayer unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough. For more info, see Varre's questline.
steps.linkedRaw: South Liurnia; About Invasion Multiplayer; Varre's questline
steps.warning: MISSABLE — Note: Skip this step until you've received the Festering Bloody Fingers from Varre during South Liurnia. Picking it up now makes About Invasion Multiplayer unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough. For more info, see Varre's questline.

steps.instruction: Continue past the Banished Knights and across the wooden bridge for a ladder that leads to the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10] on a wooden platform.
From the wooden platform, jump onto the roof next to it, then drop down the hole to find a corpse with Wooden Greatshield.
Head down the stairs and look to the right past some trees to find Mushroom x8 in a corner.
On the nearby stairs lies a corpse with Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x2 in the alley west of the stairs, then grab the Liftside Chamber grace in the room next to it.
Enter the courtyard and grab the "Prophecy" Painting from the room on the west side.
Loot the Magic Grease, Golden Rune [1], 2x Golden Rune [2], Pike, and Smoldering Butterfly x5 around the flamespitters in the courtyard.
steps.linkedRaw: Magic Grease; Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Pike; Smoldering Butterfly x5

steps.instruction: Pick up the Golden Rune [4] and Kukri x5 on the incline that leads up to the courtyard.
Return to the courtyard and pick up Fire Arrow x12 from a wooden guard post.
Head through the cellar again and drop down the ledge from earlier. Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] behind the ballistas, then go down the stairs for a Smithing Stone [1].
Enter the room to the right of the main gate to grab a Golden Rune [5] and the Gateside Chamber grace.
Through the door past the grace sits a corpse with Commoner's Simple Garb.
Push the lever to open the main gate if Gostoc didn't do it earlier, then loot the Ballista Bolt x5, Golden Rune [2], and Golden Rune [1] behind the gate.
steps.linkedRaw: Ballista Bolt x5; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [1]

steps.instruction: Kill the Elder Lion in the corner on the right at the top of the slope for Somber Smithing Stone [1], Beast Blood, and Old Fang x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [1]; Beast Blood; Old Fang x2

steps.instruction: Go through the east-northeast corridor to grab the Limgrave Tower Bridge grace for later.

Head back through the corridor and to a doorway that leads to multiple sets of stairs. Jump up the rocks left of the stairs, then onto the cliff on the opposite side to grab the Arbalest from a walled area.
Travel to the Liftside Chamber, go up the nearby stairs, then up the staircase on the left that leads to a Smithing Stone [2].
Turn back and head past the spiked barricades for a Golden Rune [2] beside some breakable crates.
Enter the room on the right and exhaust Nepheli's dialogue for a talisman later.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x4 in the corner of the room.
Exit the room and pick up the Golden Seed between two trees to the right of the path.
In an alley between two houses on the right, you'll find a Smithing Stone [2].
Bait the Troll into following you and attacking the fallen statue back in the courtyard to obtain 5x Smithing Stone [1] and a Smithing Stone [2].
Return to the stairs and grab the Secluded Cell grace in the room on the right before the boss.
Kill the scarab past the southwest doorway to obtain Ash of War: Stormcaller.
Pick up the 2x Cracked Pot behind the Living Jars in the back.
Beyond the south-southeast doorway is a shortcut lift that goes down to the Liftside Chamber.
On a wooden ledge northeast of the jars sits a corpse with Kukri x8.
Jump to the ledge on the wall and follow it to a ledge with two archways. In the area past them, you'll find Lump of Flesh x3.
Climb the sacks and head through the doorway. At the top of the room, turn right for Smithing Stone [2] x3 on a wooden ledge.
Pick up Golden Rune [2] and Smithing Stone [1] from a corner before the next room.
Beneath the stairs at the bottom floor of the room, you'll find the Manor Towershield.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [3] next to the glowing message outside.
Drop onto the ledge below and make your way down to a Golden Rune [5] hanging off a balcony.
Grab the Rainbow Stone x5 inside, then open the shortcut door east of the corpse.
Return to the corpse and jump across the broken platforms to reach a corpse with Arteria Leaf on the other side.
At the end of a broken buttress sits a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Drop to the bottom for a Golden Rune [2] in the corner.
Pick up the Poisonbloom x3 past the rats, then kill the scarab just past it to obtain Rancorcall.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the arena below for a Golden Seed. This will also unlock Rogier's dialogue about the corpse under Stormveil for later.
Loot the Smoldering Butterfly x3, Stonesword Key, and Throwing Dagger x8 from the corpses in the arena.
steps.linkedRaw: Smoldering Butterfly x3; Stonesword Key; Throwing Dagger x8

steps.instruction: Pick up the Prince of Death's Pustule next to the squid-like visage at the end.
Travel to the Secluded Cell and kill Godrick the Grafted for Godrick's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Grafted, and 20,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Godrick the Grafted; Godrick's Great Rune; Remembrance of the Grafted

steps.instruction: Nepheli's summon sign can be found near the entrance if you exhausted her dialogue earlier.
Rest at the Godrick the Grafted grace, then talk to Gostoc in the arena.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, you'll find a chest containing Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel in the room to the right of the throne.
Head down the other room and pick up the Shabriri Grape on the bottom floor.
Go outside and talk to Hyetta next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs. Give her the Shabriri Grape to learn the As You Wish gesture.
Talk to Boc next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace and select "Don't tell me...".
Travel to the Limgrave Tower Bridge and pick up the Boltdrake Talisman up the stairs.
In the crater on the right before the Archer Golem, you'll find a Warming Stone.
Loot the Soft Cotton and Ash-of-War Scarab down the rubble at the end of the bridge.
Use the sending gate to reach the other side. Pick up the Golden Rune [2] on a balcony, then grab the Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot next to the Golem remains.
At the end of the bridge is a corpse with Stormhawk Feather x5 hanging off the right side edge.
Go back and ride the lift in the tower to reach the Divine Tower of Limgrave grace.
Interact with the rune at the top and restore the power of Godrick's Great Rune.
Note: Great Runes can be equipped at sites of grace and activated with Rune Arcs. The effects are lost on death, so you'll need a new Rune Arc each time you die.
Note: Make sure to equip a bow or crossbow for destroying the chariot.
Talk to Varre now that Godrick is dead.
Travel to Roundtable Hold and exhaust Enia's dialogue in the newly opened room.
Touch the Two Fingers to learn the Rapture gesture.
On the balcony opposite Enia's room sits Rogier:
Tell him that you've defeated Godrick to receive Rogier's Rapier+8.
His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Talk to him about the corpse under Stormveil to unlock dialogue about the black knifeprints with Fia.
Talk to him about D and he'll additionally drop Rogier's Letter when he dies, detailing the location of D, Hunter of the Dead's brother.
In the hall below the balcony, you'll be invaded by Mad Tongue Alberich. Let him finish his gesture to learn the Reverential Bow gesture, then kill him for Taunter's Tongue.
steps.linkedRaw: Mad Tongue Alberich; Reverential Bow; Taunter's Tongue

steps.instruction: Head through the open door that leads to a corpse on a bed with the Cipher Pata.
Talk to Hewg and he'll comment that you've felled your mark. Reload the area, then talk to him about his prayer.
Let Fia hold you, then select "Do you know...?" and "About the Black Knifeprint" to receive the Knifeprint Clue.
Talk to D, Hunter of the Dead about Rogier.
Exhaust Nepheli's dialogue in the library. If you talked to her in Stormveil Castle, you'll receive the (missable) Arsenal Charm.
steps.warning: MISSABLE — Exhaust Nepheli's dialogue in the library. If you talked to her in Stormveil Castle, you'll receive the (missable) Arsenal Charm.

steps.instruction: Exhaust Gideon Ofnir's dialogue, then talk to him about Nepheli.
Travel to the Church of Pilgrimage and grab the Warhawk Ashes on the cliff edge behind the church (painting reward).
Descend the pillar behind the church to find Bewitching Branch x3 and Sliver of Meat on a ledge below the cliff.
steps.linkedRaw: Bewitching Branch x3; Sliver of Meat

steps.instruction: Travel to Seaside Ruins and jump down the spiritspring below the cliff south-southwest of the grace. Kill the Alabaster Lord on the beach for Ash of War: Gravitas (first time).
Past the fallen pillar on the beach lies a corpse with Lump of Flesh x3.
Enter the cave on the beach to find the Haligdrake Talisman hanging off a ledge.
Drop down to go up some stairs and unlock the entrance to Fringefolk Hero's Grave:
Descend the ladder and run past the poison. Wait for the chariot to appear, then pick up the Poisonbone Dart x5.

Continue until you reach a thin bridge with an item. Drop to the first ledge below the bridge, use Margit's Shackle to deactivate the fire-breathing pillar, then enter the north-northwest room for Lightning Grease x2.
Pick up the Erdtree's Favor in the other room, then immediately run back across to drop to the ledge below the start of the bridge.
After dropping down, take the lift up to a ledge with a Stonesword Key and a Banished Knight.

Equip a bow or crossbow, then once the chariot slams into the wall below and the screen starts shaking, shoot one of the ceiling ropes to drop a giant pot onto it, destroying the chariot and earning you the Erdtree Greatbow and Great Arrow x10.
Note: You can respawn the pots by resting at the grace.
With the chariot dead, drop down and pick up the Golden Rune [5] on the thin bridge.
Follow the uphill path to a spectral Banished Knight. Kill him for the Dragon Communion Seal, then loot the Dragonwound Grease on the corpse.
Head all the way down while picking up the Grave Glovewort [1] along the way.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit for a Golden Seed, Banished Knight Oleg, and 15,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ulcerated Tree Spirit; Golden Seed; Banished Knight Oleg

steps.instruction: Travel to The First Step and read the glowing message at Varre's location to learn the Bravo! gesture.
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Limgrave.
At the bottom of the cliff face southeast of Liurnia Lake Shore lies the entrance to Stillwater Cave:
Head inside and grab the Stillwater Cave grace.
Pick up the Golden Rune [3] on a ledge just past the grace.
Follow the upper section across a gap and through a tunnel that leads to an Operatic Bat that drops a guaranteed Golden Rune [6] (first time).
Loot the Sage Set, Serpent Arrow x15, and Golden Rune [5] in the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Sage Set; Serpent Arrow x15; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Exit the tunnel and drop into the poison for a Golden Rune [4] next to two Miranda Blossoms.
Return to the upper section and continue to a corpse with Glowstone x5.
Pick up the Poison Grease x2 in the corner opposite the boss entrance.
Kill the Cleanrot Knight for Winged Sword Insignia and 3,300 runes.

Return to Liurnia Lake Shore, head north-northwest and follow the wall on your left to a spiritspring. Use it facing southeast to find an evergaol and kill Adan, Thief of Fire for Flame of the Fell God and 3,800 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Adan, Thief of Fire; Flame of the Fell God

steps.instruction: Head west-northwest from the evergaol until you reach a wagon with Ballista Bolt x5 in front.
Loot the Fire Spur Me gesture, Fire Monks' Prayerbook, and Dappled Cured Meat (in a tent) in the camp down the slope.
steps.linkedRaw: Fire Spur Me; Fire Monks' Prayerbook; Dappled Cured Meat

steps.instruction: Travel to Laskyar Ruins and explore the ruins just northwest of the grace:
Kill the Revenant spawning in the middle for a Ghost Glovewort [2] (first time).
Grab the Smithing Stone [3] beside the stairs to the building with the spires if you haven't already.
Pick up the Ritual Pot northeast of the sending gate, then the Golden Rune [3] on the ground behind it.
Head down the cellar west of the rune to obtain the Wraith Calling Bell.
From the cellar, head north-northwest to a round stone building on your right. Talk to Rya inside and hear her request.
Head toward the island west of Rya to discover the Scenic Isle grace.
Talk to Patches next to the grace. Select "Speaking of" and "Talk".
On an island west-northwest of Patches, you'll find a basin with the Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear.
Continue northeast from the island to grab the Boilprawn Shack grace in front of a shack.
Talk to Blackguard and buy Rya's Necklace from him.
Buy one Boiled Prawn from him to learn the Spread Out gesture. Optionally, select "About Rya" and "Talk".
Climb the large ruin north of Boilprawn Shack to find a corpse with Rainbow Stone x4 at the top.
On top of another ruin just west lies a corpse with Tarnished Golden Sunflower x4.
Go back down the slope of the ruin, then head west-northwest to discover the Fallen Ruins of the Lake grace on a third ruin.
In the building surrounded by Crayfish south of the grace, you'll find Smithing Stone [2] x3.
Kill the lone Crayfish west-northwest of the building and it'll turn into a Grafted Scion that drops a Larval Tear.
Continue west-northwest to an island with a church. Talk to Varre in front, answer that they didn't seem right, then talk to him again for Festering Bloody Finger x5.
If this is the first time you obtain a Festering Bloody Finger, you will also receive About Invasion Multiplayer.
Pick up Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12] from the corpse in the church.
In the water just northwest of the church is a scarab that drops Bloodflame Blade.
Return to the church, then head west until you reach a building. Inside is a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x3.
Pop the balloon south of the building to receive a Golden Rune [6]. You can use any ranged weapon, but I prefer to use throwing knives.
Head east-southeast from the balloon until you see a large rock jutting from the water. Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] x2 in a chair behind it, guarded by a Giant Crab.
