Southeast of the chair, past the large rocks, is a small building with the Folly on the Lake grace inside.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x2 below a dead tree in the nearby poison swamp.
On a small island south-southeast of the tree is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Vow of the Indomitable.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Vow of the Indomitable
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Vow of the Indomitable

links.label: Ash of War: Vow of the Indomitable

steps.instruction: From the island, head west toward a slope with several gibbets. However, continue along the swamp to grab a Smithing Stone [2] between a tree and a rock on the left side.
Return to the slope with the gibbets to enter the Village of the Albinaurics:
Exhaust Nepheli's dialogue on the slope leading up to the village.
Enter the village and pick up a Larval Tear behind one of the stone coffins.
Activate the Village of the Albinaurics grace inside the small shack.
Head up the slope east of the grace and roll through the glowing pot to reveal Albus. Talk to him to receive the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).
Loot the coffin next to Albus to obtain the Ivory Sickle.
Cross the upper bridge and kill the Omenkiller for Crucible Knot Talisman and 4,900 runes.
Nepheli's summon sign can be found on the slope overlooking the boss if you exhausted her dialogue under the bridge.
At the bottom of the slope past the boss is a Rune Arc.
Return to the grace in the village and cross the nearby bridge. Behind a tree on the left is an Albinauric Bloodclot.
Next to the edge at the end is a corpse with the Crystal Sword.
Drop down next to the corpse, then head north up a ledge to find a scarab on the left side cliff edge. Kill it for a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Make your way to the tower in the distance west of the cliff edge to grab the Converted Tower grace in front of it.
Travel to Roundtable Hold, where Ensha will now attempt to ambush you. Kill him to obtain the Clinging Bone, then pick up the Royal Remains Set outside Gideon's study.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about Ensha twice.
Go down the stairs next to the blacksmith and talk to Nepheli.
Return to Gideon Ofnir and talk to him about Nepheli's despair.
Head back to Nepheli and select "I heard from Gideon", then talk to her again.
Travel to the Scenic Isle and head south toward an island with a Glass Shard in the middle, guarded by some Demi-Humans.
In the cliff face south of the island lies the entrance to Lakeside Crystal Cave:
Grab the Lakeside Crystal Cave grace and open the chest containing an Arteria Leaf.
Up the rubble on the left is corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
Head inside the tunnel at the end that leads to a chest with the Spear Talisman.
Exit the tunnel and descend the ledges below the cliff until you reach a campfire. Pick up the Throwing Dagger x5 in the room.
Continue to a Golden Rune [5] surrounded by snails.
When dropping down the cliff, drop from the left side to land on a ledge with Soft Cotton x2.
Loot the Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [2], and Lump of Flesh at the bottom.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [4]; Smithing Stone [2]; Lump of Flesh

steps.instruction: Kill the Bloodhound Knight for Cerulean Amber Medallion and 3,600 runes.
Talk to Latenna outside and show her the secret medallion. Hear her request, then talk to her again to receive Latenna the Albinauric.
Activate the Slumbering Wolf's Shack grace and pick up the Rune Arc on the elevated platform.
Travel to the Converted Tower and go inside to pick up Cuckoo Glintstone x5 from a desk.
Behind the tower is a corpse with Magic Grease x2.
Climb the walls surrounding the tower and double jump onto the stairs to get inside. Open the chest at the top to obtain a Memory Stone.
Head toward the Minor Erdtree northwest of the tower and kill the Erdtree Avatar for Cerulean Crystal Tear, Ruptured Crystal Tear and 5,800 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Avatar; Cerulean Crystal Tear; Ruptured Crystal Tear

steps.instruction: In the lower area past the Erdtree, near the cliff, you'll see a downward slope. Kill the scarab on the slope to obtain Ash of War: Sword Dance.
Continue down the slope to discover the entrance to Road's End Catacombs:
Go inside and grab the Road's End Catacombs grace.
Pull the boss lever in the first room, then pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] and 2x Grave Glovewort [3] below.
Hit the illusory wall next to the second staircase to find a Grave Glovewort [3], Human Bone Shard x5 and the Watchdog's Staff.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [3]; Human Bone Shard x5; Watchdog's Staff

steps.instruction: Pick up Grave Glovewort [2] in an alcove in the corridor ahead.
In the room past the corridor, you can find a Grave Glovewort [2] and a Grave Glovewort [3].
Hit the illusory wall at the end to discover a chest with the Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes.
Return to the first room and hit the illusory wall next to the first staircase. Inside you'll find a Ghost Glovewort [2] and a Rune Arc.
Go through the narrow path to find Root Resin x3, then hit the illusory wall behind it.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] at the end, then hit the illusory wall behind it to reveal the boss room.
Kill the Spiritcaller Snail for Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3,000 runes.
Exit the catacombs, then at the top of the slope, head north-northeast toward a shack. Quickly grab the Revenger's Shack grace in front of it as you get invaded.
Kill Edgar for a Shabriri Grape, Banished Knight's Halberd+8, and Raw Meat Dumpling x5.
steps.linkedRaw: Shabriri Grape; Banished Knight's Halberd+8; Raw Meat Dumpling x5

steps.instruction: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Spinning Strikes. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Grab the 5x Raw Meat Dumpling inside the Revenger's Shack; they only spawn if Edgar invades.
Kill Bols, Carian Knight in the evergaol past the shack for Greatblade Phalanx and 4,600 runes.
Kill the Operatic Bat beneath the tall rock north of the evergoal for a Golden Rune [6] (first time).
Follow the dirt path next to the tall rock to discover the Foot of the Four Belfries grace on the left side.
Loot the Blood Grease x3 and Jellyfish Shield next to a wagon on the road north of the grace.
Continue north toward a camp. In the lower section you can find a Rune Arc and a chest with Cuckoo Glintstone x10.
In the upper part of the camp, to the left of a Pumpkin Head, are two chests you can loot for Albinauric Bloodclot x6 and Smithing Stone [4].
Follow the path in the woods south-southeast of the chests to a fork, then follow the east path all the way up to The Four Belfries grace at the top.
Loot the chest near the grace to obtain an Imbued Sword Key.
Unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked by the message "Precipice of Anticipation":
Use the sending gate and kill the Grafted Scion for Ornamental Straight Sword, Golden Beast Crest Shield, and 3,200 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Grafted Scion; Ornamental Straight Sword; Golden Beast Crest Shield

steps.instruction: Continue to the chapel where you first started out and go through the previously closed side entrance to pick up The Stormhawk King.
Loot the chest in the chapel to obtain Stormhawk Deenh.
Return to Foot of the Four Belfries and head past the camp to encounter a caravan with the Carian Knight's Sword.
Head east from the camp's exit to find a chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
In front of a wagon below the cliff lies a corpse with Throwing Dagger x6.
Head southeast from the wagon to find a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [1], 3x Golden Rune [2], 5x Golden Rune [3], 2x Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [5].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Pop the balloon northeast of the cemetery to receive a Golden Rune [6].
Continue toward the island and grab the Sorcerer's Isle grace on a ledge by the water.
Examine the book in front of Testu's Rise to activate the three beasts:
#1: By the cliff edge just north from the book. [Location 1]
#2: Hanging onto the back of a tree behind the tower. [Location 2]
#3: Found below the cliff edge to the right of the tower when facing the entrance. [Location 3]
Loot the chest at the top of the tower to obtain a Memory Stone.
Pop the four balloons on the side of the island for 4x Golden Rune [6].
Underneath the large ruin behind the island lies a corpse with Old Fang x2, surrounded by Land Squirts.
East of the ruin lies a campsite with Lump of Flesh.
From the campsite, head northwest to some ruins with Soporific Grease x3 in between.
Up a short cliff northwest of the ruins, on a ledge in the corner of the area, you'll find a basin with the Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear.
Kill the large Fingercreeper burrowed in the ground near the basin for a Somber Smithing Stone [2] (first time).
Head east-southeast from the basin until you see a chair on your left with a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Continue east to discover The Ravine grace in front of a ravine.
Go through the ravine to find a Golden Seed at the other side.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [5] in a shack, then grab the Ravine-Veiled Village grace behind it.
In the water just northwest of the grace is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Barbaric Roar.
Travel to Road to the Manor, then turn around to explore Kingsrealm Ruins:
Pick up the Rimed Crystal Bud x8 in the tower southwest of the grace.
In the lower part of the ruins, you can find a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x4.
Roll through the hidden cellar just north-northeast of the corpse and kill the Royal Revenant for 3,100 runes.
Note: As with any Revenant, attempting to heal the boss will instead deal significant damage, making the fight laughably easy.
Loot the chest past the boss to obtain the Frozen Needle.
Return to the grace, then head up the north-northwest slope to a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], 4x Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [5].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Approach Caria Manor while dodging the enchanted snare to grab the Main Caria Manor Gate grace outside the entrance.
Kill the invisible scarab in the pond east-southeast of the manor gate to obtain Ash of War: Hoarfrost Stomp.
Cross the bridge-like rock that extends past the cliff, then go up the slope on the other side to find the Nomadic Merchant (North Liurnia).
Continue up the slope to a church. Grab the Bellum Church grace and the Sacred Tear in front of a statue.
From Bellum Church, pass time until nightfall, then head southeast to a large ruin. Behind it is a corpse with Sanctuary Stone x3.
Kill the Night's Cavalry on the southwest road for Ash of War: Giant Hunt, Nightrider Glaive, and 5,600 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Giant Hunt; Nightrider Glaive

steps.instruction: Continue southwest along the road to discover the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace on the right side.
Talk to Melina at the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace.

Jump down the spiritspring below the cliff southeast of the grace. Wait for the Wandering Mausoleum to get close, then use the spiritspring to leap onto it. Destroy the skull formations around it until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
In the cliffside east-southeast of the spiritspring lies the entrance to Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel:
Ride the lift down and activate the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel grace.
Open the chest up the stairs in the first room for a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Jump from the newly opened chest to a ledge to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] in the wall behind a stele.
Continue into a larger room, then go right to pick up a Smithing Stone [2] from the floor.
Head across the wooden beam and platforms for a Smithing Stone [3] on a wall and a corpse with Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Below the stairs in the next room, you'll find a Smithing Stone [3] and a Golden Rune [3].
Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [3] in the southeast side room.
Drop down to the left of the lift to discover a path that leads to a Somber Smithing Stone [2] on a wall.
Drop to the narrow ledge directly below for a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] next to a miner on the wooden platform below.
Go across the wooden beam to find 2x Smithing Stone [3] and a Smithing Stone [2] near a shortcut lift.
Enter the first room with a wooden doorway for a corpse with Smithing Stone [1] x3 and a Smithing Stone [2] beside it.
In the second room with a wooden doorway is a chest containing the Crystal Knife.
Loot the 4x Smithing Stone [3], Somber Smithing Stone [1], and Smithing Stone [2] below the stairs in the room ahead.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [3]; Somber Smithing Stone [1]; Smithing Stone [2]

steps.instruction: In the side room is a corpse with Shatter Earth.
Drop down to the left of the lift for a passage with a Somber Smithing Stone [3] at the end.
Drop to the bottom and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] on the way to the boss.
Kill the Crystalian for Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] and 3,000 runes.
Travel to the South Raya Lucaria Gate, head down the slope, and follow the right-side fence to a corpse with the Blue-White Wooden Shield.
Return to the slope and follow the left-side fence to a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x4 on the right.
Head down the first set of stairs past the spiked barricades and pick up Shattershard Arrow (Fletched) x6 hanging on the right-side fence.
Jump over the fence opposite the corpse, then pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x3 in the water below.
Shoot down the scarab attached to the underside arch of a bridge to obtain Ash of War: Charge Forth.
From under the bridge, follow the west wall to a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [1], 3x Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [3], 2x Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [5].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x3 in the building west of the cemetery.
Continue west toward a large ruins site and loot Rimed Crystal Bud x3 from the corpse in the middle of two rings of flowers.
In the tower south-southwest of the corpse is a chest containing the Icerind Hatchet.
Head northwest from the tower to discover the Temple Quarter grace.
Kill Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of the grace for Dragon Heart and 14,000 runes.
Loot the Dragonwound Grease, Kukri x6, and Academy Glintstone Key from the corpses behind the dragon's resting spot.
steps.linkedRaw: Dragonwound Grease; Kukri x6; Academy Glintstone Key

steps.instruction: On the island just southwest of the dragon is a teleporting scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
From the island, head north toward the shore riddled with Crayfish and pick up the Strip of White Flesh next to a sleeping one in the back.
Continue east from the shore to discover the Crystalline Woods grace.
In the cliff face southeast of the grace lies the entrance to Academy Crystal Cave:
Unlock the imp seal and grab the Academy Crystal Cave grace inside.
When you reach the large crystal-filled room, head right to find a corpse with Cuckoo Glintstone x5 in the back.
At the opposite end of the room is a passage that leads to a Stonesword Key in a cage.
Go through the tunnel opposite the passage, open the door, then hit the illusory wall behind a Budding Cave Moss on the left to reach a chest with Crystal Staff.
Loot the chest below for a Rune Arc.
Kill the two Crystalians for Crystal Release and 3,300 runes.
Ride the lift past the boss and loot the chest at the top to obtain Terra Magica.
Travel to Crystalline Woods and head north toward a building in the woods with Smithing Stone [3] x3.
Continue northeast toward a building in the lake with Smithing Stone [2] x3.
From the building, head east-southeast to discover the East Gate Bridge Trestle grace under the large bridge.
Kill the teleporting scarab at the top of a slope around the corner east of the grace for Ash of War: Shield Bash.
Head up the left-side edge of the slope south of the grace to discover a chair with a Stonesword Key between two bridge pillars.
Travel to the Scenic Isle, pass time until nightfall, and kill the Deathbird near a ruin north-northeast of the grace for Red-Feathered Branchsword and 6,600 runes.
Return to Rya in the building east of the grace and give her necklace back to receive the Volcano Manor Invitation.
From Rya, head north toward a building with Smithing Stone [3] x3 inside.
On the severed bridge past the building lies a Golden Rune [3].
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the left end of a roof just north of the bridge.
From the roof, head north-northwest to find a corpse with Magic Grease on the tip of a fallen spire on your left.
Go straight west from the spire until you reach the corner of a building. Pick up Crystal Bud x2 from the rubble in the corner.
Climb the building with a tower southeast of the rubble. Loot the chest in the tower for Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4], then the Arteria Leaf x2 on the roof.
steps.linkedRaw: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]; Arteria Leaf x2

steps.instruction: Travel to Gate Town North, pass time until nightfall, then kill the Death Rite Bird just south of the grace for Ancient Death Rancor and 7,800 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Death Rite Bird; Ancient Death Rancor

steps.instruction: In the tower south of the boss, you'll find a chest with a Stonesword Key.
Behind the building east of the tower, next to some gravestones, lies a corpse with Crystal Cave Moss x3.
Travel to the South Raya Lucaria Gate and examine the gate seal. Grab the Main Academy Gate grace after arriving.
Down the slope east-southeast of the grace, you'll find the Isolated Merchant (Raya Lucaria). Buy the Fanged Imp Ashes for solving a puzzle later.
steps.linkedRaw: Isolated Merchant (Raya Lucaria); Fanged Imp Ashes

steps.instruction: Loot the Strip of White Flesh x2 past the merchant, then the Celestial Dew guarded by a Bloodhound Knight at the end.
steps.linkedRaw: Strip of White Flesh x2; Celestial Dew

steps.instruction: Return to the Main Academy Gate and interact with the red summon sign on the northeast bridge. Help Yura kill the Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin for Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.
steps.linkedRaw: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin; Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists

links.label: Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists

steps.instruction: Talk to Yura afterward to receive a Smithing Stone [5], then exhaust his dialogue.
Pick up the Golden Seed at the end of the bridge.
Ride the lift at the Main Academy Gate up to enter the academy. Turn right in the small courtyard to find Magic Grease next to a tree.
Open the door up the stairs, then hit the illusory wall immediately on the right to discover an area with a Rune Arc.
Back in the church room, loot the Somber Smithing Stone [3] behind the altar, then the Golden Rune [2] in a passage west of it.
Grab the Church of the Cuckoo grace in the corridor at the opposite side of the room.
When entering the graveyard, head left to find a corpse with Grace Mimic x3 at the edge.
Drop down east of the corpse to pick up Spellproof Dried Liver next to some gravestones.
Head toward the tree southeast of the gravestones and follow the ledge in the cliff to a Smithing Stone [4].
After crossing the bridge, drop toward the left side and follow the ledge up to a corpse with Marionette Soldier Ashes.
Pick up the Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot below the ledge.
Go up the slanted gravestones at the left-side cliff, then pick up the Golden Rune [4] immediately after dropping down.
Kill the scarab on the slope for Ash of War: Spectral Lance, then continue southeast to find Mushroom x5 between some gravestones at the top.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Spectral Lance; Mushroom x5

steps.instruction: Next to a tree before the doorway that leads to the next area, you'll find a corpse with Magic Grease x2.
Drop down the cliff west-southwest of the tree to pick up the Carian Knight Set in front of a gravestone.
Follow the ledge to a Golden Rune [4] next to the brick wall at the end.
Return to the graveyard. Kill the Alabaster Lord past the waterwheel for Gravity Well, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [3] on the shrine.
Ride the waterwheel up, then jump off midway to discover an alcove with Crystal Dart x5.
Go up the stairs to grab the Schoolhouse Classroom grace in advance.
Head back out and up the slope for a Golden Rune [4] near the top of the wheel.
Ride the waterwheel down while facing north, then jump to the first available ledge to pick up a Golden Rune [3] and Avionette Soldier Ashes.
Ride the wheel until you fall off, then pick up Smithing Stone [5] from the corpse where you land.
Climb the crystals near the corpse to pick up Lost Ashes of War at the end of a cliff.
Drop back down and loot the Longtail Cat Talisman next to the rubble of crystals behind an Abductor Virgin.
Note: If you died to its grab attack, follow the tunnel past the lava until you reach a site of grace. After resting, you should be able to return to the academy.
Return to the Schoolhouse Classroom and turn left in the hallway for a corpse with Conspectus Scroll and a chest with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5].
Hit the illusory wall behind the corpse to reveal a balcony with a Smithing Stone [4].
Jump over the balcony and follow the lower ledge to some lilies. Climb the rocky ledge and jump over the gap to a corpse with Olivinus Glintstone Crown.
Return to the hallway and continue to a room with several sorcerers. Open the chest in the room to obtain a Ritual Pot.
Go up the stairs and pick up the Furlcalling Finger Remedy on the balcony.
Hit the illusory wall on the left up the second set of stairs to reveal a room with Comet and a Stonesword Key.
Climb the ladder in the room, then drop down the holes to a room with the Graven-School Talisman in front of some crystals.
Open the shortcut door back, then kill the Red Wolf of Radagon for Memory Stone and 14,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Red Wolf of Radagon; Memory Stone

steps.instruction: Activate the Debate Parlor grace and pass time until nightfall.
Head into the courtyard and pick up the Stonesword Key on the fountain.
Just north past the fountain lies a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x5.
Around the corner northwest of the corpse, you'll find a Golden Rune [2] guarded by a Giant Crab.
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] behind the nearby tower, then the Golden Seed near the cliff.
Head around the southwest corner to find a Glintstone Crab that drops Karolos Glintstone Crown.
Return to the courtyard and ascend the large curved staircase, picking up a Furlcalling Finger Remedy while dodging the boulder.
Kill Moongrum, Carian Knight for Carian Knight's Shield. Behind him is the lift to the boss, so avoid that for now.
steps.linkedRaw: Moongrum, Carian Knight; Carian Knight's Shield

steps.instruction: Follow the south-southwest path through a covered walkway to open a shortcut back to the courtyard, then return the way you came to find a Golden Rune [4].
Jump over the balustrade near the corpse to reach a room with a ladder. Open the shortcut door first, then climb up and kill the sorcerers who summon the boulder.
Open the chest in the room to obtain the Glintstone Scarab.
Head out the balcony and pick up the Golden Rune [7] on the roof below it.
Confirm that it's still nighttime, then use the sending gate below and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter in Church of Vows for Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing and 6,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Bell Bearing Hunter; Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing

steps.instruction: Reload the area and talk to Miriel. Show him the Celestial Dew, then select "Talk". If you've killed or aggro'ed any NPCs, you can cleanse your sins at the statue. Any previously hostile NPCs will then become friendly again.
Return to Debate Parlor, but turn right when entering the courtyard. Jump over the balustrade to discover a ladder and climb it to a broken window. Head left once inside to pick up Crystal Bud x5.
Loot the chest on the opposite side for Radagon Icon, then pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the outside balcony.
Drop down the east side of the balcony to pick up Living Jar Shard x3 and a Cracked Pot.
steps.linkedRaw: Living Jar Shard x3; Cracked Pot

steps.instruction: Head down the stairs, then up the stairs covered in rubble. In the room straight ahead is a corpse with Glintstone Whetblade.
Up the stairs opposite the room, you'll find a Golden Rune [2].
Go up the stairs next to the room, then jump over the west balustrade. Open the shortcut down the stairs, then go back up to grab a Golden Rune [3] at the end.
Jump onto the rooftops below and continue to a ladder. Pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the ledge around it.
Climb the ladder and pick up Crystal Dart x5 from a corpse on the bridge.
Behind the structure at the end of the bridge lies a corpse with Meteor Bolt x5.

Drop to the rooftop below, then once more to a second rooftop. From there, you're gonna do a long jump, so make sure to hold the sprint button during the entire jump for the longest distance. While facing west-northwest, jump across the long gap to the rooftop ahead.
After jumping the gap, head down the south rooftops until you reach a tower. Climb the ladder inside to a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.
Jump over the west balustrade to land on a rooftop. From there, you can drop onto two rooftops, so drop to the one with a Smithing Stone [4] on top.

Drop to the rooftop where you made the long jump. Do it once more, then follow the west rooftop to a tower. Drop down twice inside the tower to find a Glintstone Crab that drops the Lazuli Glintstone Crown.
Drop to the bottom to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [4].

Travel to Debate Parlor and return to the rooftop where you made the long jumps. This time, drop down the north rooftops instead to pick up the Golden Rune [4] on a roof past the stretch with two Marionette Soldiers.
Drop to the ledge east below where the first Marionette Soldier was and pick up the Imbued Sword Key in a tower.
Go around the ledge of the second tower to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x2.
Head back across until you see the top of a ladder, then jump onto the large rooftop below. At the northwest end of it is a corpse with Magic Grease x2.
Go through the church windows and pick up the Golden Rune [3] on the rafters.
Carefully drop to the southernmost chandelier to grab the Academy Glintstone Key.
Drop to the small bridge below and head out the balcony to find a Glintstone Crab in the corner that drops the Twinsage Glintstone Crown.
Go across the small bridge, kick down the shortcut ladder, and pick up Shattering Crystal at the end of the corridor.
Head through the covered walkway across the other bridge to pick up Azur's Glintstone Staff in front of the graven mass.
Travel to Debate Parlor and return to the large curved staircase. At the bottom of it is a Smithing Stone [5].
Pick up Crystal Dart x8 from the broken buttress attached to the side of the staircase.
Ride the lift to the boss and defeat Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon for Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, Great Rune of the Unborn, and 40,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon; Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen; Great Rune of the Unborn
linkedItemNames: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

links.label: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen

steps.instruction: Activate the Raya Lucaria Grand Library grace and talk to Rennala. Select "Cosmetics", then "Finish Cosmetics" to learn the Balled Up gesture.
steps.linkedRaw: Raya Lucaria Grand Library; Balled Up

steps.instruction: Return to Thops in Church of Irith and give him your second glintstone key to learn the Erudition gesture. Optionally, talk to him about Sellen.
Reload the area to find a scarab in the church that drops Ash of War: Thops's Barrier.
Travel to Schoolhouse Classroom and go outside to find Thops at a table. Loot Thops's Bell Bearing, Academy Glintstone Staff, and Thops's Barrier from his corpse.
steps.linkedRaw: Thops's Bell Bearing; Academy Glintstone Staff; Thops's Barrier

steps.instruction: Talk to Enia in Roundtable Hold to receive a Talisman Pouch. Optionally, talk to her about Queen Marika.
Speak with Corhyn and select "Talk" now that you've obtained two Great Runes.
Travel to Liurnia Lake Shore and head east to a spiritspring. Use it while facing east-northeast, then grab the Liurnia Highway South grace by the road.
Follow the road southeast until you reach a carriage at the end. Loot Treespear from the chest in front.
Return to Liurnia Highway South and pop the two balloons near the grace for 2x Golden Rune [6].
Follow the road to some ruins and pick up Stormhawk Feather x3 from a corpse between them.
Northwest of the corpse lies Purified Ruins:
Pick up Cuckoo Glintstone x4 from a corpse in the ruined building.
Loot the Shabriri Grape and Two Fingers Heirloom in the cellar covered with breakable planks in the ruined building.
In front of some barrels west of the cellar, you'll find a Golden Rune [3].
Talk to Hyetta by the ruins near the shore and give her a Shabriri Grape.
Pick up Mushroom x5 from the corner of the ruins north-northeast of Hyetta.
Return to the road and grab the Liurnia Highway North grace before a battlefield.
On top of the ruin north-northeast of the grace is a corpse with Beast Blood, guarded by wolves.
Head down the slope south-southeast of the ruin until you reach a chair at the end with Somber Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Go up the slope until you find the entrance to Cliffbottom Catacombs on the left side:
Enter and activate the Cliffbottom Catacombs grace.
Ride the lift down while facing east, then jump to a ledge with Grave Glovewort [2].
Pick up Root Resin x5 from the first room.
Continue until you reach a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [2].
Go down the stairs and continue to a room with a Grave Glovewort [3] beneath the floor.
Unlock the imp seal on the second floor to pick up Nox Mirrorhelm.
In front of some bookshelves beneath the floor is a Rune Arc.
Pick up Grave Glovewort [2] from the top floor room, then pick up Scythe from the room at the end.
Before dropping down, loot the Golden Rune [3] and Grave Glovewort [3] in the left passage.
Drop onto the staircase, then once more to the bottom for a Ghost Glovewort [3] in the middle.
Loot the 2x Grave Glovewort [3], Hefty Beast Bone x3, and Prattling Pate "Wonderful" around the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [3]; Hefty Beast Bone x3; Prattling Pate "Wonderful"

steps.instruction: Continue ahead to find a Grave Glovewort [2] in the corridor.
Climb the ladder at the end and pick up Page Ashes from the altar on the left.
Pull the boss lever, then turn around to find Old Fang x3 in the corner.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3,200 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Burial Watchdog; Kaiden Sellsword Ashes

steps.instruction: Travel to Liurnia Highway North and head up the northwest slope. Pick up a Golden Rune [4] from the camp outside the tower.
Loot the chest in the tower for Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3], then pick up the Carian Glintblade Staff at the top.
steps.linkedRaw: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3]; Carian Glintblade Staff

steps.instruction: Return to Liurnia Highway North, pass time until nightfall, then loot the Lucerne, Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [6], and Crystal Dart x5 around the battlefield.
steps.linkedRaw: Lucerne; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [6]; Crystal Dart x5

steps.instruction: Kill the Night's Cavalry patrolling the road past the battlefield for Ash of War: Ice Spear and 5,600 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Ice Spear

steps.instruction: Continue following the road until you reach the Gate Town Bridge grace at the end.
Talk to Hyetta near the grace, give her a Shabriri Grape, and answer that they're human eyes. Reload the area, then exhaust her dialogue.
Pick up the Sliver of Meat guarded by a Runebear south of the grace.
Continue south toward a building in the lake and grab the Smithing Stone [2] x3 inside.
Pop the balloon in the lake north-northwest of the building for a Golden Rune [6].
Under the broken bridge east of the balloon is a corpse with Strip of White Flesh x3.
Just northwest of the bridge, you'll discover a campsite with Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x3.
From the campsite, head north along the cliff wall until you see a gravestone near several Land Squirts. Pick up the Land Squirt Ashes beside it.
Return to Gate Town Bridge and head east toward a spiritspring. Just south of it is an exploding scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Use the spiritspring while facing north to find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards at the edge.
Kill the Tibia Mariner in the pond north of the astrolabe for Deathroot, Skeletal Bandit Ashes, and 4,700 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Tibia Mariner; Deathroot; Skeletal Bandit Ashes

steps.instruction: D, Hunter of the Dead's summon sign can be found on the slope that leads to the pond.
Loot the Trina's Lily and Smithing Stone [3] in the pond.
Follow the dirt path past the pond and pick up Great Dragonfly Head x5 from a graveyard on the right.
Kill the Leyndell Knight patrolling the path to obtain Dragon Cult Prayerbook (first time).
Grab the Artist's Shack grace at the top of the slope, then interact with the painting in the shack to get the "Resurrection" Painting.
Just northeast of the grace is a chair with a Smithing Stone [4].
Cross the rock extending past the cliff near the shack. Kill the lone thorn sorcerer to the left of the camp to obtain Briars of Sin (first time).
Loot Flame, Cleanse Me and Smoldering Butterfly x8 (behind a tent) from the nearby camp.
steps.linkedRaw: Flame, Cleanse Me; Smoldering Butterfly x8

steps.instruction: Behind a tree northeast of the camp, you'll discover the Eastern Tableland grace.
Ride into the woods northwest of the grace to find Immunizing White Cured Meat next to a wagon on the road.

Continue along the path until you reach Uld Palace Ruins, where an Ancestral Follower will be shooting at you from a bridge. Make your way onto the bridge by going under it, then cross it to discover the Ruined Labyrinth grace.
At the edge east-southeast of the grace sits a corpse with Frenzyflame Stone.
Take down the Wandering Mausoleum in the area past the grace by hitting away at the skull formations on its feet. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
On a ledge south of the pond is a corpse holding the Spiralhorn Shield.
From the ledge, head west until you reach the edge, then drop down to pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from a chair in a patch of flowers.
Go up the nearby slope, then once you see the mausoleum, head north to find a scarab, hidden in bushes near the back corner, that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
From the top of the slope, go south until you reach the edge, then look left to find an opening in the tall rock. Go through it to find the Stalwart Horn Charm on the ledge.
Drop down from the ledge and go up the slope with statues to grab the Mausoleum Compound grace behind a statue.
Take down the second Wandering Mausoleum by hitting the formations around its feet. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
Kill the Erdtree Avatar east of the mausoleum for Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear, Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear, Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and 5,800 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Avatar; Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear; Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear; Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear

steps.instruction: Drop down the far-left edge of the cliff past the Erdtree, then head up the slope until you reach the entrance to Black Knife Catacombs:
Go inside and activate the Black Knife Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [2] next to the boss door room.
Unlock the imp seal to pick up the Rosus' Axe.
Grab the Grave Glovewort [2] in front of some rubble before the cleaver room.
Loot Spellproof Dried Liver from a corpse in front of a cleaver, then ride the cleaver up to a ledge with a Grave Glovewort [4].
Continue to a dead end and pick up the Grave Glovewort [3] in front of a hole, but don't drop down yet.
Hit the illusory wall at the end to reveal a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [4] and a boss.
Kill the Black Knife Assassin for Assassin's Cerulean Dagger, Black Knifeprint, and 4,200 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Black Knife Assassin; Assassin's Cerulean Dagger; Black Knifeprint

steps.instruction: D, Hunter of the Dead's summon sign can be found at the entrance.
Drop down the earlier hole, pull the boss lever behind you, then pick up the Ghost Glovewort [3].
Pull the second lever and loot the 2x Grave Glovewort [2], Grave Glovewort [3] and Rune Arc in the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [2]; Grave Glovewort [3]; Rune Arc

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder in the room to a Grave Glovewort [3] in front of a coffin.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes and 3,500 runes.
Open the chest at the end to obtain a Deathroot.
Travel to the East Raya Lucaria Gate and head up the slope east-northeast of the grace to reach a campsite with Slumbering Egg x2.
Ride down the ruin below the cliff, then head north-northeast to find a chair with a Rune Arc.
At the cliff northwest of the chair, you'll find another Rune Arc.
Enter the camp and pick up the Cuckoo Glintstone x3 next to a spiked barricade near the left-side catapult.
Loot the chest at the other side of the camp to obtain the Great Mace.
Head toward the massive staircase past the camp, then into the small woods on the left to find a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [3].
Pick up the Dragonwound Grease on the massive staircase, then grab the Grand Lift of Dectus grace inside.
steps.linkedRaw: Dragonwound Grease; Grand Lift of Dectus

steps.instruction: Talk to Melina at the Grand Lift of Dectus grace.
Head back down the stairs, then up the south-southeast slope toward a tower that inflicts madness buildup. Loot the Smithing Stone [2] x2, Yellow Ember, and Golden Rune [3] on the slope.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [2] x2; Yellow Ember; Golden Rune [3]

steps.instruction: Continue up the slope to find a corpse with Burred Bolt x5 on a long slanted rock.
Climb the tower for a chest containing the Howl of Shabriri, then kill the Frenzied Villagers at the top to extinguish the frenzy flame.
From the tower, head south-southeast to discover the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts grace behind a ledge.

Enter the tower east of the grace, equip any glintstone crown found in the academy, then use the Erudition gesture in front of the statue to unlock the seal. Loot the chest at the top for Cannon of Haima and Gavel of Haima.
steps.linkedRaw: Cannon of Haima; Gavel of Haima

steps.instruction: Ride the lift back down and jump over the balcony to access an area behind the tower, where you can pick up Crystal Dart x3.
Return to the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts and enter the village southwest of the grace:
In a corner immediately on the left, you'll find Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame.
steps.linkedRaw: Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame
linkedItemNames: Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame

links.label: Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame

steps.instruction: Pick up Frenzied's Cookbook [1] from the open house in the middle.
On the porch surrounded by a group of frenzied soldiers, you can find Shabriri's Woe.
Go up the slope at the end of the village, then jump onto the southwest village rampart to find a Stonesword Key.
Drop down the outer side of the rampart to pick up Eye of Yelough x3 from a corpse guarded by rats.
Follow the outer side of the rampart until you reach the village entrance, then go southeast toward a field with Eye of Yelough and Frenzyflame Stone in some chairs.
Return to the slope at the top of the village, then where the path splits, go downhill for a scarab that drops Frenzied Burst.
Continue downhill to find a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], 4x Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [7].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [7]

steps.instruction: Head back up the slope, then continue to the top to be invaded by Festering Fingerprint Vyke. Kill him to obtain a Fingerprint Grape and Vyke's War Spear.
steps.linkedRaw: Festering Fingerprint Vyke; Fingerprint Grape; Vyke's War Spear

steps.instruction: Grab the Church of Inhibition grace at the top, then loot the Sacred Tear and Finger Maiden Set in the church.
steps.linkedRaw: Church of Inhibition; Sacred Tear; Finger Maiden Set

steps.instruction: Talk to Hyetta in Bellum Church and give her the Fingerprint Grape.
Travel to Bestial Sanctum and feed Gurranq the two Deathroots to receive Ash of War: Beast's Roar and Bestial Vitality.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Beast's Roar; Bestial Vitality

steps.instruction: After reloading the area, Gurranq will enter a frenzy. Hit him a few times to snap him out of it, then talk to him (or rest at the grace if you can't).
Give Rogier the Black Knifeprint, then talk to him after reloading the area. Optionally, talk to him about Ranni's whereabouts, why he wants a cursemark, and about D.
By now, you should have enough Grave Gloveworts to upgrade any regular spirit ash to +4 with Roderika; afterward, select "Talk" to learn the Curtsy gesture.
After learning the gesture, talk to Hewg about Roderika.
Let Fia hold you, then talk to her about Rogier to receive a Sacrificial Twig.
Enter the manor and pick up the Rimed Crystal Bud x5 guarded by a Fingercreeper in the grass immediately to the left of the stone path.
Return to the stone path pick up the Smithing Stone [2] x3 in front of a fountain.
On the path behind the fountain is a Golden Rune [4].
In the grassy area east of the fountain lies a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x2.
Return to the manor entrance, then go east to find a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x3 next to a tree.
Go up the nearby stairs and into a small room with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [6].
Exit the room and continue to a fork. Follow the path straight ahead to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] at the end of an alley.
Go back and follow the other path to a hole in the battlement. Drop down and head north-northwest toward a scarab that drops Carian Piercer.
A corpse with the Ice Crest Shield lies on the ledge near the scarab.
From the ledge, go around the northwest corner, then turn west to find a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x2 in the grassy area to the left of the path.
Behind a crystal just south of the corpse, you can find Glintstone Firefly x6, guarded by two large Fingercreepers.
Return to the path and follow it to the manor entrance. Grab the Manor Lower Level grace up the stairs.
Look behind the altar in the room with the grace to find a Smithing Stone [4].
Head along the bridge, then once the path splits, cross the northeast bridge to find a Rune Arc behind the tower at the end.
Jump onto the rooftops below the tower, then descend a ladder to discover a chest containing the Sword of Night and Flame.
Open the shortcut door, then return to the grace and cross the bridges until you reach a set of stairs. Jump onto the wooden ledge below to pick up Rimed Crystal Bud x8.
Below the northeast staircase is a Golden Rune [3].
Head along the other side of the rampart to find a corpse with Urumi in front of the battlement.
Drop down the wooden platforms at the end of the rampart to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] on the broken battlement.
Return to the Manor Lower Level and the stairs at the end. Take the lift up and activate the Manor Upper Level grace.
Step into the garden for a Golden Seed and a corpse with Rimed Crystal Bud x3 in front of a tree.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Seed; Rimed Crystal Bud x3

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder on the left after going up the stairs to find a corpse with Magic Grease x2 hanging off the edge.
Kill the Troll Knight below to receive a guaranteed Troll Knight's Sword (first time).
Head across the top of the walls next to the troll, then drop down at the end for a Smithing Stone [4].
Pick up the Rimed Crystal Bud x5 guarded by a Page on the left staircase.
Hanging off the midsection between the stairs is a Golden Rune [4].
Kill Royal Knight Loretta for Loretta's Greatbow, Ash of War: Loretta's Slash, and 10,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Royal Knight Loretta; Loretta's Greatbow; Ash of War: Loretta's Slash

steps.instruction: Activate the Royal Moongazing Grounds grace, then from the boss entrance, go south-southwest through a doorway. Jump down the wooden platforms, then pick up the Cracked Pot and Crystal Dart x8 below.
steps.linkedRaw: Royal Moongazing Grounds; Cracked Pot; Crystal Dart x8

steps.instruction: Continue down to pick up a Smithing Stone [3] behind a small tree guarded by two Living Jars.
Jump onto the rooftop below the cliff to reach a corpse with Ash of War: Carian Grandeur.
Return to Royal Moongazing Grounds, enter the area past the boss, then follow the east path to a scarab that drops Frozen Armament.
Continue along the path to discover the Behind Caria Manor grace just past the woods.
In front of a gravestone east-southeast of the grace is a Grave Glovewort [1].
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [2] near the group of gravestones southwest of the first.
Head below the large slanted rock to find a Grave Glovewort [1] near some gravestones on the left.
Climb the slanted rock to pick up Thawfrost Boluses from the edge.
Enter the evergaol east-northeast of the rock and kill the Onyx Lord for Meteorite and 3,600 runes.
From the evergoal, head south-southwest to pick up a Golden Rune [3] from the pack of wolves.
Behind a tree with yellow leaves west-northwest from the pack of wolves, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [2].
Follow the west-southwest path for a Grave Glovewort [1] on the left, then pick up the Albinauric Ashes at the end of the path.
Just northeast of the ashes, you'll see an item pickup with the Juvenile Scholar Set and a Larval Tear (painting reward).
Return to Royal Moongazing Grounds, then from the boss exit, head west-southwest toward a ruin with a scarab that drops Ash of War: Chilling Mist.
Fight Adula southwest of the ruins; it will flee once you deal about half its HP.
Enter the tower past the dragon and grab the Ranni's Rise grace.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, open the nearby chest to obtain Spectral Steed Regalia: Carian Silver.
Exhaust Ranni's dialogue at the top of the tower until she tells you to leave.
Return to Rogier and tell him that Ranni cast off her cursemark.
Talk to Ranni, ask to enter her service, then greet her other vassals in the tower:
Talk to Iji's projection until you've exhausted his dialogue.
Talk to Blaidd's projection.
Talk to Seluvis's projection.
Talk to Ranni after greeting her vassals; if you rest at the grace, this dialogue is skipped.
Head toward the tower below the cliff southeast of Ranni's Rise. Climb the walls surrounding the tower to find a corpse with the Black Wolf Mask.
Talk to Seluvis inside the tower and accept his task to receive Seluvis's Potion.
Loot the chest at the top of Seluvis's Rise to obtain a Memory Stone.
You'll now have to decide who to give the potion to:
Give the potion to Nepheli:
Note: Turns her into a puppet, preventing completion of her, Gostoc's, and Kenneth Haight's questlines.
After receiving the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni, Pidia will die and drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet.
Give the potion to Dung Eater:
Note: Turns him into a puppet, failing his questline and locking you out of the Blessing of Despair ending (not required for all achievements).
Progress Dung Eater's questline up until you can administer the potion, then give it to him. [See quest]
Kill him after giving him the potion to obtain the Omen Set, but do it before reloading the area as that will despawn him.
Progress Seluvis's questline up until you can buy puppets from him, then buy the Dung Eater Puppet.
Give the potion to Gideon Ofnir:
You can progress everyone's questlines, but you'll miss out on either puppet until your next playthrough.
Talk to Nepheli and either give her Seluvis's Potion or the Stormhawk King that continues her questline.
Unlock the imp seal near Nepheli for a chest with Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow and Black-Key Bolt x20.
steps.linkedRaw: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow; Black-Key Bolt x20

steps.instruction: Unlock the second imp seal for a chest with Assassin's Prayerbook.

Speak with Rogier and select "Talk" to hear that his condition is worsening. Reload the area and talk to him in his unresponsive state, then reload the area three more times to find him dead. Loot Rogier's Bell Bearing and the Spellblade's Set from his corpse.
Note: He'll also drop Rogier's Letter if you talked to him about D, and Rogier's Rapier+8 if you didn't get it earlier.
If you didn't give the potion to Nepheli, and don't plan to give it to Dung Eater, give it to Gideon Ofnir now to safely progress everyone's questlines.
Note: Skip the Seluvis steps below if you're giving the potion to Dung Eater. You can't do them until you're rid of the potion, and Seluvis must remain alive until then.
Head down the hidden cellar in the ruins northeast of Ranni's Rise and interact with the message that reads: "Seluvis' Puppet. Do not touch".
Talk to Seluvis about his chambers to receive a puppet for free. Optionally, talk to him about Nepheli if you gave the potion to Gideon Ofnir or Dung Eater.
Quit and reload your game twice to unlock the next dialogue option, then talk to Seluvis and select "I want a new puppet".
Buy one puppet, then talk to Seluvis about the scheme and respond that you're interested.
Drop onto the rooftop below the cliff northeast of Seluvis's Rise and continue down to a ladder. Climb down to find a Spellproof Dried Liver.
Exhaust Pidia's dialogue in the room to access his inventory.
Go back up the ladder to find a corpse with Old Fang x5 on the roof.
Drop down to the rampart below the southwest edge and follow it to a wooden platform with Slumbering Egg x3.
Continue down the ramparts to pick up a Stonesword Key guarded by a Giant Crab at the end.
Talk to Iji at the Road to the Manor about Nokron and about Blaidd.
Travel to the Ravine-Veiled Village and climb up the ladders to a tunnel with 2x Smithing Stone [4].
Climb the ladder in the tunnel to a room with a Smithing Stone [3] and 2x Smithing Stone [4], but mind the poison traps on the ground.
Take the lift up while facing south, then jump off midway to a ledge with a Smithing Stone [5].
Ride the lift to the top. Pick up a Golden Rune [5], then a Smithing Stone [4] just behind the arch.
Loot the Smithing Stone [4] and Somber Smithing Stone [4] to the left of the stairs, then go up the stairs for a Rune Arc.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [4]; Somber Smithing Stone [4]; Rune Arc

steps.instruction: In the small room down the stairs is a corpse with Lightning Grease x2, but mind the poison traps.
Kill the exploding scarab in a tunnel to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Pick up Soft Cotton from a corpse at the precipice, then grab the Ruin-Strewn Precipice grace.
Take the lift up, then once you reach a second set of stairs, drop down for a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Climb the ladder ahead, then climb the rocks east of it to find a Somber Smithing Stone [3] at the top of some pillars.
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] guarded by some bats below.
Behind some crates near the ladder at the end, you'll find a Smithing Stone [4].
Go up the ladder up and grab the Golden Rune [5] and Smithing Stone [4] guarded by some bats near the wall.
Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [4] farther along the wall, and optionally kill the Operatic Bat next to a ladder for a Golden Rune [6] (first time).
Climb the ladder, then jump to the ledge of a pillar and go around it to find a Golden Rune [5].
Continue until you reach another ladder. On the wall behind it is a Smithing Stone [4].
Climb up, then go west-northwest up another ladder to a roof with a Smithing Stone [3] and the Serpent-God's Curved Sword.
Return down the ladder while picking up a Smithing Stone [4] in a corner on the way.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] in the wall, then the Smithing Stone [3] under a tent.
Kill the two Operatic Bats for 2x Golden Rune [6] (first time).
At the cliff edge behind the wooden structure is a corpse with Lost Ashes of War.
Follow the edge to a Rune Arc behind a pillar, then take the lift up to discover the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook grace.
Kill Magma Wyrm Makar for Magma Wyrm's Scalesword, Dragon Heart, and 24,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Magma Wyrm Makar; Magma Wyrm's Scalesword; Dragon Heart

steps.instruction: Summon Great Horned Tragoth to learn the Casual Greeting gesture (you can send him home afterward with the Finger Severer).
Blackguard's summon sign can be found at the entrance if you bought Rya's Necklace from him.
Activate the Magma Wyrm Makar grace at the end of the room. You should ignore the lift past the grace until the West Altus section.
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Liurnia.
Head toward the well northeast of Eastern Tableland, then go north past the well and a small pond to reach a Stonesword Key at the end.
Use the lift inside the well, then grab the Ainsel River Well Depths grace at the bottom.
Pick up the Golden Rune [3] in a coffin on the river edge.
Follow the river north to find a corpse with Magic Grease x3 at the base of a waterfall.
Head past the ants at the other side of the river to find Grace Mimic x8 on a coffin.
Go left once the path splits for a Smithing Stone [3].
Take the other path to a room with Silver Firefly x2, Golden Rune [1], and a Smithing Stone [3] guarded by an ant.
steps.linkedRaw: Silver Firefly x2; Golden Rune [1]; Smithing Stone [3]

steps.instruction: Follow the river down the right path and loot the Ghost Glovewort [1], Shattershard Arrow (Fletched) x10, and Smithing Stone [3] in the water.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghost Glovewort [1]; Shattershard Arrow (Fletched) x10; Smithing Stone [3]

steps.instruction: Go up the slope and grab the Ainsel River Sluice Gate grace in a nook in the wall.
Head back and take the other path. Kill the large-bellied ant for a Golden Rune [10] and a Rune Arc.
Drop onto the stone beam below the cliff at the end to reach a Smithing Stone [4].
On a ledge below the stone beam is a corpse with a Celestial Dew.
Drop to the bottom and loot the Smithing Stone [1], Golden Rune [2], and Golden Rune [3] on dry ground.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]

steps.instruction: Pick up the Golden Rune [1] and Ghost Glovewort [1] in the water.
Follow the water up some rocks and through a narrow tunnel, then pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x3 on the left-side edge.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [1] in the water.
Climb the slanted pillars, then turn around to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x2 at the top of a stone beam.
Make your way toward the Withered Astel and kill it so that you can freely explore the rest of the area.
Drop down the ledge below the south corner of the edge and enter the large building to grab the Map: Ainsel River.
Talk to the Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River) in the building.
From the building, follow the south wall to a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x3.
Just past the nearby pillar lies a Golden Rune [2].
Loot the Golden Rune [3], Magic Grease x2, Throwing Dagger x6, and Furlcalling Finger Remedy on the stairs by the river.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [3]; Magic Grease x2; Throwing Dagger x6; Furlcalling Finger Remedy

steps.instruction: Behind a broken wall next to the stairs is a corpse with Shield Grease.
Pick up a Golden Rune [3] from the north stairs that goes back to the merchant.
Loot the Ghost Glovewort [2] and Golden Rune [3] near the waterfall.
Follow the river downstream to a Ghost Glovewort [1], then grab the Ainsel River Downstream grace on the ledge next to it.
Continue to a room with ants and pick up Smithing Stone [2] x3, Immunizing Horn Charm, Formic Rock, and Crystal Dart x5 from the left side of the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [2] x3; Immunizing Horn Charm; Formic Rock; Crystal Dart x5

steps.instruction: Go through the southwest tunnel to find a corpse with Somber Smithing Stone [3] overlooking the lake of rot.
Pick up Soap x4 from an alcove on the left side when heading back.
Return to the ant room to pick up the remaining Ghost Glovewort [1] and Ghost Glovewort [2].
Continue downstream, then turn left to pick up Melted Mushroom x3.
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [2] before the tunnel that leads to the boss.
Kill the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella for Frozen Lightning Spear and 12,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella; Frozen Lightning Spear

steps.instruction: Open the chest underneath the massive throne to obtain a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Activate the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella grace on dry ground near the waterfall.
Starting from Siofra River Well Depths, pick up the Golden Rune [3] in front of a pillar in the water.
At the southeast end of the water, you'll find a Ghost Glovewort [1] and a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Go northeast from the end of the water to pick up Silver Firefly x5 behind a tree on the right.
Head back to pick up a Golden Rune [2] in the water near a structure.
Follow the water until you reach a Ghost Glovewort [1] at the base of a tall tree.
Pick up the Golden Rune [4] and Smithing Stone [4] next to the water, then the Soap x3 below the waterfall.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [4]; Smithing Stone [4]; Soap x3

steps.instruction: Grab the Golden Rune [4] hanging on the railing of a staircase.
In the upper area, south-southwest of the staircase and hanging off the top edge of a structure, you'll find a corpse with Budding Horn x3.
Walk across the top of the structure to reach a ledge with Throwing Dagger x8.
Descend the hole near the ledge, then jump onto the broken half of a statue for Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x3 and a scarab that drops Oracle Bubbles.
steps.linkedRaw: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x3; Oracle Bubbles

steps.instruction: Go up the left set of stairs for a Smithing Stone [4] on a ledge.
Loot the 2x Golden Rune [2], Smithing Stone [2], Immunizing Cured Meat, and Rainbow Stone x5 around the stairs opposite the ledge.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [2]; Smithing Stone [2]; Immunizing Cured Meat; Rainbow Stone x5

steps.instruction: Use the lift past the staircase from earlier, then go left across a bridge to find a room with Preserving Boluses.
Below the bridge is a corpse with Beast Liver x3.
Head upstream and pick up Crab Eggs x3 from a corpse on the left, next to a Giant Crab.
Continue upstream toward a massive pillar. Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [1] next to it, then climb the bottom of the pillar for a Golden Rune [3].
Grab the Siofra River Bank grace near a pillar, then light the brazier just east of the grace (1/8).
East-southeast of the brazier, you can find a Ghost Glovewort [2] and the Map: Siofra River.
Go up the slope next to the map to find a corpse with Old Fang x2 on the edge overlooking the site of grace.
At the end of the slope lies a campsite with Arteria Leaf x3 and the Inverted Hawk Heater Shield.
steps.linkedRaw: Arteria Leaf x3; Inverted Hawk Heater Shield

steps.instruction: Up on the ledge west of the grace lies a campsite with Armorer's Cookbook [6].
From the campsite, turn back and follow the wall on the left until you reach a second brazier to light (2/8).
On a boulder near the second brazier is a corpse with Lump of Flesh x3.
From the boulder, head southeast to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [2] from a small island in the water.
Ignore the sending gate and head north toward a ledge with a Golden Rune [4].
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [2] next to the second massive pillar southeast of the ledge.
Loot the Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot in the water east of the pillar, then the Ghost Glovewort [1] next to the path that leads into the woods.
Light the brazier on the nearby island in the water (3/8).
Climb the wooden scaffolding past the brazier to reach a corpse with Sliver of Meat.
Drop to the wooden platform below, then make a left turn up two sets of stairs to grab a Golden Rune [3].
Follow the wooden platform into the cliffside, then drop down at the end to find the Abandoned Merchant. Buy the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17], as it's needed for Alexander's questline.
Grab the Hefty Beast Bone near the merchant, then drop down to pick up a Smithing Stone [4] from the middle of the room.
Exit the building while following the wall on the right until you see a corpse with Furlcalling Finger Remedy in the water.
Loot the 2x Golden Rune [4] in the water, among several Land Octopuses.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [2] and Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot x2 near a waterfall.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghost Glovewort [2]; Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot x2

steps.instruction: Enter the top of a hut southeast of the waterfall to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x2 inside.
From the hut, head north to light another brazier (4/8).
Next to a massive pillar south-southeast of the brazier, you can find a Ghost Glovewort [2].
Grab the Worshippers' Woods grace in the structure northeast of the pillar.
Light the brazier guarded by two lightning orbs just south of the grace (5/8).
Loot the Dwelling Arrow x10 and Dappled Cured Meat at the bottom of a fallen pillar south of the brazier and on the right.
steps.linkedRaw: Dwelling Arrow x10; Dappled Cured Meat

steps.instruction: Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [2] on top of the bricks up the pillar, then use the sending gate.
After arriving, go southwest to find a corpse with Slumbering Egg x2 at the cliff edge.
Enter the building near the corpse for a Somber Smithing Stone [5] and a scarab that drops Great Oracular Bubble.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [5]; Great Oracular Bubble

steps.instruction: In the area behind the building, on top of a rock, is a corpse with a Golden Rune [7].
Go through the narrow passage at the south end to reach a corpse with Dragonwound Grease x3.
Return to the building, then head northwest to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] in the left corner of the water.
Kill the Dragonkin Soldier in the water for Dragon Halberd and 16,000 runes.
Pick up Marika's Scarseal from the corpse below the waterfall.
South of the waterfall is a smaller waterfall with a Golden Rune [7] at its base.
Next to a tree northeast of the second waterfall is a Ghost Glovewort [4].
Drop down the north ledge, then cross the flying buttress between two pillars to find a Stonesword Key behind the second pillar.
Go back across and pick up the Golden Seed at the cliff.
From the golden tree, head north-northwest along a ledge to reach a campsite with a Rune Arc.
Go back and cross the rock bridge to light the brazier immediately on the right (6/8).
Head northeast from the brazier to find a Golden Rune [4] on a ledge.
Farther north you'll discover the Below the Well grace.
Just north-northeast of the grace lies a campsite with a Ghost Glovewort [3].
Grab the Clarifying Horn Charm on the stairs, but ignore the lift at the top; you'll need the Stonesword Keys for later.
From the grace, head southeast to find a corpse with Sliver of Meat x3 near the edge.
Follow the cliff edge southwest to light the seventh brazier (7/8).
Continue down the path until you reach an open field. Kill the scarab near the waterfall to obtain Ash of War: Square Off.
Loot the Golden Rune [4] and Smithing Stone [2] x3 in the small woods past the field.
Travel to Worshipper's Woods and head south-southeast toward a ruined structure with a Smithing Stone [3] on top.
In the woods southwest of the structure lies a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x3.
Light the final brazier at the nearby cliff (8/8).
From the brazier, go west to find a Golden Rune [3] behind a tree.
On the path north of the tree, loot the Shield Grease and Golden Rune [2], which is behind a tree next to the path.
Head south-southwest from the tree to find Blaidd next to a pillar. Talk to him to unlock dialogue with Seluvis later.
Use the spiritspring behind Blaidd to reach a Ghost Glovewort [3] on the bridge far above.
Jump across the gap to find a Stonesword Key at the end of the bridge.
Descend the gap to a lower part of the bridge, where you'll find Dwelling Arrow x10.
Return to Blaidd, then head west toward a Golden Rune [4] in front of a large tree.
Under the staircase southwest of the tree, you can find a corpse with Horn Bow.
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] on a lower ledge opposite the corpse.
Go up the stairs and touch the horned remains. Kill the Ancestor Spirit for Ancestral Follower Ashes and 13,000 runes.
Travel to The Four Belfries and unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked by the message "Night Sky Unceasing":
Descend the rocks to a bridge, then pick up the Ghost Glovewort [2] and Mottled Necklace on the bridge.
From Lenne's Rise, head downhill until you reach the Dragonbarrow Fork grace next to a tree.

Follow the right-side cliff edge past a pond with two dragons and toward the divine tower, where you'll find some chairs with Rune Arc, Somber Smithing Stone [9], Dragonwound Grease, and Arteria Leaf x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Rune Arc; Somber Smithing Stone [9]; Dragonwound Grease; Arteria Leaf x2

steps.instruction: Turn back and loot the Sliver of Meat x3, Gravel Stone, and Golden Rune [5] in the pond.
steps.linkedRaw: Sliver of Meat x3; Gravel Stone; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Pick up Map: Dragonbarrow from a stele next to the marked road past the pond.
Follow the road west to discover the Dragonbarrow West grace behind an arched root.
Head toward the road just northeast of the grace and follow it to the top, where you'll find a shack with the Isolated Merchant's Shack grace.
Buy a Beast-Repellent Torch from the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) to keep the Giant Dogs at bay when held in either arm.
Below a ledge west-northwest of the shack is a scarab that drops Ash of War: Sky Shot.
Return to Dragonbarrow West and head southwest across a gap to find a cemetery on the left with Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [6].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [6]

steps.instruction: Between the two mushroom-covered rocks west-southwest of the cemetery is a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
Guarded by a Giant Crow at the top of the largest rock is a corpse with Sacramental Bud.
In the cliff edge southeast of the rocks, you'll find a root that leads to Abandoned Cave:
Head inside and grab the Abandoned Cave grace.
Drop into the rot and backstep toward an Abductor Virgin. Just east of it is a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Continue to a ledge and jump toward the ground below to pick up Serpent Bow.
Pick up Fire Grease from an alcove in the tunnel.
Climb the heap of Abductor Virgins in the large room to reach the Venomous Fang.
Kill the two Cleanrot Knights for Gold Scarab and 7,000 runes.
Travel to Rotview Balcony and head north-northeast toward the cliff edge. Drop down below the dead tree to find a Rune Arc on one of the roots.
Kill the Putrid Avatar below for Greenburst Crystal Tear, Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear, and 9,600 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Putrid Avatar; Greenburst Crystal Tear; Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear

steps.instruction: Pick up a Cracked Pot from a root extending past the cliff edge near the Minor Erdtree.
On the opposite side of the Erdtree lies the entrance to Minor Erdtree Catacombs:
Enter it and grab the Minor Erdtree Catacombs grace.
Ride the lift down and take the west path to a room with a Grave Glovewort [3].
Pull the boss lever in the next room, then return to the lift to pick up a Grave Glovewort [4].
Send the lift up to reveal a room below it. Drop down to pick up Ghost Glovewort [4] and Grave Violet x3 from a corridor blanketed with rot.
Go up the stairs in the corridor to discover a room with a Grave Glovewort [4] and a Golden Rune [4].
Climb the ladder to a room with Imp Head (Wolf), picking up a Grave Glovewort [3] on the way.
Pick up Sacramental Bud x2 and a Grave Glovewort [5] from the ledge at the end.
Loot the Grave Glovewort [3], Aeonian Butterfly, and Grave Glovewort [5] in the room below.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [3]; Aeonian Butterfly; Grave Glovewort [5]

steps.instruction: Drop down below the lift again and kill the two Erdtree Burial Watchdogs for Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes and 7,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Burial Watchdogs; Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes

steps.instruction: Travel to Rotview Balcony and follow the nearby road to a scarab that drops Whirl, O Flame!.
Open the chest in the back of a carriage to obtain the Greatsword.
Grab Explosive Bolt x6 and a Rune Arc from the nearby camp.
On the cliff northwest of the camp, you'll find a chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Return to the road and follow it toward the ruins to find the Caelem Ruins grace on the left:
In the back of the rightmost building is a corpse with Drawstring Fire Grease x3.
Pick up Smoldering Butterfly x3 from the second building on the left side of the ruins.
Go down the cellar in the third left-side building and kill the two Mad Pumpkin Heads for 6,300 runes.
Open the chest in the cellar to obtain the Visage Shield.
Near the cellar entrance, next to a fire, you can find a corpse with Great Dragonfly Head x3.
Follow the road in the middle of the ruins to the Smoldering Wall grace past the smoldering fence.
Climb the mushroom-covered rock west-northwest of the grace for a Golden Rune [9] in front of a Giant Crow.
On top of the mushroom-covered rock farther west is a Smithing Stone [5].
Northwest of the second mushroom-covered rock lies Forsaken Ruins:
Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] in the middle of the ruins.
In a window northeast of the middle corpse is a Golden Rune [5].
Unlock the imp seal and loot the Sword of St. Trina from the chest in the cellar.
Hanging onto the back of an arched root south of the ruins is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
From the root, go southwest and follow the banners up a slope to find the entrance to Gael Tunnel:
Drop down the far-left side to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Activate the Gael Tunnel grace at the bottom.
Go down a set of stairs for a Golden Rune [5] on a wooden platform.
Loot the 3x Smithing Stone [4] and Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot around the room with the wooden platform.
Head through the northeast tunnel and grab the 2x Smithing Stone [4], Somber Smithing Stone [4], and Cross-Naginata in the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [4]; Somber Smithing Stone [4]; Cross-Naginata

steps.instruction: Go down the other path for Large Glintstone Scrap x5, Grace Mimic x5, and a Smithing Stone [4] on the wall.
steps.linkedRaw: Large Glintstone Scrap x5; Grace Mimic x5; Smithing Stone [4]

steps.instruction: Continue to the boss and pick up the Smithing Stone [4] on the left wall.
Open the shortcut door and talk to Alexander if you didn't earlier. Behind him is a Smithing Stone [4] you might've grabbed already.
Kill the Magma Wyrm for Dragon Heart, Moonveil, and 7,500 runes.
Follow the slope outside the entrance downhill to an invisible scarab that drops Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes

links.label: Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes

steps.instruction: Grab the Fort Gael North grace below a ledge in the area with the scarab.
When approaching the fort, pick up Explosive Greatbolt x5 from a camp on the right side.
At the fort entrance, follow the branches around the corner to a ladder that leads inside Fort Gael:
After entering, pick up Warming Stone x2 from a wooden beam.
Go up the stairs and open the chest under a tent to obtain Starscourge Heirloom.
Hit the railing at the top of the staircase, then jump to the wooden platform below to grab the gate lever and a corpse with Mushroom x10 down the outer platform.
Drop down to the ledge inside the fort to reach a room with the Katar.
Kill the Elder Lion at the bottom for Ash of War: Lion's Claw, then grab the Rune Arc by the entrance.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Lion's Claw; Rune Arc

steps.instruction: In the area behind the fort, you'll find Flame, Grant Me Strength and Smoldering Butterfly x6 (by the fire).
steps.linkedRaw: Flame, Grant Me Strength; Smoldering Butterfly x6

steps.instruction: From the fire, head north-northeast down a root in the cliff, then go straight northeast down a slope to find a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Travel to Smoldering Wall and head southwest toward a campsite with Slumbering Egg x2.
Follow the road past the grace until you see a scarab on the left and kill it for Ash of War: Lifesteal Fist.
Grab the Astray from Caelid Highway North grace on the hillside with the scarab, near a sword monument.
East of the grace, you'll find the Nomadic Merchant (North Caelid).
From the grace, head west into the rot swamp to discover the entrance to Gaol Cave:
Unlock the imp seal, then grab the Gaol Cave grace and open the chest for a Rune Arc.
Pick up a Golden Rune [2] from the first room.
Continue until the floor collapses, then proceed the only way forward until you find a Golden Rune [4] and Turtle Neck Meat x2 guarded by rats.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [4]; Turtle Neck Meat x2

steps.instruction: In the guard room at the end, you'll find a Golden Rune [5], Somber Smithing Stone [5], shortcut door, and a lever that unlocks all jail cells.
After unlocking all cells, loot the Old Fang x5 and Pillory Shield from a cell next to the shortcut door.
Enter the northeast room and pick up a Golden Rune [2] from the northwest cell.
Drop down the southwest ledge, then grab the Golden Rune [2] in a cell immediately on the right.
Loot the Wakizashi, Stonesword Key, and Golden Rune [4] from a cell on the left.
Enter one of the open cells in the room downhill to pick up a Rainbow Stone and Golden Rune [4].
Hit the planks in the room, drop to the bottom, and kill the Frenzied Duelist for Putrid Corpse Ashes and 6,700 runes.
Go through the tunnel past the boss to pick up the Regalia of Eochaid, then turn south for Glowstone x3.
Travel to Astray from Caelid Highway North and head southwest toward Caelid Waypoint Ruins:
Pick up Great Dragonfly Head x5 from a corpse guarded by dogs in one of the ruined buildings.
Next to the dead tree in the middle is a corpse with Rot Grease x3.
At the end of the cliff, south of the tree, sits a corpse with Poisonbloom x4.
Enter the cellar in the lower part of the ruins to grab the Meteoric Ore Blade.
Return to the road and follow it until you notice the Caelid Highway South grace behind a root on the right.
An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the cliff west-southwest of the grace.
Follow the cliff south-southeast toward a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [5].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Kill the enemy with a feathered hat and he'll turn into a Troll Knight that drops a Larval Tear.
Return to the road and kill Decaying Ekzykes by the roadside for Dragon Heart and 38,000 runes.
Enter the church behind the dragon and pick up the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [3] near the altar.
Examine the altar and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Activate the Cathedral of Dragon Communion grace inside the church, then pass time until nightfall.
Kill the Night's Cavalry patrolling the road for Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight and 8,500 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight

links.label: Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight

steps.instruction: Travel to the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank and kill the Death Rite Bird east-southeast of the grace for Death's Poker and 15,000 runes.
Return to the grace and head south toward a Giant Crow. In the area below it is a basin with the Windy Crystal Tear.
From the basin, head south to find Fan Daggers x6 next to a wagon on the road.
Head east-northeast from the wagon to find an Elder Lion on the left; kill it for a Somber Smithing Stone [4], Beast Blood, and Old Fang x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [4]; Beast Blood; Old Fang x2

steps.instruction: Loot the two corpses around the lion for Beast Blood x2 and Beast Blood x3.
steps.linkedRaw: Beast Blood x2; Beast Blood x3

steps.instruction: Return to the road and follow it downhill to a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x3 in the middle of a battlefield.
Pick up the Mushroom x6 in a tent past the smoldering fence, then grab the Impassable Greatbridge grace behind a wooden tower.
Climb the wooden tower to discover a chest with the Arrow's Sting Talisman.
Behind a ledge west of the wooden tower, near a sword monument, you'll find a scarab that drops Ash of War: Cragblade.
Follow the path along the cliff until you reach a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [4], but kill it fast to avoid the Giant Crow ambush.
In the cliffside past the scarab lies the entrance to Caelid Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Caelid Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [4] in the first corridor, then a Grave Glovewort [3] in the corner past it.
Hit the illusory wall below the stairs in the next room to reveal 2x Grave Glovewort [5] and the Miranda Sprout Ashes.
Loot the Grave Glovewort [3], Ghost Glovewort [3], and Ghost Glovewort [4] in the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [3]; Ghost Glovewort [3]; Ghost Glovewort [4]

steps.instruction: Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [4] in the final room, and hit the illusory wall behind the pillar in the middle to reveal the boss lever.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Kindred of Rot Ashes and 6,800 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Cemetery Shade; Kindred of Rot Ashes

steps.instruction: Travel to Inner Aeonia and head southwest past an island with a root to be invaded by Millicent. Defeat her to obtain Sacramental Bud x5, Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [5], and a Golden Rune [10].
steps.linkedRaw: Millicent; Sacramental Bud x5; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [5]; Golden Rune [10]

steps.instruction: Return to the grace and kill Commander O'Neil south-southeast of the grace for Commander's Standard, Unalloyed Gold Needle, and 12,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Commander O'Neil; Commander's Standard; Unalloyed Gold Needle

steps.instruction: Polyanna's summon sign can be found at the entrance near the grace.
Make sure to grab the Heart of Aeonia grace once the boss is dead.
Travel to Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank and follow the road to a Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [5], and a corpse with Glass Shard x5 farther ahead.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [5]; Glass Shard x5

steps.instruction: Talk to Gowry in the shack past the gate. Hear his request, then talk to him to receive Sellia's Secret. Reload the area to get the Unalloyed Gold Needle back.
Follow the road near Gowry's shack until you see a red painting beneath a balcony on the right. Examine it to receive the "Redmane" Painting.
Jump over the railing west of the painting to find Poisonbloom x5 on a rooftop below.
Head around the outskirts of the town to discover the Sellia Under-Stair grace by a staircase.
In a ruined building north-northwest of the grace is a corpse with Rotten Stray Ashes.
Travel to Sellia Crystal Tunnel and go up the ladder:
Loot a Golden Rune [5] in the hut straight ahead, then the 3x Smithing Stone [5] around it.
On top of the hut is a corpse with Glintstone Scrap x6.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [5] and Rune Arc at the top of the room.
Jump onto the middle hut, then across to a wooden beam with Cuckoo Glintstone x5.
Grab a Smithing Stone [5] from the area below the wooden beam, then climb the ladder ahead for a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Cross the planks to an area with 2x Smithing Stone [5] and a chest containing Rock Blaster.
