Climb the ladder next to the hut for a Golden Rune [4] and kick down the shortcut ladder next to the corpse.
On a wall near the ladder is a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Continue to a corpse with a Dragonwound Grease, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [4] in the room left of it.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [5] and Faithful's Canvas Talisman on the wooden platform.
Kill the Fallingstar Beast for Somber Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [7] x5, Gravity Stone Chunk x10, Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1], and 7,600 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Fallingstar Beast; Somber Smithing Stone [6]; Smithing Stone [7] x5; Gravity Stone Chunk x10; Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]

steps.instruction: Travel to Sellia Under-Stair, go up the stairs, then turn left toward a large staircase. Jump to the root halfway up and pick up Cerulean Tear Scarab from the nearest rooftop.
Climb the tower farther south and light the brazier at the top (1/3).
On a lower rooftop northwest of the brazier is a corpse with Toxic Mushroom x5.
Pick up a Stonesword Key on top of an archway between two rooftops.
Light the brazier at the top of the tower near the archway (2/3).
Kill the teleporting scarab north of the tower to obtain Ash of War: Double Slash.
Return to the large staircase and pick up the Golden Seed at the top.
Climb the tower near the golden tree and light the final brazier to unlock all sealed barriers (3/3).
Pick up the Staff of Loss from a balcony near the tower, then open the chest below it for the Spelldrake Talisman +1.
At the top of the stairs near the grace, you'll find a chest with Night Comet.
Just east of the stairs is another staircase with Poison Grease x2 at the top.
Destroy the wagon left of the staircase to uncover a path to a chest with an Imbued Sword Key in the back of the town.
Return to the large staircase, head northwest toward a tall doorway, and kill the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk for Nox Flowing Sword and 6,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk; Nox Flowing Sword

steps.instruction: Activate the Chair-Crypt of Sellia grace after the fight, and loot the chest in the back for Lusat's Glintstone Staff.
steps.linkedRaw: Chair-Crypt of Sellia; Lusat's Glintstone Staff

steps.instruction: Go through the doorway at the top of the large staircase to discover the Sellia Backstreets grace.
Head up the slope until you reach a church. Grab the Church of the Plague grace and the Sacred Tear in front of the statue.
steps.linkedRaw: Church of the Plague; Sacred Tear

steps.instruction: Talk to Millicent and give her the repaired needle. Reload the area, then talk to her to receive the Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom.
Note: She won't invade anymore after you give her the needle, so make sure you've dealt with her invasion first.
Exit the church and head down the west slope while tightly hugging the wall on the left until you reach the edge. On a ledge below is a corpse with Drawstring Poison Grease x3.
Return to the path and kill the five Operatic Bats around the area for 5x Golden Rune [9] (first time).
Pick up a Golden Rune [5] from the fallen pillar.
Follow the path toward the top of a large gate and pick up the Black-Key Bolt x20 and Golden Rune [4] on it.
Head toward the lookout tower past the gate and pick up Eternal Darkness from the cell inside, guarded by a Bloodhound Knight.
Return to Church of the Plague and head east-northeast toward an astrolabe with Starlight Shards by the cliff.
Use the spiritspring north of the church while facing west, and loot the 2x Smithing Stone [7], Stonesword Key, and Smithing Stone [8] on top of the large rock.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [7]; Stonesword Key; Smithing Stone [8]

steps.instruction: Head toward the fort east of the rock and grab the Fort Faroth grace behind the smoldering wall.
Kill the Operatic Bat on a lower ledge behind the fort for a Golden Rune [9] (first time).
Return to the grace and enter Fort Faroth:
Kill the three Operatic Bats for 3x Golden Rune [9] (first time), or simply run past them and head straight for the ladder.
Climb the ladder and open the chest at the top to obtain Dectus Medallion (Right).
Drop to the rooftop below, then turn right to find a corpse with Neutralizing Boluses x2 behind some breakable crates.
Descend the ladder in the hole at the opposite end of the rooftop for a Golden Rune [12].
Jump to the nearby upper ledge and descend the ladder at the end to a corpse with Radagon's Soreseal.
Return to the grace and kill Elder Dragon Greyoll by slaying five of the seven juveniles at half HP around her. Once she dies, you'll receive Dragon Heart x5 and 74,290 runes.
Note: Hit Greyoll's left hind leg with a weapon that inflicts blood loss for an easier, but lengthier fight.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, climb the mountain near Greyoll to find the Reed Great Katana up top.
Head along the cliff edge west of Fort Faroth until you encounter a sleeping dragon. Bait it into attacking the statue just north of it to obtain Smithing Stone [5] x3.
Continue along the cliff edge where you left off to discover Sellia Evergaol, and kill Battlemage Hugues for Battlemage Hugues and 7,800 runes.
Buy Greyoll's Roar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion, since it is required for all achievements.
Return to Gowry's Shack to talk to Millicent.
Reload the area and tell Gowry that Millicent paid a visit.
Travel to Impassable Greatbridge and head toward the wooden tower past the bridge. Behind it is a Smithing Stone [3].
Go up the slope to the castle, then drop onto the wooden tower for a Smithing Stone [6] on a ledge down a ladder.
From the top of the tower, jump to a lower ledge and follow the cliff to a graveyard with a scarab that drops Ash of War: Flaming Strike.
Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x8 next to some gravestones, and optionally kill the Operatic Bat for a Golden Rune [9] (first time).
Climb the ladder in the graveyard to enter the castle. Follow the rampart to another ladder and enter the room below to open a shortcut back to the graveyard.
Loot the Smithing Stone [5] and Armorer's Cookbook [5] in the room with the shortcut.
Kill the two Elder Lions in the courtyard for 2x Somber Smithing Stone [4], 2x Beast Blood, and 2x Old Fang x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [4]; Beast Blood; Old Fang x2

steps.instruction: Enter the room in the courtyard to pick up Armorer's Cookbook [4] behind a barrel.
Loot the Smithing Stone [4] from the pile of corpses in the courtyard, then the Golden Rune [6] in a wooden structure.
At the top of the stairs past some spiked barricades, turn right for a room with a ladder that leads to the Flamberge and a Smithing Stone [3].
Climb a second ladder to find a Smithing Stone [5] at the top of a tower.
Head back and grab the Chamber Outside the Plaza grace in a room on the right past the barricades and flamespitters.
Go up the staircase west of the flamespitters to find a Smithing Stone [4].
Enter the room near a dead tree to pick up the Red-Hot Whetblade.
Go up the stairs in the room and follow the rampart to a chest with a Smithing Stone [6].
Return to the grace and kill the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight for Ruins Greatsword and 16,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight; Ruins Greatsword

steps.instruction: Grab the Redmane Castle Plaza grace after the fight.
Go up the stairs and pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] to the left of a large astrolabe.
You'll now have three ways to initialize the Radahn festival:
Speak with Jerren and Iji:
Talk to Jerren in the throne room; your answer doesn't matter. Then speak to him about Iji.
Talk to Iji about Jerren to initialize the Radahn festival.
Return to Blaidd and tell him Iji's story.
Consult Seluvis and Sellen:
Provided you spoke to Blaidd in Siofra River, ask Seluvis about Nokron to receive Seluvis's Introduction.
Talk to Sellen and show her the letter of introduction.
Return to Blaidd and tell him Sellen's story.
Simply activating a site of grace in Altus Plateau will also initialize the festival.
Travel to Redmane Castle Plaza and the festival should now have started:
Talk to Therolina to learn the Polite Bow gesture.
Talk to Blaidd and Alexander.
Talk to Jerren and answer "Ready as I'll ever be". Exhaust his dialogue after the cutscene to learn the Heartening Cry gesture.
Note: If missed, you can repeat the step by quickly traveling to Roundtable Hold and back.
Head through the throne room to find a Smithing Stone [6] next to an altar.
Take the lift down and kill Starscourge Radahn for Radahn's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Starscourge, and 70,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Starscourge Radahn; Radahn's Great Rune; Remembrance of the Starscourge

steps.instruction: This is your second of three chances to summon Great Horned Tragoth for the Casual Greeting gesture.
Talk to Blaidd on a dune and grab the Starscourge Radahn grace next to him.
Exhaust Alexander's dialogue near the grace.
Pick up Radahn's Spear x20 from three corpses scattered around the dunes west of the grace.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, head north from the grace until you get invaded by Knight Leontiel. Kill him for Leontiel's Greatsword and Leontiel's Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Knight Leontiel; Leontiel's Greatsword; Leontiel's Set

steps.instruction: Return to Jerren in the throne room and exhaust his dialogue.
Buy Radahn's Lion Armor from Enia (for a gesture later).
Let Fia hold you and select "May I ask a favor?" to receive the Weathered Dagger.
Give the dagger to D, Hunter of the Dead, then reload the area. Talk to Fia in a new room in the east wing and loot D's Bell Bearing and the Twinned Set from D's corpse.
Note: Do not sell any part of the armor, as the entire set is needed for a questline later.
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Caelid.
Speak to Iji about Jerren and select "Talk".
Talk to Blaidd in Forlorn Hound Evergoal. You can release him, but it won't change the outcome.
Return to Iji and ask why Blaidd is in the evergaol.
Descend the crater in Limgrave (marked on your map). Before you enter Nokron, pick up a Golden Rune [5] from a ledge, and Soporific Grease x2 below it.
Jump to a tower on the right to reach a rooftop with the Ghostflame Torch.
From the rooftop, drop down north to pick up Burred Bolt x10.
Head right around the corner and up two roofs to find a Rune Arc.
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] in front of the fallen tower, then the Nascent Butterfly x3 at the opposite end.
Continue to find a corpse with Furlcalling Finger Remedy on a ledge, then grab the Smithing Stone [5] in a corner behind it.
Loot the Golden Rune [6], Clarifying White Cured Meat, and Ghost Glovewort [3] in the room below.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [6]; Clarifying White Cured Meat; Ghost Glovewort [3]

steps.instruction: Grab the Nokron, Eternal City grace just past the room.
Pick up Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1] from the gazebo in the courtyard.
Between the buildings northeast of the gazebo, you'll find a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
In the garden southeast of the gazebo, pick up 2x Ghost Glovewort [3], Greatshield Soldier Ashes, and a Smithing Stone [5].
steps.linkedRaw: Ghost Glovewort [3]; Greatshield Soldier Ashes; Smithing Stone [5]

steps.instruction: Pick up a Larval Tear from the open building nearby.
In the area southwest of the building, you can find a Ghost Glovewort [3] and a Ghost Glovewort [4]
Follow the trail of fireflies along the cliff to a Smithing Stone [3] at the opposite end.
Go through the archway in the courtyard and down some stairs to find a Golden Rune [7].
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [3] and Golden Rune [7] near the cliff edge, then grab a Larval Tear from the gazebo.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghost Glovewort [3]; Golden Rune [7]; Larval Tear

steps.instruction: Before taking on the boss, turn around to find a Rune Arc against the rocky ledge.
Kill the Mimic Tear for Larval Tear x2, Silver Tear Mask, and 10,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Mimic Tear; Larval Tear x2; Silver Tear Mask

steps.instruction: Activate the Mimic Tear grace after defeating the boss.
Kill the scarab on the bridge to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
On the left side of the bridge, near the scarab, is a Golden Rune [4].
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [3] in the archway on the bridge, then grab the Dwelling Arrow x8 behind a brazier southeast of it.
Go down the collapsed part of the bridge to pick up a Nascent Butterfly next to two logs.
Light the brazier by the road (1/6).
Follow the road northwest to pick up Gold-Tinged Excrement x5, Ghost Glovewort [4], Golden Rune [4], and Fireproof Dried Liver near a shaman.
steps.linkedRaw: Gold-Tinged Excrement x5; Ghost Glovewort [4]; Golden Rune [4]; Fireproof Dried Liver

steps.instruction: Light the brazier behind the shaman (2/6).
Go up the slope southwest of the brazier to discover the Ancestral Woods grace.
Jump to the roof below the cliff and make your way down to a corpse with Rejuvenating Boluses on a ledge.
On top of the nearby staircase, you can find a Rune Arc.
Jump to the ledge northwest of the staircase and go around the building to reach a Celestial Dew.
Return to the staircase and jump across the lower roof for a Golden Rune [7] on the other side.
Cross the broken remains of a bridge and drop through a window opening. Grab the Black Whetblade next to an altar.
Unlock the imp seal in the narrow passage near the altar, and loot the Mimic Tear Ashes and Smithing Stone [3] in the room.
Jump through an open window in the passage, then continue through another opening to reach the Nox Flowing Hammer.
Kill the boulder below to obtain a Larval Tear (first time).
Exit the building and grab the Night's Sacred Ground grace at the cliff.
Loot the Celestial Dew, Golden Rune [7], and Soft Cotton x3 guarded by several Silver Tears past the grace.
steps.linkedRaw: Celestial Dew; Golden Rune [7]; Soft Cotton x3

steps.instruction: Open the chest underneath the massive throne to obtain the Fingerslayer Blade and a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Return to Ancestral Woods and hug the left wall until you reach a Somber Smithing Stone [5] in a puddle.
Head up the hill with the wolves to pick up Smithing Stone [4] and Beast Blood x4 from three corpses near a tall spire.
Light the brazier behind the spire (3/6).
Kill the scarab north-northeast of the spire for Ash of War: Enchanted Shot, then light the nearby brazier (4/6).
Jump to the enclosed structure in the water below the cliff. Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [5] and Golden Rune [12] from the ground inside.
Climb the wall of the structure to reach the second half. Loot the chest guarded by a shaman to obtain Ancestral Infant's Head.
Return to Ancestral Woods and head north-northeast to a small ritual grounds. Pick up Old Fang x4 from a corpse next to the staircase.
Grab the Ghost Glovewort [4] in front of the shaman, then kill her for a Shining Horned Headband (first time).
Light the brazier behind the deer-like carcass (5/6).
From the brazier, head east toward the Hallowhorn Grounds and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [4] from the edge.
Next to a pillar down the stairs that lead to the Hallowhorn Grounds, you'll find a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x5.
East of the staircase lies a campsite with Kukri x8.
From the campsite, follow the cliff edge to the final brazier and light it (6/6).
Next to the spire west-southwest of the brazier is a Smithing Stone [5].
Drop onto the undersection of the bridge near the brazier. At the southwest end is another Smithing Stone [5].
Head toward the northeast end of the bridge's undersection, then descend the structure below to find a Smithing Stone [2], Celestial Dew, and Clarifying Horn Charm +1.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [2]; Celestial Dew; Clarifying Horn Charm +1

steps.instruction: Exit the room and continue along the bridge to grab a Smithing Stone [5] between the pillars at the end.
Touch the horned remains in the Hallowhorn Grounds and kill the Regal Ancestor Spirit for Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor and 24,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Regal Ancestor Spirit; Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor

steps.instruction: Return to the fifth brazier (at the small ritual grounds). Just north of it is a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
East of the corpse, walk across the stone beams at the top of the Hallowhorn Grounds to reach the Mottled Necklace +1.
Head toward the jellyfish north of the stone beams and pick up the Old Fang next to them.
On a ledge below the cliff near the jellyfish, you'll find a Stonesword Key.
Head down the ledge to grab Silver Tear Husk x2 and the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace.
steps.linkedRaw: Silver Tear Husk x2; Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs

steps.instruction: At the end of the cliff, drop onto the aqueduct and kill the Crucible Knight to receive the Crucible Hornshield.
Cross the west-southwest bridge to grab the Missionary's Cookbook [5].
Take the other path toward the aqueduct channel. Enter the opposite room and kill the scarab down the stairs to obtain Order Healing.
Loot the Golden Rune [7] on the outer ledge, then the Golden Rune [13] on the broken bridge.
Kill the Crucible Tree Knight in the aqueduct channel for a Somber Smithing Stone [6], then grab the Smithing Stone [5] next to him.
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] in front of the waterfall farther in, then the Smithing Stone [4] in the room below it.
Enter the west room to pick up a Rune Arc.
Talk to D, Beholder of Death and give him the Twinned Set to learn the Inner Order gesture; you can still get it even if you don't have the set.
steps.linkedRaw: D, Beholder of Death; Inner Order

steps.instruction: Kill the Valiant Gargoyles for Gargoyle's Greatsword, Gargoyle's Twinblade, and 30,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Valiant Gargoyles; Gargoyle's Greatsword; Gargoyle's Twinblade

steps.instruction: D, Beholder of Death's summon sign can be found at the top of the stairs if you gave him the Twinned Set.
Activate the Great Waterfall Basin grace on dry ground near the waterfall.

Travel to the Artist's Shack in Liurnia and follow the southeast cliff edge until you see Alexander. Throw an Oil Pot at him and help him out to receive the Triumphant Delight gesture (if not obtained). Talk to him afterward to receive Exalted Flesh x3.
Descend the gravestones in the cliff near Alexander. Once you reach the lowest gravestone, jump to a roof to pick up Smithing Stone [3] x3.
Drop down and grab the Jarburg grace next to a house.
South of the grace lies a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], 2x Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [3], and a Golden Rune [6].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [6]

steps.instruction: Talk to Jar-Bairn on the porch of a house in Jarburg multiple times:
Note: Don't attack any of the Living Jars in the village; it will anger him and cause him to disappear.
Talk to him and answer that you'll be the new Potentate.
Reload the area and talk to him about picking flowers in the village.
Reload the area and exhaust his dialogue about Alexander (after meeting Alexander).
Reload the area and talk to him about poachers (after speaking to Diallos in Roundtable Hold the second time).
Loot the 3x Cracked Pot, 2x Ritual Pot (one is on a rooftop), and Living Jar Shard in the village.
steps.linkedRaw: Cracked Pot; Ritual Pot; Living Jar Shard

steps.instruction: Travel to the Grand Lift of Dectus and hoist your medallion in front of the lift. After arriving, grab the Altus Plateau grace on a rocky ledge just north of the lift.
Talk to Melina at the Altus Plateau grace.
Talk to Rya at the Grand Lift of Dectus and accept her invitation to Volcano Manor.
Note: If she's not there, you'll find her in the lower Lux Ruins instead.
After arriving, grab the Volcano Manor grace for later. Ignore the manor for now to avoid canceling a step in Patches's questline.
Exit the manor and pick up Smoldering Butterfly x6 from the left-side cliff edge.
Kill the invisible scarab ahead to obtain Ash of War: Through and Through.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Through and Through
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Through and Through

links.label: Ash of War: Through and Through

steps.instruction: Pick up the Golden Seed near the scarab, then grab the Smoldering Butterfly x4 just east-southeast of the golden tree.
Head down the slope to find a Golden Rune [3] in the middle.
On the left side of the slope, on a ledge, you'll find a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Grab the Map: Mt. Gelmir from the stele below.
Activate the Road of Iniquity grace just past the map stele; you'll start from it later when exploring Mt. Gelmir.
Travel to Roundtable Hold and talk to Corhyn to trigger him to leave.
Talk to Roderika and select "There's something you should know".
Talk to Dung Eater in a newly opened room in the north wing.
Travel to the Altus Plateau grace, pass time until nightfall, and head east-southeast toward a camp. Pick up the Stonesword Key in front of a tent.
On a rocky ledge east-northeast of the camp, you'll find a Golden Rune [4].
Kill the Night's Cavalry patrolling the road for Ash of War: Shared Order and 10,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Shared Order

steps.instruction: Look for a moving cloud of dust on the road and hit it to obtain Ash of War: Earthshaker.
Grab the Altus Highway Junction grace on a ledge between the diverging paths.
Talk to Boc at the grace and select "I'm sorry...". Give him the golden needle, then select "I have a favor to ask" and "You may call me lord" to learn the My Lord gesture.
After giving Boc the needle and selecting "Surely she'd be happy for you?", talk to Melina at the Altus Highway Junction grace.
Pick up the Golden Seed north of the grace.
Follow the road uphill to find Corhyn next to a stele. Talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Grab the Map: Altus Plateau from the stele next to Corhyn.
Continue along the road until you reach a bridge. Under a tent just southeast of it, you can find a corpse with a Lump of Flesh.
On the bridge, you'll discover the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge grace and the Nomadic Merchant (Altus Plateau).
Return to Altus Highway Junction and pick up Old Fang x3 from the stone platform just east-northeast of the grace.
Go around the ledge east-northeast of the platform and up the left slope to find an Amber Starlight.
Give Seluvis the Amber Starlight, then talk to him to receive the Magic Scorpion Charm.
Exhaust Ranni's dialogue to receive the Carian Inverted Statue.

Note: Completing this step will end Seluvis's questline. If you plan to give Seluvis's Potion to Dung Eater (which requires Seluvis to be alive), do it now or skip ahead to the West Altus section until you complete the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
Reload the area, then activate the Ranni's Chamber grace in her room.
Loot Seluvis's Bell Bearing and the Preceptor's Set from Seluvis's puppet-like corpse.
Make your way down to Pida and loot Pidia's Bell Bearing and Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet from his corpse.
steps.linkedRaw: Pidia's Bell Bearing; Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet

steps.instruction: Note: If you gave Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli, he'll drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet instead.
Speak to Iji and select "Talk".
Travel to the Study Hall Entrance and ride the lift up to enter Carian Study Hall:
Head right first to pick up a Golden Rune [3].
Ascend the stairs and deal with Preceptor Miriam until she disappears.
Pick up the Carian Glintstone Staff from a shrine before the second lift.
Take the lift up and somehow kill Preceptor Miriam to obtain Magic Downpour.
Pick up a Golden Rune [4] from a corpse on the circular balcony.
Climb the ladder on the balcony and grab the Cerulean Seed Talisman from the top rafters.
Return to the Study Hall Entrance and examine the pedestal to turn the building upside down:
Re-enter the study hall and kill Preceptor Miriam again to obtain Lucidity.
Pick up the Mask of Confidence from a ledge near the underside arch of a bridge.
Descend the chandeliers below to reach the rafters, then loot Holyproof Dried Liver x2 and Glintstone Firefly x8 from the bottom rafters.
steps.linkedRaw: Holyproof Dried Liver x2; Glintstone Firefly x8

steps.instruction: Drop onto the lift in the middle and ride it to the bottom (er... top?), then go outside to discover the Liurnia Tower Bridge grace.
Kill the Godskin Noble on the bridge to obtain the Godskin Noble Set.
Enter the Divine Tower of Liurnia and ride the lift inside to grab the Divine Tower of Liurnia grace.
Loot the Cursemark of Death and Stargazer Heirloom from Ranni's corpse at the top.
Travel to Great Waterfall Basin grace and rest in the coffin below the waterfall. Grab the Great Waterfall Crest grace after arriving.
Kill the nearby Erdtree Avatar to obtain the Staff of the Avatar.
Grab the Ghost Glovewort [4] in front of a slope behind the avatar, then kill the scarab at the top for Ash of War: Golden Land.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghost Glovewort [4]; Ash of War: Golden Land

steps.instruction: Head toward the roots and climb onto the far-right one. Just above where it connects to the cliff, you'll find a Smithing Stone [6].
Follow the middle branch of the far-right root to a cave in the cliffside. Kill the large-bellied ant inside to receive a Numen's Rune and a Rune Arc.
Kill the four large-bellied ants below to receive 4x Numen's Rune and 4x Rune Arc.
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] in the cave, then pick up Elden Stars from a corpse on the outside ledge.
Climb the branch of the root below, then pick up Holy Grease x3 at the bottom of the root.
Follow the root to its base to find a Smithing Stone [4].
From the base of the root, head south to find a Golden Rune [5] on a root extending past the cliff.
Loot the Warming Stone x3, Smithing Stone [4], and Golden Rune [6] guarded by flying ants in the middle.
steps.linkedRaw: Warming Stone x3; Smithing Stone [4]; Golden Rune [6]

steps.instruction: Just past the three corpses, next to a small tree, is a Ghost Glovewort [4].
Continue westward to discover the Deeproot Depths grace by the cliff.
Follow the water to a Gargoyle. On the path in front of him lies a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Pick up Hefty Beast Bone x5 from a corpse behind the Gargoyle, and grab the Map: Deeproot Depths in the gazebo.
steps.linkedRaw: Hefty Beast Bone x5; Map: Deeproot Depths

steps.instruction: Southeast of the gazebo is a ruined building with a Rune Arc and Smithing Stone [6] x3, guarded by several Basilisks.
Enter the tower north of the building to pick up Ash of War: Vacuum Slice in front of a Gargoyle.
When exiting the tower, turn right through a short passage to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] in a bush between two trees.
To the right of the large root west of the bush, you'll find a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
From the large root, head north to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] on dry ground near a waterfall.
Use the spiritspring near the waterfall to reach the Arteria Leaf x5 at the top of the building.
Drop to the lower rooftop next to the corpse for a Smithing Stone [7].
Return to the gazebo, then head west-southwest between two structures to find a Ghost Glovewort [5] in a bush.
Climb the root northwest of the bush to pick up a Golden Rune [1] behind a Gargoyle.
Jump to the first root on the left, then follow it to the top to find the Prince of Death's Staff on a tower.
At the bottom of the same root, you'll find a Smithing Stone [6].
Jump onto the tilted tower below the root and pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from behind its upper right corner.
Grab The Nameless Eternal City grace just south-southwest of the tower.
Loot the Human Bone Shard x5, 2x Smithing Stone [4], Clarifying Boluses, Golden Rune [9], 2x Golden Rune [8], Ghost Glovewort [5], and Nascent Butterfly west of the grace.
steps.linkedRaw: Human Bone Shard x5; Smithing Stone [4]; Clarifying Boluses; Golden Rune [9]; Golden Rune [8]; Ghost Glovewort [5]; Nascent Butterfly

steps.instruction: Drop down the northwest cliff to find a Ghost Glovewort [6] at the cliff edge below.
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7] in the back of the nearby building.
Use the spiritspring next to the building while facing east to reach the Stonesword Key on top.
Use the spiritspring while facing northwest, and kill Crucible Knight Siluria for Siluria's Tree and 25,000 runes.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] next to the massive tree stump, and open the chest inside it for the Crucible Tree Set.
Head down the slope and pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] and Golden Rune [8] in front of the two large roots.

Follow the root on the right all the way to a Wandering Mausoleum. Jump onto it from the closest branch and destroy the skull formations around it until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
North of the mausoleum is a tilted building with a Somber Smithing Stone [6] inside.
Next to a trunk on the cliff behind the building, you'll find the Mausoleum Soldier Ashes.
Follow the cliff edge southwest to find a Smithing Stone [5] in front of a rock.
Continue southwest and pick up a Golden Rune [8] at the end of a root stretching out into the depths.
Return to the two large roots and kill the scarab on the left root for a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
The root on the right stretches into several branches. Follow the left branch first for a Golden Rune [8] past four Basilisks.
From the branch with the item, drop down toward south to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] on a ledge below.
Return to the two roots and follow the middle branch to another Golden Rune [8].
Head back and follow the uppermost right branch to the roof of a building, where you can find a Smithing Stone [6].
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [7] inside the building, then head east toward a waterfall with Lightning Greatbolt x6 close by.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [7]; Lightning Greatbolt x6

steps.instruction: Go up the slope near the waterfall and loot the Somber Smithing Stone [7], Golden Rune [8], and Fan Daggers x4 from the Runebear's den.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [7]; Golden Rune [8]; Fan Daggers x4

steps.instruction: Travel to The Nameless Eternal City and head up the east-southeast root from earlier. This time, follow the same root to a Golden Rune [5].
Jump onto the thin root that stretches around the nearby tower to find Nascent Butterfly x3 on the top ledge of the tower.
Drop down the top end of the root to grab the Across the Roots grace.
Follow the root near the grace back around to loot a Golden Rune [8] from the corpse at the end.
Jump to a lower branch southeast of the corpse to reach an area with a Ghost Glovewort [7] near some ants.
Descend the hole in the area to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] on a ledge.
Kill the Runebear at the bottom to obtain the Prince of Death's Cyst.
When exiting the cave, turn right to find a Ghost Glovewort [5].
Return to Across the Roots and kill Fia's Champions for Fia's Mist and 40,000 runes.
Activate the Prince of Death's Throne grace after the fight.
Speak to Fia and answer that you want to be held. Talk to her in secret twice, then give her the Cursemark of Death to receive the Radiant Baldachin's Blessing (no need to get rid of this one).

Talk to Fia in secret and reload the area. Talk to her again and reload the area a second time. Interact with her afterward to enter the Deathbed Dream, then kill Lichdragon Fortissax for Remembrance of the Lichdragon and 90,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Lichdragon Fortissax; Remembrance of the Lichdragon

steps.instruction: Loot the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from Fia's corpse, then reload the area to pick up Fia's Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Mending Rune of the Death-Prince; Fia's Set

steps.instruction: D, Beholder of Death will show up if you gave him the Twinned Set. Talk to him, then reload the area to find the Inseparable Sword and the Twinned Set on the ground.
Enter Renna's Rise, northeast of Ranni's Rise, and loot the chest at the top of the ladder to obtain the Snow Witch Set.
Use the sending gate at the top of the tower to reach Ainsel River Main. After arriving, pick up Miniature Ranni from one of the coffins.
Rest at the Ainsel River Main grace, and talk to the miniature Ranni three times to get a response from her.
Kill the Withered Astel launching rocks at you to receive a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Pick up the 2x Ghost Glovewort [6] in the water northeast of the Withered Astel.
East-northeast of the gloveworts, you'll find a Golden Rune [7] and Human Bone Shard x3 around a staircase.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [7]; Human Bone Shard x3

steps.instruction: Next to an unlit brazier south-southwest of the staircase is a Smithing Stone [4].
Grab the Stonesword Key next to a Miranda Blossom in the water, then pick up the Ghost Glovewort [6] and Clayman Ashes next to the waterfall.
steps.linkedRaw: Stonesword Key; Ghost Glovewort [6]; Clayman Ashes

steps.instruction: Northwest of the waterfall, leaning against a ruined wall, you'll find a Golden Rune [7].
From the wall, turn southwest to pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] and a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [7] from a corner of the ruined structure.
Follow the water downstream to a corpse with Stimulating Boluses.
Pick up the Golden Rune [10] x8 and Shield Grease x2 in the room downstream.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [10] x8; Shield Grease x2

steps.instruction: Follow the southwest path past a shield-headed ant until you reach a chest with the Wing of Astel on top of a structure.
Go up the slope near the structure to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [6] hanging from the edge.
Return to the ant room and follow the river to a Ghost Glovewort [6] in the water.
Go through the doorway and drop down to discover the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
Talk to Ranni while resting at the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
Beside the wall behind the grace sits a corpse with Magic Grease x3.
Enter the room on the left up the first set of stairs to find a chest with the Ant's Skull Plate.
Pick up Fan Daggers from a corpse on the stair railing.
At the top of the stairs, enter the south building for a chest with the Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2].
Behind the building you'll find a corpse with the Archer Ashes.
Return to the stairs and pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the arcade.
Go through the opening in the arcade to discover a chest with a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
At the end of the arcade is another Golden Rune [10].
Enter the building up the stairs and loot the Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets from a chest guarded by two Nox Monks.
Kill the boulder on the bridge for a Larval Tear (first time), then grab the Golden Rune [10] at the end.
Enter the building near the bridge. Kill the boulder in the ceiling for a Larval Tear (first time), then loot the chest for a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the railing on the stairs past the bridge.
In front of the right building up the stairs, you can find a Smithing Stone [6].
Enter the left building, kill the boulder in the ceiling for a Larval Tear (first time), then loot the chest for a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Kill the scarab in front of the last staircase for a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Ascend the stairs and loot the Moon of Nokstella from a chest in the top building.
Head through the south doorway in the building to reach a lift and ride it down to a Golden Seed.
From the golden tree, drop down toward north-northeast to find a Stonesword Key on the cliff edge.
Head southeast toward a ledge and pick up the 2x Ghost Glovewort [8] in the water, guarded by a several electrified Silver Tears.
Beside a rock in the water, near the gloveworts, is a Golden Rune [10].
Make a sharp turn around the bottom of a bridge for a Smithing Stone [6] in a corner of an arcade.
In front of a closed door, past the opposite end of the arcade, you'll find a Celestial Dew.
Follow the cliff around the corner north until you reach a corpse with Silver Tear Husk x3.
Head toward the ruined buildings near the cliff to find a Smithing Stone [6] and Drawstring Holy Grease x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [6]; Drawstring Holy Grease x2

steps.instruction: Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [7] near the waterfalls at the end.
Follow the river downstream until you see a Ghost Glovewort [7] on the riverbank.
Ascend the stairs on the left riverbank to reach a chest with a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Continue downstream to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the cliff edge behind a structure on the left.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] in the riverbed, then grab the Celestial Dew beneath the structure where the river drops into a waterfall.
Use the lift in the building east of the structure to reach the Nokstella Waterfall Basin grace.
Talk to Ranni while resting at the Nokstella Waterfall Basin grace.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9] just northeast of the grace.
Proceed through the short tunnel in the water to find a Smithing Stone [4] and Smithing Stone [5].
Kill the Baleful Shadow past the tunnel to receive the Discarded Palace Key.
Use the lift at the end of the corridor and activate the Lake of Rot Shoreside grace.
Travel to the Raya Lucaria Grand Library and unlock the chest near the grace to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Equip armor with high Immunity, the Spiralhorn Shield or Ant's Skull Plate, the Immunizing Horn Charm and Mottled Necklace +1, and Flame, Cleanse Me or craft some Preserving Boluses.
From the Lake of Rot Shoreside grace, drop down toward east to pick up Aeonian Butterfly next to a rotted tree.
Quickly continue north for a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on top of some mushrooms.
Head southeast toward some ruins and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] beside a wall.
Continue south toward a ruin sticking out of the rot. Pick up the Golden Rune [9] hanging from the top of it.
Kill the Ancestral Follower in the rot west-northwest of the ruin for the Immunizing Horn Charm +1, then immediately return to the ruin.

Head toward the platform with a pillar south-southeast of the ruin. Step on the pressure plate to raise platforms around the boss, then kill the Dragonkin Soldier in the rot for Dragonscale Blade and 58,000 runes.
Loot the Golden Rune [7], Golden Rune [10], and Lightningproof Dried Liver around the raised platforms.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [7]; Golden Rune [10]; Lightningproof Dried Liver

steps.instruction: Head toward the building southeast of the platforms. To the left of it is a structure protruding from the rot, with a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on top.
Climb the southwest structure to reach the top of a building. Pick up the Mushroom Crown on a pillar inside.
Return to the Lake of Rot Shoreside and pick up the Map: Lake of Rot down the slope.
Step on the pressure plate southwest of the map, then pick up Rot Grease from the corpse next to the raised platform.
Head toward the mushrooms in the rot west of the corpse to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
From the mushrooms, head southeast toward a corpse in the rot with Black-Key Bolt x10, then step on the pressure plate farther south-southeast.
Use the raised platforms to reach a corpse in the rot with a Warming Stone.
Step on the pressure plate south of the corpse, then continue south-southwest to reach the final pressure plate.
When stepping on the final plate, the platform will elevate. Kill the Alabaster Lord at the top of the structure for Alabaster Lord's Sword.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the top east corner of the structure.
Descend the ladder at the opposite end of the structure, and kill the scarab at the bottom of the slope for a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Return to the ladder, then drop onto the ledge to the right of it. Go around the ledge and pick up the Preserving Boluses behind a large brazier.
In the building northwest of the braziers, you'll find a chest with the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [22].
Return to the braziers and go down the stairs to discover the Grand Cloister grace.
Continue past the grace and pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the top ledge.
Make your way down the gaps in the ledges to reach the bottom, then pick up the Golden Rune [10] in front of a large brazier.
Bait out the Putrid Tree Spirit near the rot waterfall and kill it to receive a Golden Seed.
Grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Smithing Stone [7] in front of the rot waterfall.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9], Fan Daggers x8, and Smithing Stone [5] near the group of enemies at the opposite side of the cloister.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghost Glovewort [9]; Fan Daggers x8; Smithing Stone [5]

steps.instruction: Ascend the stairs and loot the Scorpion's Stinger from the chest at the end.
Rest in the coffin at the end of the rot stream, then kill Astel, Naturalborn of the Void for Remembrance of the Naturalborn and 80,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void; Remembrance of the Naturalborn

steps.instruction: Grab the Astel, Naturalborn of the Void grace, then use the lift north-northeast of the grace.
A few steps from the lift, you'll discover the Moonlight Altar grace.
From the Moonlight Altar grace, head east until you reach the first half of Lunar Estate Ruins:
In the first part of the ruins is a corpse with Glintstone Firefly x5.
Kill the Revenant spawning in the middle for a Ghost Glovewort [2] (first time).
Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the corpse near the Revenant.
Head down the hidden cellar next to an imp seal to grab the Cerulean Amber Medallion +2.
From the cellar, head east toward the other half of the ruins. Optionally, kill the Revenant on the left side of the ruins for a Ghost Glovewort [2] (first time).
Roll through the hidden cellar on the far-left side of the ruins. Loot the chest inside for Smithing Stone [8] x3.
From the second cellar, follow the slope north to a cathedral. Grab the Cathedral of Manus Celes grace inside.
Pick up the 11x Starlight Shards around the cathedral (including the one near the astrolabe).
Kill Glintstone Dragon Adula outside the cathedral for Dragon Heart x3, Adula's Moonblade, and 120,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Glintstone Dragon Adula; Dragon Heart x3; Adula's Moonblade

steps.instruction: Just west of the cathedral lies Moonfolk Ruins:
Loot the Rune Arc and Golden Rune [9] in the lower part of the ruins.
In a hidden cellar in the upper northeast part of the ruins is a chest with a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Pick up Magic Grease from a corpse in the upper southwest part of the ruins.
Head down the slope southwest of the ruins and pick up Gravel Stone x5 from the corpse behind a sleeping dragon.
Kill the three dragons in the area for 3x Dragon Heart.
Follow the path near the sleeping dragon to a small wood. Kill Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader in the evergaol past the woods for Black Knife Tiche and 80,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader; Black Knife Tiche

steps.instruction: Return to the path and follow it downhill to an area with three gazebos. Loot the 2x Smithing Stone [7] x3 and Smithing Stone [8] x3 from the gazebos.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [7] x3; Smithing Stone [8] x3

steps.instruction: Continue down the slope and grab the Altar South grace in front of the tower at the bottom.
Examine the book in front of Chelona's Rise to activate the great wise beasts:
Note: The puzzle resets upon reloading, so you'll need to ride to each location.
#1: The first beast can be found below the cliff west of the tower. [Location 1]
#2: On a high-up ledge below the upper cliff far to the east-northeast of the tower. [Location 2]
#3: Use the spiritspring near the evergaol to hit the wise beast above the trees. [Location 3]
Return to Chelona's Rise and loot Ranni's Dark Moon from the chest at the top.
Drop down the hole in Cathedral of Manus Celes and place the ring on Ranni's finger. Talk to her afterward to receive the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Talk to the miniature Ranni while resting at the Ranni's Chamber grace.
Kill the hostile Blaidd outside Ranni's Rise to obtain the Royal Greatsword and Blaidd's Set.
Inform Iji of Blaidd's death, then reload the area to find Iji's Bell Bearing and Iji's Mirrorhelm on his anvil.
Travel to Magma Wyrm Makar and use the lift northwest of the grace. A few steps from the lift, you'll discover the Abandoned Coffin grace.
Follow the dirt path west of the grace to a scarab that drops Ash of War: Sacred Order.
Farther along the path lies Perfumer's Ruins:
Pick up Budding Cave Moss x4 from a corpse past the far-right entrance to the ruins.
Kill the Omenkiller in the middle of the ruins to obtain the Omenkiller Set (first time).
Loot the Perfume Bottle and Perfumer's Cookbook [1] in the middle, then grab the Golden Rune [5] from a hole in the wall.
steps.linkedRaw: Perfume Bottle; Perfumer's Cookbook [1]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Pick up the Perfume Bottle and Nascent Butterfly around the Miranda Blossom in the upper part of the ruins.
Head down the cellar covered in planks next to the Miranda Blossom to grab the Perfumer's Talisman.
In the cliffside below Perfumer's Ruins lies the entrance to Unsightly Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Unsightly Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [5] from the corridor that loops around the stairs.
In a corridor down the stairs, you can find another Grave Glovewort [5].
Continue to another set of stairs and pick up the Grave Glovewort [4] at the bottom.
Drop down next to the stairs, and loot the Winged Misbegotten Ashes and Ghost Glovewort [5] from the floor with Misbegotten corpses.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [4] on the way to the boss lever and pull it.
Grab the Rune Arc and Prattling Pate "Apologies" in the looping corridor around the lever, then drop down for a Grave Glovewort [4].
steps.linkedRaw: Rune Arc; Prattling Pate "Apologies"; Grave Glovewort [4]

steps.instruction: Kill Perfumer Tricia & Misbegotten Warrior for Perfumer Tricia and 9,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Perfumer Tricia & Misbegotten Warrior; Perfumer Tricia

steps.instruction: From the catacomb entrance, head east-northeast to find a corpse with Gold Firefly in the water, guarded by three Miranda Sprouts.
Just east of the corpse lies the entrance to Sage's Cave:
Enter and activate the Sage's Cave grace.
Hit the illusory wall past the grace, then the illusory wall near some cave moss to reveal a room with Lost Ashes of War and Rejuvenating Boluses x5.
steps.linkedRaw: Lost Ashes of War; Rejuvenating Boluses x5

steps.instruction: Pick up the 2x Golden Rune [5] from the corpses farther in the room.
Hit the illusory wall between two braziers in the room to find chests with Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x5, Black Hood, Candletree Wooden Shield, and Nascent Butterfly.
steps.linkedRaw: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x5; Black Hood; Candletree Wooden Shield; Nascent Butterfly

steps.instruction: Continue to a room with multiple enemies. Hit the illusory wall behind a Skeletal Militiaman to find a chest with a Stonesword Key.
Loot Golden Great Arrow x10, Dragonwound Grease x4, and Raptor Talons from the three chests up ahead.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Great Arrow x10; Dragonwound Grease x4; Raptor Talons

steps.instruction: In the room with the waterfall, take the left tunnel to an illusory wall and loot the Raptor's Black Feathers and Skeletal Mask behind it.
Hit the illusory wall near the chests and kill Necromancer Garris for Family Heads and 9,000 runes.
Turn back and follow the other path. Kill the invisible Black Knife Assassin for Concealing Veil and 9,000 runes.
Note: Your spirit summon will know its location at all times.
Travel to Abandoned Coffin and pick up a Smithing Stone [5] between two carriages just northeast of the grace.
Head up the slope with carriages and pick up Fulgurbloom x5 from the top of one on the right.
Pick up the Ruler's Set from one of the last carriages near the path.
You'll be ambushed by Lansseax farther up the slope. After dealing some damage to her, she'll fly away.
In the area southeast of where you're ambushed is a heap of carriages with a Nascent Butterfly on top.
Return to the path on the slope and follow it to the Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace.
Talk to Millicent on the cliff north-northeast of the grace.
Grab the Golden Seed near the grace, then head toward the large encampment down the slope:
Pick up Lightning Grease from a corpse in the middle of the lower camp.
Grab the Greatshield Talisman and Troll's Golden Sword from the carriages in the lower camp.
Pick up Warming Stone from a corpse in the middle camp.
In the camp southeast of the middle camp lies a corpse with Fan Daggers x5.
In the camp north-northeast of the middle camp sits a chest with a Sacrificial Twig.
From the lower camp with the carriages, head south downhill until you reach a tunnel with Hefty Beast Bone x2.
Unlock the evergaol past the tunnel and kill Godefroy the Grafted for Godfrey Icon and 26,000 runes.
Travel to the Altus Plateau grace and head toward the broken wagon northwest of it to find a Lightningproof Dried Liver.
On a lower ledge east of the wagon lies a corpse with String x5.
Head toward the top of the slope to enter Lux Ruins:
Pick up String x3 and a Golden Rune [3] from the ruined building.
Kill the teleporting scarab in the back of the ruins to obtain Ash of War: Shield Crash.
Kill Demi-Human Queen Gilika in the cellar for 8,500 runes.
Loot the Ritual Sword Talisman from the chest in the cellar.
Drop down the cliff northwest of the cellar to discover a corpse with Lightningproof Dried Liver.
Head up the northeast slope past Millicent to reach Wyndham Ruins:
Kill the Tibia Mariner in the water for Deathroot, Tibia's Summons, and 14,000 runes.
In the isolated ruin closest to the cliff, you'll find a Smithing Stone [5].
Loot the Human Bone Shard x5 and Golden Rune [3] from the ruins in the water.
steps.linkedRaw: Human Bone Shard x5; Golden Rune [3]

steps.instruction: Grab the Stormhawk Feather x4 in front of the main entrace to the ruins, then pick up the Golden Rune [7] in the corner behind it.
Go up the stairs past the entrance to find a Golden Rune [4].
Unlock the cellar in a ruined building and loot the Pearldrake Talisman +1 from the chest.
In one of the corners of the uppermost building is a corpse with Dappled White Cured Meat.
At the top of the slope lies the entrance to Wyndham Catacombs:
Head inside and activate the Wyndham Catacombs grace.
Take the lift down while facing west, then walk off to a ledge with a Grave Glovewort [5].
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [4] from the room with a cleaver.
In the small room up ahead is a Grave Glovewort [5].
Descend the stairs to a sewage room with a Ghost Glovewort [6] and a Grave Glovewort [4].
Unlock the imp seal up the ladder to obtain the Lightning Scorpion Charm.
Head straight across the impaling floor to pull the lever in the room above.
Drop down beneath the floor as it's rising, then loot the Magic Grease x2, Golden Rune [5], and Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [1] guarded by Giant Crabs.
steps.linkedRaw: Magic Grease x2; Golden Rune [5]; Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [1]

steps.instruction: Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1] and 12,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Burial Watchdog; Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1]

steps.instruction: Return to the entrance, then make your way down the southwest cliff to grab the Seethewater River grace at the bottom.
Kill the large scarab in the river to obtain Ash of War: Barrage.
On a ledge southeast of the scarab is a corpse with Arrow x10.
Follow the river until you reach a Golden Seed on the left.
In front of a rock farther north is a Smithing Stone [5]. Save the rest of this area for later when exploring Mt. Gelmir.
Travel to Erdtree-Gazing Hill and follow the dirt path north of the encampment. Kill the scarab floating above the water for Ash of War: Blood Blade.
Continue along the path past the water to find the sealed entrance to Old Altus Tunnel behind a Troll:
Unlock the imp seal and loot Explosive Stone Clump x3 from a corpse on the right.
Take the lift down and grab the Old Altus Tunnel grace.
On the wall beside a hut is a Smithing Stone [5].
Climb the ladder on the wooden platforms to a room with Boltdrake Talisman +1 and Stanching Boluses.
On the walls around the room, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Drop to the wooden platforms to the right of the ladder. Pick up the Golden Rune [6] and Smithing Stone [5] at the end.
Drop onto the roof of the hut below the ladder to reach an elevated Smithing Stone [5] on the wall.
Go through the northwest tunnel behind the hut to find 2x Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Head back and loot a Somber Smithing Stone [4] and Troll's Hammer from the corpses in the huts.
Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [5] and Somber Smithing Stone [6] on the walls in the room.
Kill the Stonedigger Troll for Great Club and 9,600 runes.
Return to the entrance and head east to pick up a Golden Rune [3] on the tip of a long slanted rock.
Use the spiritspring east of the rock while facing northwest, then jump across the gap to the northwest ledge to find a Nascent Butterfly.
Drop down from the ledge and follow the path north toward the Shaded Castle. Kill Maleigh Marais in the area left of the castle for Antspur Rapier and Marais Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Maleigh Marais; Antspur Rapier; Marais Set

steps.instruction: Near a Golem at the end of the rocky area is a Smithing Stone [5].
Go behind the castle to find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards near the cliff edge.
Head around the outside of the castle rampart until you see a Golden Rune [3] guarded by four slugs in front of the castle.
In the poison farther east-southeast, you'll find a corpse with Poison Grease.
Climb the slanted rocks near the corpse to enter the castle, then pick up Poisonbloom x4 from the left end of the rampart.
Go up the stairs on the left to grab the Shaded Castle Ramparts grace.
From the Shaded Castle Ramparts, follow the northeast stretch of the rampart and pick up a Golden Rune [6] from the alcove on the right.
Loot the Glass Shard and Poisonbone Dart x5 in the poison pond near the alcove.
Enter the wooden structure near the pond and interact with the painting to obtain the "Champion's Song" Painting.
Return to the grace and descend the ladder to the swamp. Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] in the wooden structure.
South of the wooden structure is a stone platform. In a secluded area past the stone platform, you'll find a wooden ramp with a Golden Rune [6].
In the secluded area, loot the Smithing Stone [5] next to a tree, then the Drawstring Fire Grease x2 around a rooftop.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [5]; Drawstring Fire Grease x2

steps.instruction: Climb the rooftop west of the stone platform to reach a rampart with a Smithing Stone [5] at the end.
Return to the rooftop in the poison swamp, then pick up Beast Blood near the building farther north.
Kill the Revenant behind the building for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [5] on the corpse near the Revenant.
Pick up Neutralizing Boluses x2 from the left end of the rampart, accessible from the top of the building near the Revenant.
At the opposite end of the rampart is a small enclosed area with a putrid Miranda Blossom. Grab the Smithing Stone [5] behind it.
Return to the poison swamp and climb the ladder in the middle. Head left along the rampart to find Glass Shard x2 on the edge.
Loot the chest at the end to obtain the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Head back along the rampart and drop down to the inner poison swamp. Next to the large tree is a Golden Rune [6].
Go up the stairs in the middle, then climb the ladder on the left to find a Golden Rune [4].
Activate the Shaded Castle Inner Gate grace just past the ladder.
Head back down the ladder and optionally kill the Revenant in the area up the stairs for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Pick up Rot Grease x3 from the corpse near the Revenant.
In the wooden structure in the poison swamp, you'll find a Smithing Stone [4].
Climb the ladder in the poison and pick up a Smithing Stone [5] behind some crates at the left end of the rampart.
Continue along the rampart to find a corpse with a Perfume Bottle at the end.

Turn back and kick the ladder down the stairs. Do a running jump toward the large rock formation, climb around its east side, then drop down next to a branch sticking out of a rock to reach a Stonesword Key. [See video]
Return to the grace and continue to a dark room with a ladder. Climb it and pick up Perfumer's Cookbook [2] from a chair at the top.
Head back down and pick up Hefty Beast Bone x4 from the corner outside the room.
Pick up Gold Firefly x2 from the room across a bridge.
Grab the Smithing Stone [5] outside the room, then kick the shortcut ladder next to a brazier.
Take the lift up and kill Elemer of the Briar for Marais Executioner's Sword, Briar Greatshield, and 24,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Elemer of the Briar; Marais Executioner's Sword; Briar Greatshield

steps.instruction: Activate the Castellan's Hall grace after the fight.
Return to Millicent and give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Tell Gowry that you gave Millicent the prosthesis, then talk to him about Millicent.
Buy Pest Threads from Gowry, then talk to him about Malenia to learn the Desperate Prayer gesture.
Feed Gurranq the Deathroot to receive Beast Claw.
From the Altus Highway Junction, head south-southeast toward a campsite on the left with Beast Blood.
Head up the slope east of the campsite to reach a mining field. In one of the pits lies Gravity Stone Fan x4.
Pick up Gravity Stone Chunk x2 from a pit farther northeast.
Kill the Fallingstar Beast at the top for Somber Smithing Stone [5], Smithing Stone [6] x5, Gravity Stone Fan x10, Gravity Stone Chunk x10, and 11,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Fallingstar Beast; Somber Smithing Stone [5]; Smithing Stone [6] x5; Gravity Stone Fan x10; Gravity Stone Chunk x10

steps.instruction: Head up the slope east from the Altus Highway Junction. Behind a Miranda Blossom at the top lies the entrance to Perfumer's Grotto:
Head inside and activate the Perfumer's Grotto grace.
Pick up the Living Jar Shard x5 next to a Miranda Blossom in the first room.
Loot Perfume Bottle and Living Jar Shard x10 from the chests behind a branch in the second room.
steps.linkedRaw: Perfume Bottle; Living Jar Shard x10

steps.instruction: Kill the Withered Astel ahead, then pick up the Arteria Leaf x3 on the root.
Loot the Miranda Powder x6, Warming Stone, and 2x Golden Rune [5] before the boss.
steps.linkedRaw: Miranda Powder x6; Warming Stone; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Kill the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom for Great Omenkiller Cleaver and 8,400 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom; Great Omenkiller Cleaver

steps.instruction: Return to the Altus Highway Junction and head north-northwest toward an Omen camp. Pick up the Perfume Bottle under a tent.
Just west of the Omen camp, you'll find a campsite with Turtle Neck Meat.
From the campsite, head north toward a sword monument. Drop down the cliff past it and grab the Sacred Tear in the church.
Talk to Yura inside the church, then loot the Nagakiba from his corpse.
His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Piercing Fang. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Shortly after, you'll be invaded by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Kill her to obtain the Purifying Crystal Tear and Eleonora's Poleblade.
steps.linkedRaw: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger; Purifying Crystal Tear; Eleonora's Poleblade

steps.instruction: In the graveyard behind the church is a corpse with Human Bone Shard x6.
In the lower graveyard farther north is a corpse with Magic Grease.
Drop down the cliff east of the corpse and touch the blue phantom crest in the corner.
Pick up the Miquella's Lily in front of a gravestone north of the phantom crest.
Touch the phantom crest east-northeast of the gravestone and examine the book next to it to receive the Mirage Riddle.
Below the ledge south-southeast of the book, you'll find a corpse with a Golden Rune [3].
Kill the scarab surrounded by three Wormfaces east of the corpse to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Grab the Bower of Bounty grace northeast of the scarab.
Go up the slope south of the grace, then turn left and hit the fake boulder near the cliff edge to reveal the final phantom crest.
Follow the cliff edge northeast to find Fulgurbloom x4 on a ledge below the broken bridge.
Return to Bower of Bounty and head north-northwest to a ledge at the end with a Nascent Butterfly, guarded by three Wormfaces.
From the ledge, head southwest toward the now revealed Mirage Rise. Loot Unseen Blade, Unseen Form, and Slumbering Egg x5 from the top of the tower.
steps.linkedRaw: Unseen Blade; Unseen Form; Slumbering Egg x5

steps.instruction: Return to the grace again and pick up Hefty Beast Bone x2 from a corpse below the broken bridge northeast of the grace.
Continue northeast and kill the giant Wormface for Crimsonspill Crystal Tear, Speckled Hardtear, and 10,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Wormface; Crimsonspill Crystal Tear; Speckled Hardtear

steps.instruction: Enter the ruins north of the boss for Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19], a scarab that drops Ash of War: Golden Slam, and a corpse with Beast Blood x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19]; Ash of War: Golden Slam; Beast Blood x2

steps.instruction: Farther northeast lies the second part of Woodfolk Ruins, where you can find the Icon Shield and Gravel Stone x2.
South of the second part, behind two Wormfaces, you'll find a corpose with Invigorating White Cured Meat.
Pick up Soft Cotton from the corner of the nearby ruin.
In the corner of a ruin wall farther south-southeast is a corpse with Poisonbone Dart x5.
Southwest of the ruin wall lies the final part of Woodfolk Ruins. Go down the cellar in the middle to pick up Wrath of Gold.
In the cliffside southwest of the ruins, you'll find the entrance to Altus Tunnel:
Take the lift down and grab the Altus Tunnel grace.
In the first room on the right is a chest with a Rune Arc and a Smithing Stone [5] on the wall behind some crates.
In the second room is a corpse with Crystal Dart x8.
Loot 3x Smithing Stone [5] from the bottom floor walls in the mining room.
Go up the stairs to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] and Arteria Leaf x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [5]; Arteria Leaf x2

steps.instruction: Follow the south tunnel to a wooden platform with a Golden Rune [7].
Descend the root to find a corpse with Glintstone Scrap x6 on the bottom scaffolding.
Carefully climb the root to the top platform to pick up Arsenal Charm +1.
Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [5] in the room before the boss.
Kill the two Crystalians for Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] and 9,000 runes.
Travel to the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge and jump down the broken bridge to pick up Golden Arrow x10.
Continue to the bottom of the bridge, then head north to pick up Lump of Flesh x3 on top of some rubble.
From the rubble, head north-northeast to find a Golden Seed on your right as you exit the forest.
Follow the dirt path near the golden tree uphill to a small village. Pick up Poison Grease from the porch of a windmill at the end.
Continue uphill until you reach the Windmill Village grace at the entrance to Dominula, Windmill Village:
Follow the cliff edge northeast of the grace to a corpse with the Celebrant's Skull.
Go up the stairs near the grace and pick up a Golden Rune [5] from the stable attached to a building.
Inside an open house in the same area is a Rune Arc.
On the ledge east of the house, you'll find a corpse with Holyproof Dried Liver.
Walk around the outside of the house west of the corpse to pick up Stormhawk Feather x3.
Head up stairs and take the first right around a house to grab a Lightning Grease.
From the top of the stairs, drop down the planks around the west building to find Exalted Flesh x2 on a roof below it.
Kill the Godskin Apostle at the top of the village for Godskin Peeler, Scouring Black Flame, and 14,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Godskin Apostle; Godskin Peeler; Scouring Black Flame

steps.instruction: Millicent's summon sign can be found on the slope if you gave her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Rest at the Windmill Heights grace, then talk to Millicent near the grace.
Pick up a Gold Firefly from the corpse in front of a house south-southeast of the grace.
Travel to Windmill Village and head north-northwest toward a windmill. Pick up Raw Meat Dumpling x10 from the stable behind it.
Continue toward a windmill farther northwest and grab the Noble's Set and Twinned Knight Swords from the corpses there.
Head toward the final windmill past a pond and pick up Giant Rat Ashes from the rat-infested stable.
Standing on the ledge east of the windmill is a Battlemage. Kill him to obtain the Battlemage Set (first time).
Interact with Goldmask at the end of the broken bridge.
Pick up Dragonwound Grease from the corpse next to Goldmask.
Talk to Corhyn and tell him Goldmask's whereabouts.
Return to the end of the bridge and talk to Corhyn next to Goldmask. Optionally, talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Follow the road southeast of Windmill Village to find a Golden Seed on a ledge on the right.
Continue toward the catapults and pick up a Golden Rune [9] by a tent near the spiked barricades.
Kill the scarab north of the tent to obtain Ash of War: Lightning Slash.
Head toward the tower past the camp and pick up Golden Arrow x6 from the lower scaffolding around it.
Grab the Hefty Beast Bone x10 halfway up the tower, then loot Greatbow and Great Arrow x20 from the chest at the top.
steps.linkedRaw: Hefty Beast Bone x10; Greatbow; Great Arrow x20

steps.instruction: Return to Windmill Village and head south-southeast along a dirt path instead of the road. Pick up Four-Toed Fowl Foot x3 next to a wagon.
Follow the dirt path to a ruins site and pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] from a chair in the lower ruins.
Kill the Wandering Noble in the upper corner of the ruins and he'll turn into an Elder Lion that drops a Larval Tear.
Between the catapults past the ruins, you'll find Lightning Greatbolt x3.
On the hillside southwest of the catapults lies a cemetery with a Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], Golden Rune [6], and Golden Rune [8].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [6]; Golden Rune [8]

steps.instruction: Return to the path and follow it toward the Rampartside Path grace.
Head down the slope southeast of the grace to reach a campsite with Land Octopus Ovary.
Continue downhill and loot the Golden Rune [6], Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot, and Golden Rune [3] in the graveyard.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [6]; Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot; Golden Rune [3]

steps.instruction: Use the nearby spiritspring and kill Ancient Dragon Lansseax on the hillside for Lansseax's Glaive and 60,000 runes.
At the north end of the hillside, you'll find the Harp Bow (painting reward).
On a stone platform down the hillside sits a corpse with a Stonesword Key.
Kill the scarab farther downhill to obtain Ash of War: Lightning Ram.
Enter the church at the bottom and loot the Lightning Greatbolt x10, Sacred Tear, and Dragonbolt Blessing inside.
steps.linkedRaw: Lightning Greatbolt x10; Sacred Tear; Dragonbolt Blessing

steps.instruction: On the hill above the church lies a cemetery with a Golden Rune [3], 2x Golden Rune [4], and 2x Golden Rune [6].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [6]

steps.instruction: Head toward the Sainted Hero's Grave north-northwest of the cemetery:
Kill the Black Knife Assassin guarding the entrance for Black Knife and 10,800 runes.
Ride the lift down and grab the Sainted Hero's Grave grace.
Unlock the imp seal and pick up the Crimson Seed Talisman.
Enter the room straight ahead and optionally kill the Revenant beneath the stairs for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [5] beneath the stairs.
Hit the illusory wall at the top of the room, then continue to the next room for a Grave Glovewort [4] below the stairs.
Pick up Leyndell Soldier Ashes in the back of a room with a pitfall in the middle.
Drop down the pitfall to grab a Grave Glovewort [3], then pull the lever.
Ride the first cleaver to a room with an imp seal and unlock it for a Grave Glovewort [5] and the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1.
Return to the cleaver room to pick up a Grave Glovewort [4] and a Grave Glovewort [3].
Climb the ladder at the end to a room with a Revenant and optionally kill it for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Pick up the Human Bone Shard x5 and Grave Glovewort [5] in the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Human Bone Shard x5; Grave Glovewort [5]

steps.instruction: Grab Root Resin x3 from a corpse on the bridge.
Quickly loot Prattling Pate "Let's get to it", Ghost Glovewort [4], and a Ghost Glovewort [5] from the room past the bridge.
steps.linkedRaw: Prattling Pate "Let's get to it"; Ghost Glovewort [4]; Ghost Glovewort [5]

steps.instruction: Bait the shadow Duelist into the light zone before the cleaver room. Once he's vulnerable, kill him to unlock the boss door.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [3] on the way down to the boss.
Kill the Ancient Hero of Zamor for Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff and 20,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ancient Hero of Zamor; Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff

steps.instruction: Travel to Windmill Village and kill the scarab on a stone platform near the broken bridge west of the grace for Protection of the Erdtree.
Grab the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace under the broken bridge.
Rest at the grace to reset the caravan to its starting point near the grace, then loot the chest in the carriage to obtain the Great Stars.
Pick up Stimulating Boluses x2 from a separate part of the broken bridge below the cliff to the left of the caravan.
Continue down the bridge to pick up Radiant Gold Mask from the bottom edge.
In the area with gravestones to the right of the caravan, kill a Wandering Noble carrying a chest for a Golden Rune [10] (first time).
Below the cliff in the area with gravestones, behind a Pumpkin Head, you'll find a corpse with Gravel Stone x2.
To the left of the road lies Writheblood Ruins:
Invade Magnus the Beast Claw in the leftmost ruin for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Great Stars, and a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
steps.linkedRaw: Magnus the Beast Claw; Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Great Stars; Somber Smithing Stone [6]

steps.instruction: Head down the cellar in the middle ruin and kill the Sanguine Noble for 8,800 runes.
Loot the Bloody Helice from the chest in the cellar.
In a corner of the third ruin, you'll find a Golden Rune [5].
From the third ruin, head west-northwest to find a Golden Rune [4] at the cliff edge, near several soldiers.
Pick up Blood Grease x2 next to an empty carriage near a bridge at the end of the road.
Head down the slope south of the bridge and kill the Wandering Noble carrying a chest for a Golden Rune [10] (first time).
Grab the Bridge of Iniquity grace on the other side of the bridge.
Talk to Varre at Rose Church and answer "Anoint me" to receive the Lord of Blood's Favor.
Interact with the deceased maiden in the Church of Inhibition to soak the Lord of Blood's Favor in blood.
Return to Varre and offer him your finger to receive a Bloody Finger, then talk to him to obtain the Pureblood Knight's Medal.
From the Road of Iniquity grace, head downhill and kill the Putrid Corpse next to some spikes. He'll turn into a giant Wormface that drops a Larval Tear.
Continue down the slope to find Fan Daggers x5 on a pile of corpses.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit near the Minor Erdtree for Leaden Hardtear, Cerulean Hidden Tear, and 18,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ulcerated Tree Spirit; Leaden Hardtear; Cerulean Hidden Tear

steps.instruction: Pick up the Golden Rune [4], Golden Arrow x5, and Drawstring Fire Grease x3 in the area around the Erdtree.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [4]; Golden Arrow x5; Drawstring Fire Grease x3

steps.instruction: At the end of the broken bridge is a corpse with Beast Blood x3.
Jump onto the lower part of the bridge to pick up a Stonesword Key.
As you approach the shack, you'll be invaded by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater. Kill her to obtain a Butchering Knife with the Sacred affinity.
Loot Golden Vow from the corpse in the shack.
In the battlefield past the shack, you'll find Explosive Greatbolt x5 and a Golden Rune [8].
Behind a spiked barricade in the battlefield lies a corpse with Throwing Dagger x6.
Loot the Arteria Leaf x2 and Bloodrose x3 (between two slanted rocks) in the area past the battlefield.
Climb the ladder in the cliff face near the battlefield, then go left to discover the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
Loot a Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [7] from the cemetery near the grace.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [7]

steps.instruction: On the cliff past the cemetery is a chair with a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Head toward the tower past the grace and pick up Beast Blood from a collapsed tent below it.
Climb the tower to pick up Fire Arrow x10 and the Pulley Bow at the top.
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] from a rock near the tower.
Talk to Patches on the other side of the tall rugged ledge next to the rock, then follow the rainbow stones on the cliff edge.
Note: If he's not there or you've joined the Volcano Manor, travel to Seethewater River, then follow the river to get to the next step.
After being kicked off the cliff, loot the Nascent Butterfly, Glass Shard, Hefty Beast Bone x2, and Rejuvenating Boluses from the four corpses.
steps.linkedRaw: Nascent Butterfly; Glass Shard; Hefty Beast Bone x2; Rejuvenating Boluses

steps.instruction: Unlock the nearby imp seal to gain access to Seethewater Cave:
Head inside and grab the Seethewater Cave grace.
After dropping into the poison, pick up Poison Grease x3 from the right side of the room.
Follow the left tunnel to a corpse with Lump of Flesh x4, surrounded by rats.
Take the other tunnel while hugging the left side to find an alcove with Preserving Boluses.
Drop down the poison waterfall, then follow the southwest tunnel to a Golden Rune [7] on a ledge.
Loot the Mushroom Set and Immunizing Cured Meat from the upper room with a Miranda Blossom.
Follow the other tunnel past the poison waterfall to a hole. Pick up Poisonbone Dart x10 from a ledge with rats about halfway down.
Drop to the bottom, then head up first for a Golden Rune [6].
Kill the two Kindreds of Rot for Kindred of Rot's Exultation and 10,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Kindreds of Rot; Kindred of Rot's Exultation

steps.instruction: Return to the entrance and follow the river west-northwest until you reach a corpse with Herba x3.
Continue along the river to find Fireproof Dried Liver x3 behind a geyser.
Pick up the Golden Rune [6] at the end of the river, then grab the Seethewater Terminus grace.
In front of a spiked barricade west of the grace, you'll find Mushroom x5.
Head toward the jellyfish near the cliff and pick up a Stonesword Key behind the dead tree.
Enter Fort Laiedd near the cliff:
Kill the Fire Prelate to obtain Prelate's Inferno Crozier.
Open the door and pick up Armorer's Cookbook [7] from the room.
Loot Slumbering Egg x3 and a Golden Rune [8] from the corpses up top.
Jump over a broken merlon near one of the towers to find the Fire Scorpion Charm on a wooden platform outside the battlement.
Pick up Smoldering Butterfly x8 from the burning pile of corpses outside the fort.
Kill the Magma Wyrm in the lava past the fort for Dragon Heart and 19,000 runes.
Loot the Smoldering Butterfly x7, Golden Rune [3], and Golden Rune [5] from the four corpses in the lava.
steps.linkedRaw: Smoldering Butterfly x7; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [5]

steps.instruction: Talk to Alexander in the lava to receive the Jar helm.
Past the lava, you'll find a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [2], Golden Rune [4], and a Golden Rune [6].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [2]; Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [6]

steps.instruction: Continue uphill until you're ambushed by a Runebear. Bait it into attacking the statue near the cliff to obtain Smithing Stone [6] x3.
Pick up Roiling Magma from the first shack on a ledge.
On the ledge with the third shack is a corpse with Gravel Stone.
Continue uphill to grab the Craftsman's Shack grace in a shack on the right.
Pick up the Pulley Crossbow from the wooden platform near the grace.
Head through the spiked barricades to pick up Sacramental Bud x2 from a corpse past a barricade.
Pick up String x5 from the roof of a house at the entrance to Hermit Village.
Loot Prattling Pate "You're beautiful", Hierodas Glintstone Crown, Gold-Tinged Excrement, and the Errant Sorcerer Set from the village.
steps.linkedRaw: Prattling Pate "You're beautiful"; Hierodas Glintstone Crown; Gold-Tinged Excrement; Errant Sorcerer Set

steps.instruction: At the cliff near the village is an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
Kill Demi-Human Queen Maggie in the area past the village for Memory Stone and 13,000 runes.
Grab the Primeval Sorcerer Azur grace to the left of the rocky bridge, and interact with Primeval Sorcerer Azur to receive Comet Azur.
Show Sellen Azur's sorcery, then select "Tell me your story", "Let us journey together", and "I have a favor to ask" to receive the Sellian Sealbreaker.
From the Church of the Plague, head north-northeast toward a graveyard near the cliff face. Pick up Beast Blood x2 in front of the large gravestone.
Hit the illusory wall in the cliff behind the gravestone to reveal the entrance to Sellia Hideaway:
Head inside and activate the Sellia Hideaway grace.
In front of some crystals at the end of the tunnel is a Golden Rune [3].
Hit the two illusory walls behind the crystals to reveal a large room. Drop onto a large crystal below the first one and follow it up to a Golden Rune [5] next to a miner.
Descend the same crystal to the bottom and optionally kill the Revenant for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Loot the Stimulating Boluses, Golden Rune [5], and Lost Ashes of War near the Revenant.
steps.linkedRaw: Stimulating Boluses; Golden Rune [5]; Lost Ashes of War

steps.instruction: Go up the tunnel marked by fireflies to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Drop down at the end of the tunnel, then follow the ledge to a campsite with Glowstone x4.
Descend the long crystal below the ledge and unlock the seal at the bottom. Interact with Primeval Sorcerer Lusat to receive Stars of Ruin.
Return to the ledge and follow it through a dark tunnel to reach a second crystal room. At the bottom of the room lies a corpse with Crystal Dart x10.
Pick up Preserving Boluses x3 from a corpse on an upper ledge in the room.
Hit the illusory wall next to the corpse to reveal a chest with the Crystal Spear.
Climb the crystals at the top of the room to reach a hole. Drop down and loot the Crystalian Ashes from a chest.
Kill the three Putrid Crystalians for Crystal Torrent and 7,100 runes.
Return to Sellen, talk about the request, then tell her Lusat's location to receive Starlight Shards.
Talk to her real body in the cellar at Witchbane Ruins and accept her primal glintstone to obtain Sellen's Primal Glintstone.
Talk to Jerren in the cellar after reloading the area.
Transplant her primal glintstone into her puppet in the hidden cellar northeast of Ranni's Rise.
Outside the Raya Lucaria Grand Library, you'll now find two summon signs:
Challenge Sellen:
Use the red summon sign and kill Sellen for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Sellen's Bell Bearing, and Witch's Glintstone Crown.
steps.linkedRaw: Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Sellen's Bell Bearing; Witch's Glintstone Crown

steps.instruction: Talk to Jerren outside the library to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Assist Sellen:
Use the gold summon sign and help Sellen kill Jerren for the Eccentric's Set.
