Exhaust Sellen's dialogue in the library to receive the Glintstone Kris.
Reload the area to find her turned into a sorcerer ball. Pick up the Witch's Glintstone Crown next to her.
Pick up Lusat's Set in Sellia Hideaway and Azur's Set near Hermit Village.
At the tip of the rocky bridge near Primeval Sorcerer Azur, you'll find a Golden Rune [6].
Drop down and enter Gelmir Hero's Grave:
Ride the lift down and grab the Gelmir Hero's Grave grace.
Descend the chariot path downhill until you see an opening with a Grave Glovewort [7] on the left.
Pick up 2x Grave Glovewort [6], 2x Grave Glovewort [7], and a Ghost Glovewort [7] from the nearby room.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [6]; Grave Glovewort [7]; Ghost Glovewort [7]

steps.instruction: Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar, then grab a Golden Rune [6] from the south room.
Return to the earlier chariot path and traverse the lava. Turn left at the end to find a chest with the Ringed Finger.
At the opposite end of the lava, you'll find a hole with a Grave Glovewort [7] in front.
Drop down the hole and pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] in front of the boss doors.
Open the doors and kill the Red Wolf of the Champion for Bloodhound Knight Floh and 21,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Red Wolf of the Champion; Bloodhound Knight Floh

steps.instruction: Loot the chest in the room to obtain a Deathroot.
Pick up Beast Blood x3 from the bottom of a ladder outside the boss room.
Jump onto the chariot and ride it across the lava. Jump off at the end for a Grave Glovewort [7] and a Cemetery Shade that drops the Mantis Blade (first time).
Drop down to the left of the uphill path to discover a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x6.
Go through the narrow passage to find a Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Knight Set (first time) and a corpse with the Gelmir Knight Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Bloodhound Knight Set; Gelmir Knight Set

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder in the room to find Root Resin x5 surrounded by breakable jars.
When the chariot turns to go down, run upward to grab a Grave Glovewort [7] halfway up and a Stonesword Key at the top. Warp out before you get hit.
Return to the entrance and pick up Mushroom x6 from the corpse near a sleeping wolf.
Head north and talk to Patches near the rugged ledge to learn the Calm Down! gesture (if not obtained).
Cross the rocky bridge on the other side of the ledge to pick up Soporific Grease x2 and the Scavenger's Curved Sword from a camp.
steps.linkedRaw: Soporific Grease x2; Scavenger's Curved Sword

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder in the camp. At the top, you'll see two more ladders: climb the one higher up on the ledge to reach a corpse with Great Arrow x5.
Head back down and climb the other ladder to find the Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).
Climb the ladder near the merchant, then pick up Eye of Yelough x3 from the camp on the right.
On the slope north of the camp lies a corpse with Poison Grease x2.
Continue up the slope to discover the entrance to Volcano Cave:
Head inside and activate the Volcano Cave grace.
In the first room are three tunnels: go through the one on the right to find a corpse with a Golden Rune [6].
Drop down below the corpse to reach a ledge leading to a room with Arteria Leaf x3, Coil Shield, and Sliver of Meat x6.
steps.linkedRaw: Arteria Leaf x3; Coil Shield; Sliver of Meat x6

steps.instruction: In the room below the ledge is a corpse with Lump of Flesh x5.
Kill Demi-Human Queen Margot for Jar Cannon and 11,000 runes.
Return to the camp and cross the nearby bridge to grab the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.
Take the spiritspring up and kill the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast for Somber Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [6] x5, Fallingstar Beast Jaw, and 21,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast; Somber Smithing Stone [6]; Smithing Stone [6] x5; Fallingstar Beast Jaw

steps.instruction: At the edge of the crater is an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
Head toward the rocky bridge that juts out from the crater's edge. After dropping down, look beneath the bridge to find a Golden Rune [3].
Continue down the bridge and pick up a Golden Rune [7] from the small area east of it.

Note: If you haven't been to the manor yet, you can now grab the grace inside. You can also explore the outside area, which was done after accepting Rya's invitation during Carian Study Hall, looping back to the beginning of this section.
Feed Gurranq the Deathroot to receive Stone of Gurranq.
On the second floor, you'll be invaded by Inquisitor Ghiza. Kill him to obtain Ghiza's Wheel.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] at the end of the second floor room.
Speak to Tanith and agree to join the Volcano Manor to receive the Drawing-Room Key.
Reload the area to find Patches in the entrance hallway. Talk to him about himself.
Unlock the two doors on the left side of the main corridor. Pick up the Recusant Finger and Letter from Volcano Manor on the table.
steps.linkedRaw: Recusant Finger; Letter from Volcano Manor

steps.instruction: Talk to Rya in the drawing room.
Talk to Bernahl and answer that you understand.
Exhaust Diallos's dialogue in the back of the room.
Return to Tanith and talk about the letter.
Locate the Volcano Manor target marked on your map and kill Istvan for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and the Scaled Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Istvan; Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Scaled Set

steps.instruction: Talk to Tanith afterward to receive Magma Shot.
Talk to Patches to receive the Letter to Patches.
Kill Tragoth (marked on your map) for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and the Bull-Goat Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Tragoth; Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Bull-Goat Set

steps.instruction: Note: Killing Tragoth will lock you out of obtaining the Casual Greeting gesture. If you haven't gotten it yet, skip this step until you can summon him for it in Capital Outskirts.
Return to Patches and tell him the request is done. Reload the area, then ask about your reward to receive the Magma Whip Candlestick.
Pick up the new Letter from Volcano Manor on the drawing room table.
Talk to Rya about strange sounds beyond the walls.
Talk to Bernahl to unlock his inventory again. Optionally, select "Talk".
Talk to Diallos about needing time for himself. If he's not there, simply reload the area.
Reload the area, then unlock the second room on the right to discover Rya's serpentine form and talk to her.
Speak to Tanith about Zorayas's form.
Kill Rileigh (marked on your map) for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Crepus's Vial, and Black-Key Bolt x20.
steps.linkedRaw: Rileigh; Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Crepus's Vial; Black-Key Bolt x20

steps.instruction: Speak to Tanith afterward to receive the Serpentbone Blade.
Pick up the Red Letter on the drawing room table.
Talk to Bernahl to receive the Letter to Bernahl.
You don't need to talk to Diallos, but you should have heard him berating himself when you entered the room (which means he's about to relocate to Jarburg).
Talk to Jar-Bairn about the new potentate.
Talk to Diallos in a shack in Jarburg.
Reload the area five times to trigger the village attack. Talk to Jar-Bairn and the dying Diallos; it doesn't matter how you respond.
Reload the area and talk to Jar-Bairn as he collects Diallos's remains.
Reload the area again and pick up Numen's Rune, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and Diallos's Mask from the ground.
steps.linkedRaw: Numen's Rune; Hoslow's Petal Whip; Diallos's Mask

steps.instruction: Return to Volcano Manor and talk to Rya about a serpent she saw enter the neighboring room and never come out.
Speak to Tanith about Zorayas's troubles.
Unlock the room next to Rya's to find a corpse with a Perfume Bottle.
Roll into the illusory wall behind the corpse to reveal a secret path. Follow it to a room with Budding Horn x3.
Go through the southeast corridor to find a corpse with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21] at the end.
Hit the illusory wall next to the corpse to reveal a room with Depraved Perfumer Carmaan.
Head back and go down the stairs to find a Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Claws (first time) and a corpse with Fireproof Dried Liver.
Continue ahead to discover the Prison Town Church grace.
Follow the street out the door to an alcove on the right with a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
In the corner of the street, you'll see an Abductor Virgin. Climb the building in the corner to find a Smithing Stone [6] on the rooftop.
Head onto the southeast rooftops to pick up a Golden Rune [5] on a small bridge between them.
Go up the thin rooftop path near the bridge to reach a corpse with a Golden Rune [9] on the top ledge.
Drop onto the rooftop beneath the corpse, then again to a lower roof to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
Kill the Omenkiller to obtain the Great Omenkiller Cleaver (first time), then grab the Drawstring Fire Grease x3 behind him.
steps.linkedRaw: Great Omenkiller Cleaver; Drawstring Fire Grease x3

steps.instruction: Follow the passage near the Omenkiller to a cliff. Do a tight running jump at the end of the wooden staircase to reach a Stonesword Key.
Beneath the cliff lies a secluded graveyard. Loot the Smithing Stone [6] x2, Golden Rune [9], and Smoldering Shield in the graveyard.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [6] x2; Golden Rune [9]; Smoldering Shield

steps.instruction: Go up the slope past a coffin and ascend the rooftops to return to the town. Pick up a Golden Rune [6] from the burning pile of corpses.
In an open cell in the town sits a corpse with the Erdtree Seal.
Exit the town and go up the stairs on the right to find a corpse with Fire Arrow x10 below a lamppost.
Next to a chimney east of the lamppost is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Unlock the imp seal down the stairs to find the Crimson Amber Medallion +1 on a ledge.
Head around the right side of the building guarded by a Man-Serpent to pick up a Smithing Stone [4].
Climb the ladder outside the building, then drop to the lower ledge near a pit. Kill the Omenkiller inside for a Great Omenkiller Cleaver (first time).
Pick up the Albinauric Staff and Albinauric Mask from the guillotine.
Climb the ladder ahead to find a Golden Rune [10] on the balcony railing.
Jump to the roof below the balcony and go past the open door to pick up Albinauric Bloodclot from a roof between the balustrades.
Pick up the Beast Blood x2 in the room and open the shortcut door that leads back outside.
Continue inside and pick up a Golden Rune [9] beneath the stairs.
Turn left in the corridor to find a corpse with Explosive Greatbolt x5 on the balcony.
Enter the open room back inside to grab the Guest Hall grace.
Descend the ladder past the closed door, then go around the right corner to find Fireproof Dried Liver x2.
Run up the steep slope east-northeast of the corner for a Somber Smithing Stone [6] on the rooftop.
Grab a Golden Rune [9] from the structure surrounded by slugs in the lava.
Head toward the roof with a spire northeast of the structure, and follow the thin roof west to reach the Smithing Stone [6] x2 at the end.
Go up the slope in the area to find two caged lifts: take the south one down and grab the Smoldering Butterfly x6 in a cavern.
Kill the Magma Wyrm erupting from the lava for a Dragon Heart.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [7] from the innermost part of the cavern.
Take the other lift up. Notice the item on the right-hand edge; you'll come back for it soon. Turn left at the top of the stairs to grab a shortcut back to the grace.
Kill the Godskin Noble for Godskin Stitcher, Noble Presence, and 50,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Godskin Noble; Godskin Stitcher; Noble Presence

steps.instruction: Activate the Temple of Eiglay grace and grab the Serpent's Amnion from the altar.
Head back down the stairs to pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [5] you noticed earlier.
Drop down to a ledge below the corpse and follow it to an area with several bats. Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x5 next to a cage.
Descend the tunnel in the cliffside to reach a structure deep in the cave, where you'll find the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber grace.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [4] and Smithing Stone [6] from the lava-filled area below the grace.
Fall through the cracked floor in the cave and kill the two Abductor Virgins for Inquisitor's Girandole and 10,000 runes.
Grab the Abductor Virgin grace in the tunnel past the boss.
Tell Rya about the dark side of Volcano Manor, then give her the Serpent's Amnion.
Reload the area, then speak to Tanith about Zorayas's absence. Talk to her again to receive the Tonic of Forgetfulness.
Use the lift near the Temple of Eiglay grace and pick up a Golden Rune [9] from the arcaded corridor.
Jump off the balcony past the corridor, then turn around to find a Golden Rune [12] against the manor wall.
Pick up the Smoldering Butterfly x4 surrounded by slugs, then the Furlcalling Finger Remedy at the edge of a cliff.
steps.linkedRaw: Smoldering Butterfly x4; Furlcalling Finger Remedy

steps.instruction: Continue until you reach an Abductor Virgin and jump through the window nearby. Descend the ladder in the room to find Drawstring Fire Grease x4.
Open the cell at the bottom of the room to pick up Missionary's Cookbook [6].
Open the door at the top of the room, then take a left up the stairs to discover a shortcut lift. Send it down without riding it.
Return to the door you just opened, then look below the south balustrade to find a ledge with the Crimson Tear Scarab.
Use the shortcut lift at the bottom while facing northwest and roll off mid-ride to reach a room with a Stonesword Key.
Go out the window and kill the scarab around the corner for a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Follow the narrow path below the winged-serpent statues to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [6] at the end, guarded by five Basilisks.
Return to the scarab and go through the other window to find Rya. You'll now be faced with three options:
Give Tonic of Forgetfulness:
Tell Tanith that you gave Rya the potion.
After killing Rykard and all NPCs in the manor have left, talk to Rya in the drawing room.
Reload the area and pick up Daedicar's Woe from the floor.
Kill her:
Rya turns back into a snake and drops Daedicar's Woe.
Tell Tanith that Zorayas is dead.
Do nothing:
After killing Rykard, exhaust her dialogue without giving her the tonic.
Reload the area to find Zorayas's Letter and Daedicar's Woe at her spot.
Climb the ladder past Rya and pick up the Commoner's Headband on a winged-serpent statue.
Open the door ahead and pick up Man-Serpent Ashes from the altar.
Note: At the east end of the room is a sending gate to Rykard. Avoid it for now, as killing him will end all manor questlines and lock you out of several rewards.
Unlock the imp seal at the opposite side. Drop onto a lower ledge to the right of the door, then go up the stairs to reach the Dagger Talisman.
Drop down below the talisman to reach a Rune Arc.
At the bottom, pick up Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve in front of a fireplace at the northeast end of the room, then open the shortcut back to the manor.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve

links.label: Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve

steps.instruction: Pick up a Seedbed Curse from the chair at the southwest end of the room.
Go up the nearby stairs and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the broken balustrade, behind an Abductor Virgin.
Talk to Dung Eater to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key.
Ascend the massive staircase near the Altus Highway Junction and run past the duo boss to grab the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace.
Pick up the 2x Golden Seed around the tree and the Map: Leyndell, Royal Capital from the stele in the back.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Seed; Map: Leyndell, Royal Capital

steps.instruction: Kill the two Tree Sentinels you ran past for Erdtree Greatshield, Hero's Rune [1] and 20,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Tree Sentinels; Erdtree Greatshield; Hero's Rune [1]

steps.instruction: At the fork southeast of the grace, follow the right path to a camp and kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit there for a Golden Seed.
Loot the chest in the carriage to obtain the Giant-Crusher.
Return to the fork and pick up Holy Grease x2 from the stone platform guarded by wolves.
Follow the uphill path to a church and pick up the Missionary's Cookbook [4] next to a large pot.
Grab the Minor Erdtree Church grace and the Golden Order Seal at the base of the tree.
steps.linkedRaw: Minor Erdtree Church; Golden Order Seal

steps.instruction: Talk to Melina at the Minor Erdtree Church grace to learn the Outer Order gesture.
Note: If you rested at a grace in the capital and she left, you won't be able to complete this step until you reunite with her at the end of Leyndell.
Down the slope northeast of the church, you'll find a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x3.
Return to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree and head down to the moat east of the grace. Kill the invisible scarab in the moat for Ash of War: Prayerful Strike.
At the south end of the moat lies the entrance to Sealed Tunnel:
Head inside and grab the Sealed Tunnel grace.
Hit the illusory wall next to the campfire, then pick up a Golden Rune [5] from the wooden platform in the middle.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the northeast corner, then loot the chest at the opposite side for the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2].
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [5]; Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]

steps.instruction: Hit the illusory wall behind the chest, then do a running jump to the left of the lift to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
Hit the illusory wall at the bottom to reveal a Golden Rune [5].
Past a third illusory wall, descend the ladder to the bottom and bait the Abductor Virgin into destroying the statue to obtain Smithing Stone [6] x3.
Loot the Furlcalling Finger Remedy x3, Golden Rune [1], and Rune Arc in the middle, then grab a Somber Smithing Stone [5] from the wall.
steps.linkedRaw: Furlcalling Finger Remedy x3; Golden Rune [1]; Rune Arc; Somber Smithing Stone [5]

steps.instruction: Head back up the ladder and drop onto the wooden platform below a root for a side tunnel with a Stonesword Key at the end.
Pick up a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot when crossing the lower root.
After dropping down in the next room, turn around to pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the wall.
Grab the Grace Mimic x5 beneath the staircase, then the Smithing Stone [5] on the ground next to it.
Pick up Large Glintstone Scrap x3 and Old Fang x2 from the upper part of the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Large Glintstone Scrap x3; Old Fang x2

steps.instruction: Hit the illusory wall in the room and drop down two roots to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
At the top of the large root, do a running jump to reach a ledge with Lightning Grease x4.
Grab the Golden Rune [9] at the bottom, but be wary of the explosive sentry stones.
Kill the Onyx Lord for Onyx Lord's Greatsword and 16,000 runes.
Continue past the boss to discover the Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate grace.
steps.linkedRaw: Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate

links.label: Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate

steps.instruction: Travel to the Outer Wall Phantom Tree and head up the stairs until you're ambushed by a Valiant Gargoyle that drops the Gargoyle's Great Axe.
Continue up the stairs and loot the 2x Golden Seed around the golden tree.
On the balustrade to the left of the stairs past the tree is a teleporting scarab that drops Ash of War: Golden Parry.
Pick up Lost Ashes of War from the corpse at the top of the stairs.
Kill the Wandering Noble carrying a chest on the slope east-northeast of the golden tree for a Golden Rune [12] (first time).
Turn left at the top of the slope to find a Golden Rune [5] guarded by two bats.
Continue along the left side of the battlefield to discover the Outer Wall Battleground grace.
Talk to Melina at the Outer Wall Battleground grace.
Head down the hillside south-southwest of the grace to be ambushed by Margit. Defeat him to obtain the Viridian Amber Medallion +1.
On a catapult in the camp northwest of where you fought Margit sits a corpse with Arteria Leaf x3.
Kill the Operatic Bat in the camp farther southwest for a Golden Rune [9] (first time) and grab the Golden Rune [10] in the nearby pit.
Jump from the cliff edge southwest of the camp onto a gravestone with Old Fang x3.
Pick up the Rainbow Stone x4 and Golden Rune [4] near the gravestones.
Return to the Outer Wall Battleground grace and grab the Golden Rune [7] just east of it.
Under a tent farther east sits a corpse with Mushroom x8.
Go up the stairs by the cliff wall, then head south-southeast toward a Sword Monument. If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, pick up Spectral Steed Regalia: Funereal Night from one of the swords.
From the Sword Monument, continue east to find a Golden Rune [2] by two large gravestones.
Return to the top of the stairs, then take the first left to a corpse with Grace Mimic x3.
Pick up the Drawstring Holy Grease x3 behind a large gravestone near the cliff, then grab the Smithing Stone [5] next to the path.
steps.linkedRaw: Drawstring Holy Grease x3; Smithing Stone [5]

steps.instruction: Follow along the path to discover the Hermit Merchant's Shack grace outside a shack.
Talk to the Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts) in the shack and buy the Sentry's Torch.
Rest until nightfall and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter in the shack for Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing and 20,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Bell Bearing Hunter; Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing

steps.instruction: Follow the rocky cliff edge east of the grace to a corpse on the cliff with a Golden Rune [10].
Between two large gravestones on the opposite side of the path is a Golden Rune [5].
While it's still nighttime, follow the path eastward toward the Minor Erdtree and kill the Deathbird for Twinbird Kite Shield and 29,000 runes.
Pick up the Winged Crystal Tear from the basin behind the Deathbird.
Return to the path and follow it downhill to find a Golden Rune [4] beside a large gravestone.
Continue downhill, take a left at the fork, then follow the road east toward some Archer Golems. Pick up Great Arrow x10 from a rock on the right side.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the rock on the left side of the road.
Head up the slope that leads to the Minor Erdtree and pick up Twiggy Cracked Tear and Crimson Crystal Tear from the basin in front of it.
steps.linkedRaw: Twiggy Cracked Tear; Crimson Crystal Tear

steps.instruction: At the bottom of the slope is a downhill path that leads to the outer moat, where you'll find a Golden Rune [6].
Talk to Blackguard near the moat. Select "You should probably know...", then talk about the Dung Eater.
Follow the path at the opposite end of the moat to reach Auriza Hero's Grave:
Take the lift down and grab the Auriza Hero's Grave grace.
Unlock the imp seal to access a room with the Golden Epitaph.
Run past the chariot and pick up Fan Daggers x5 from the opposite side of the hole. Standing between the pillars is safe.
Drop down the hole for a Grave Glovewort [6] guarded by multiple Basilisks.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [5] and Grave Glovewort [5] on the way to a larger room with two chariots.
Turn left as you reach the room with two chariots to pick up a Stonesword Key and a Ghost Glovewort [6].
Note: You can just use Margit's Shackle in this spot to destroy all the chariots, bypassing the entire challenge of the dungeon.
Head down, alternating between the two chariots, and pick up the Grave Glovewort [6] in the middle.
Grab the Golden Rune [7] at the bottom. Standing between the pillar and the wall is safe.
Once the chariot turns, quickly drop onto a wooden beam below the rune to reach a corpse with Holy Grease x2.
At the top of the slanted beam below is an area with the Vulgar Militia Ashes and a Grave Glovewort [5].
Head back and drop onto the stone beams, then climb a ladder to an area with a chariot. At the top is a room with a fire-breathing pillar and a Grave Glovewort [6].
At the bottom of the area, enter the room straight ahead to pick up the Crucible Feather Talisman.
Take the lift in the other room to a pillar and hit it until it stretches tall and shines light through the window. Grab the Great Dragonfly Head x3 and Grave Glovewort [6] around the corner.
steps.linkedRaw: Great Dragonfly Head x3; Grave Glovewort [6]

steps.instruction: If you aligned the pillar correctly, all chariots should be destroyed, giving you Ash of War: Holy Ground and the Tree Sentinel Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Holy Ground; Tree Sentinel Set

steps.instruction: Kill the two Crucible Knights for Ordovis's Greatsword, Crucible Axe Set and 28,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Crucible Knights; Ordovis's Greatsword; Crucible Axe Set

steps.instruction: Return to the entrance and bait the Runebear by the cliff into attacking the statue near the path to obtain Smithing Stone [6] x2.
Head toward the cliff edge to discover the entrance to Auriza Side Tomb:
Note: If you chose Cracked Pot as your keepsake, the two rooms with 2x Cracked Pots will each have only 1 instead.
Head inside and grab the Auriza Side Tomb grace.
Proceed into the first room for a Grave Glovewort [6].
Jump out the window or open the chest ahead; both lead to the next room, where you'll find a Grave Glovewort [6] (below the stairs) and a Grave Glovewort [5].
Continue to a room with a chest at the end of a carpet. Open it to be transported to an area with 2x Cracked Pot and Perfumer's Cookbook [3].
Hit the illusory wall in the previous room to reveal a Grave Glovewort [5] and a chest.
Open the chest to be taken to an identical version of the dungeon, which I'll refer to as layout B. After entering layout B, grab the Golden Rune [7] on the upper ledge.

Drop down and open the chest past the illusory wall to reach layout A's upper ledge. Climb the ladder there to a chest that takes you to the start of layout B, then continue to a room with a Ritual Pot and a Smithing Stone [5].
Jump out the window to remain in layout B, then enter the room behind you after landing to find a Ritual Pot and Root Resin x2.
Like earlier, look below the stairs to find a Grave Glovewort [6].
Open the chest at the end of the carpet to pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] and 2x Cracked Pot.
Climb the ladder in the area to reach a Grave Glovewort [6] and the boss lever.
Open the chest up the stairs, then kill the Grave Warden Duelist for Soldjars of Fortune Ashes and 15,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Warden Duelist; Soldjars of Fortune Ashes

steps.instruction: Return to the entrance and follow the right-side wall to a spiritspring. Use it while facing southwest to reach a corpse with Gravity Stone Fan x3.
Use the spiritspring while facing north to land behind the Golems. Head uphill to the boss, then around the rampart's ledge to find a Gravel Stone.
Kill the Draconic Tree Sentinel for Dragon Greatclaw, Dragonclaw Shield, and 50,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Draconic Tree Sentinel; Dragon Greatclaw; Dragonclaw Shield

steps.instruction: This is your last chance to summon Great Horned Tragoth for the Casual Greeting gesture if you haven't obtained it and didn't kill him during Volcano Manor.
Millicent can also be summoned if you spoke to her at Windmill Heights.
Grab the Capital Rampart grace on the rampart past the boss.
Ride the lift past the grace and grab the Magic Grease x3 in the corridor.
Pick up a Furlcalling Finger Remedy from the altar in the church room.
Continue forward until you reach the East Capital Rampart grace.
Talk to Melina at the East Capital Rampart grace.
Boc will show up at the East Capital Rampart after resting there. You'll have a few options to finish his questline:
Give him a Larval Tear:
Talk to him and select "Have you ever thought so?", then give him a Larval Tear.
Talk to him and select "Please wait".
Interact with him in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library, then reload the area to find him dead.
Use Prattling Pate "You're beautiful":
Use it in front of him, then select "I heard a voice" and answer "That's right". He'll remain there for the rest of the playthrough, altering your garments for free.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about the unlocated demigods.
From the East Capital Rampart, follow the rampart to a Golden Rune [10] guarded by a large Oracle Envoy.
Turn left down the stairs to discover a side room with a Smithing Stone [4].
Follow the side path to a room with Cave Moss x10 behind a folding screen.
The top of the room leads back up to the Gargoyle. Pick up the Golden Rune [7] it's guarding.
Back at the bottom floor, take the lift down to a room with a ladder and Preserving Boluses.
Climb the ladder and open the chest behind a table to obtain a Perfume Bottle.
Go up the stairs to find a Seedbed Curse on a corpse strapped to a chair.
Head out the balcony below with the two Perfumers to find the Upper-Class Robe at the end.
Jump to the rooftop near the start of the balcony, then onto the north rooftop to find a Smithing Stone [5].
From the rooftop near the balcony, drop down southwest for a Smithing Stone [6] guarded by a Page playing music.
Break the wooden crates at the end of the hallway to find a corpse with Miranda Powder x10.
In the other room you'll find a Golden Rune [10] and Warming Stone x5.
Exit either room and head down the road. Turn left when you see a resting Leyndell Knight to pick up Fan Daggers x8.
When you reach the main street, head along the left side to find an alley with Old Fang x3, guarded by dogs.
Pick up Gold Firefly x3 from an alcove on the right side of the street.
Run past the Erdtree Avatar and take the first right to grab the Avenue Balcony grace down some stairs.
Kill the Erdtree Avatar to obtain a Lord's Rune.
Jump onto the fallen carriage to pick up some Holy Grease.
Go up the first set of stairs next to the carriage and pick up the Smithing Stone [4] behind a chalice in the gazebo.
Continue up the second set of stairs. Behind a pillar in the alleyway past two Leyndell Soldiers, you'll find a Golden Rune [8].
Explore the southeast part of the road first. Rush down the Gargoyle and grab a Somber Smithing Stone [5], Golden Rune [8], and Golden Rune [11] from the corpses.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [5]; Golden Rune [8]; Golden Rune [11]

steps.instruction: Head back and explore the other part of the road. Take a left at the tree to find Lordsworn's Bolt x10 behind a building.
Pick up Gravel Stone x2 and a Golden Rune [13] from the two corpses along the fences.
Behind the gazebo is a corpse with Tarnished Golden Sunflower x8.
Kill the Elder Lion behind an empty fountain for a Somber Smithing Stone [6], Beast Blood, and Old Fang x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [6]; Beast Blood; Old Fang x2

steps.instruction: Grab a Golden Rune [10] and Hero's Rune [2] from the corpses past the fountain.
Return to the gazebo and jump onto the lower one below a gap in the fence to grab the Stonesword Key on top.
Head down the sewer tunnel near the gazebo and kick down the shortcut ladder at the end.
From the gazebo, head southwest and behind a staircase to find a Golden Rune [8].
Loot the Golden Rune [8], Golden Rune [12], and Lightningproof Dried Liver x2 on the stairs at the end of the main street.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [8]; Golden Rune [12]; Lightningproof Dried Liver x2

steps.instruction: Pick up a Golden Rune [9] behind the upright carriage on the main street.
Enter the east room in the nearby courtyard and grab the Golden Rune [9] and Hero's Rune [5], guarded by a Crucible Knight.
Use the lift farther inside to open a shortcut back to the beginning. Run along the rampart once more and drop down to the rooftops below the Gargoyle to find a Golden Rune [9] on the fifth roof.
There is an item below the fifth rooftop, but don't drop down yet. Instead, continue across the roofs for a Golden Rune [12] on the rooftop at the end.
Pick up a Stonesword Key from the nearby rooftop with two Imps.
Jump back across and drop down below the fifth rooftop to grab a Smithing Stone [6] in front of a stone planter.
Pick up a Golden Rune [9] from the railing, then jump over it to grab the Imp Head (Corpse) directly below it.
Take the first left in the alley to find a corpse with Arteria Leaf x2 between two buildings.
Return to the courtyard across the street and ride the lift in the west room to a small town. Loot the Golden Rune [9], Gravel Stone, Smithing Stone [4], and Stonesword Key around the town.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [9]; Gravel Stone; Smithing Stone [4]; Stonesword Key

steps.instruction: Go back to the lift and head across the rooftops to find a corpse with the Black Bow.
Jump to the rooftop at the end to reach a Golden Rune [12].
Drop down to pick up a Stonesword Key and Clarifying Boluses from the barrel room.
Climb the ladder in the barrel room to open a shortcut to the Avenue Balcony grace.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the ash-covered area across the town bridge for a Golden Seed.
Pick up Golden Arrow x15 and Smithing Stone [6] from the ash-covered area.
Enter the room near the bridge to find a Cracked Pot in front of a barred window.
Climb the short ladder past the room and activate the Lower Capital Church grace in the church.
Pick up Lionel's Set and Deathbed Dress from the bed.
Kill the Omenkiller nearby for the Omensmirk Mask (first time) and grab the Smithing Stone [6] he's guarding.
Descend the short ladder and head northeast through the sewer tunnels to pick up Hefty Beast Bone and a Golden Rune [8].
At the dead end farther northeast is a corpse with the Guilty Hood.
Take the left path when exploring the other side of the tunnels to find Poisonbone Dart x8.
Go through the nearby side path to pick up Lost Ashes of War and be ambushed by a large Fingercreeper that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [4] (first time).
steps.linkedRaw: Lost Ashes of War; Somber Smithing Stone [4]

steps.instruction: Head back and loot String x4 from a corpse in the sewer tunnel.
Drop down by the Gargoyle around the corner to pick up Fan Daggers x5, Erdsteel Dagger, and Holyproof Dried Liver.
steps.linkedRaw: Fan Daggers x5; Erdsteel Dagger; Holyproof Dried Liver

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder, then go down the stairs below the dragon's wing to find a Somber Smithing Stone [6] behind a ruined building.
Head back and grab the Dragonwound Grease in front of the closed gate.
Pick up a Golden Rune [9] from the left-side fence, where a Leyndell Knight is patrolling.
There is a gap in the fence beneath Gransax's wing. Drop onto the roof below it and grab the Albinauric Bloodclot near a well.
Kill the scarab in the middle of the area to obtain Ash of War: Thunderbolt.
Go through the narrow corridor in the area to find Pickled Turtle Neck x3.
Retrace your steps to discover a Smithing Stone [5] on the opposite side.
Hop down the well to find a Rune Arc at the bottom.
Open the sewer gate and pick up Poisonbone Dart x6 at the end of the long tunnel.
Open the door to Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Head down and grab the Underground Roadside grace in the open room for later.
Travel to the Avenue Balcony grace and pick up the Smithing Stone [6] in the corner behind the staircase.
Go down the stairs and climb Gransax's wing to reach a corpse with a Rune Arc.
Climb the ladder and pick up Gravel Stone x5 from a corpse at the top of the stairs.
Pick up a Golden Rune [11], then grab the West Capital Rampart grace just past it.
Head down the staircase in the middle to find the Cane Sword next to it.
Grab a Golden Rune [9] from the balcony and pull the lever to open the shortcut gate below.
From the opposite side of the lever, drop onto one of the stables and kill the spear-wielding Leyndell Knight to obtain the Gravel Stone Seal (first time).
Pick up Old Fang x5 from one of the stables, then grab the Gravel Stone x3 in a corner below Gransax.
steps.linkedRaw: Old Fang x5; Gravel Stone x3

steps.instruction: Climb Gransax's left foot, then from the top of a stable, jump to the wooden structure to reach a Smithing Stone [6] and a Stonesword Key.
Enter the Fortified Manor and kill Vargram (marked on your map) for the Raging Wolf Set.
Loot Alberich's Set from the corpse at the end of the hall.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [5] behind some weapon racks in the room past the doorway.
Grab the Fortified Manor, First Floor grace and the "Flightless Bird" Painting in the next room.
steps.linkedRaw: Fortified Manor, First Floor; "Flightless Bird" Painting

steps.instruction: Go through the open door in the hall to find the Two Fingers' Prayerbook and Black-Key Bolt x20 by a fireplace.
steps.linkedRaw: Two Fingers' Prayerbook; Black-Key Bolt x20

steps.instruction: Open the closed door in the hall and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [6] at the end of the cloister.
Loot Nascent Butterfly x3 and a Stormhawk Axe from the corpses in the garth.
Activate the shortcut lift in the garth, though you've probably reached that area from Weeping Peninsula.
Explore the southeast area outside the manor and pick up a Golden Rune [9] from the wooden structure near a large root.
Enter the upper part of the manor and pick up the Sanctified Whetblade and Hammer from the blacksmith's room.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] on the nearby staircase.
In the bedroom, you'll find the By My Sword gesture and a Hero's Rune [1].
Grab the Rune Arc on the round table and the Smithing Stone [5] on the balcony.
Open the door to the audience room and pick up the Coded Sword on the throne.
Enter the study to find a Furlcalling Finger Remedy in front of the fireplace.
Pick up the Seedbed Curse in the library. If not picked up before killing Maliketh, you'll find it outside near Gransax's feet instead.
Travel to West Capital Rampart and kill the Valiant Gargoyle past the grace for the Gargoyle's Halberd.
Pick up the Golden Seed, then go down the stairs for a Smithing Stone [6] on the ledge.
Head toward the colosseum and take the first left up the slope to find Corhyn. Talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
On the cliff edge farther south sits a corpse with a Smithing Stone [5].
Pick up the Star Fist from a nearby alcove in the colosseum.
In front of the colosseum entrance is a corpse with the Ritual Shield Talisman.
Enter the colosseum to access it from the Marika statue in Roundtable Hold.
Pick up a Furlcalling Finger Remedy from an alcove just west of the entrance.
Head toward the large root and follow it down to an area with Miranda Sprouts. Pick up a Smithing Stone [6] from the broken bridge.
Cimb the root to the top, then follow a branch down to find Holy Grease x3 around the corner of the roof.
Defeat Godfrey, First Elden Lord for a Talisman Pouch and 80,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Godfrey, First Elden Lord; Talisman Pouch

steps.instruction: Activate the Erdtree Sanctuary grace after the fight.
Exit east and pick up Holy Grease x6 from the gazebo on the right.
Climb the root near the other gazebo, then turn left as you exit the upper room to drop onto the roof. Go through the window to find a chest with the Erdtree Bow.
Through the doorway is a corpse with a Celestial Dew and a ladder you can kick down.
Grab the Golden Order Principia from a chair hanging above the root inside.
Give Miriel the Golden Order Principia, then buy Law of Regression for 10,000 runes.
Exhaust Miriel's dialogue about Radagon for a hint about the next step.

Reach 37 Intelligence to cast Law of Regression by stacking intelligence-boosting gear: Stargazer Heirloom (5), Marika's Scarseal (3), Twinsage Glintstone Crown (6). Activate Godrick's Great Rune (5) and add Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear to your Physick flask (10). If that's not enough, equip the Grafted Blade Greatsword and use its skill (5).
From the Erdtree Sanctuary, turn right before the west exit to find Somber Smithing Stone [5] x3 around the corner.
Take the lift down the west exit, and use Law of Regression in front of the Radagon statue (stand near the message, or it won't work).
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, approach the newly revealed Marika statue to be invaded by The Noble Broken Mask. Kill him for the Golden Order Flail and the Broken Mask's Set.
steps.linkedRaw: The Noble Broken Mask; Golden Order Flail; Broken Mask's Set

steps.instruction: Pick up Holy Grease x5 from the corpse in front of a tree.
Kill the invisible scarab up ahead to obtain Barrier of Gold.
Jump over the railing above the giant spear and pick up Bolt of Gransax from the top of the spear.
Interact with Goldmask near the colosseum and tell him that Radagon is Marika to learn the Golden Order Totality gesture.
Talk to Corhyn afterward to unlock Immutable Shield for sale. Optionally, talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Farm the two Duelists near the colosseum until you obtain the Duelist Greataxe, Battle Hammer, and Duelist Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Duelist Greataxe; Battle Hammer; Duelist Set

steps.instruction: Farm the full bloom Guardians on the roots outside the Erdtree Santuary until you obtain the Guardian Garb (Full Bloom).
Climb the root east from the Erdtree Sanctuary, then cross the bridge to grab the Queen's Bedchamber grace and Blessing of the Erdtree.
steps.linkedRaw: Queen's Bedchamber; Blessing of the Erdtree

steps.instruction: Kill Morgott, the Omen King for Morgott's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Omen King, and 120,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Morgott, the Omen King; Morgott's Great Rune; Remembrance of the Omen King

steps.instruction: Melina's summon sign can be found at the top of the stairs.
Exhaust the dying Morgott's dialogue.
Touch the wall of thorns blocking access to the Erdtree, then grab the Elden Throne grace.
Rest at the grace to reunite with Melina and receive the Rold Medallion.
Talk to Melina at the Queen's Bedchamber grace.
Tell Enia that you want to burn the impenetrable thorns, then ask how to burn thorns.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir and ask him where you should go.
After asking Enia how to burn thorns, talk to Melina at any site of grace.
Exhaust Nepheli's dialogue in Stormveil Castle's throne room to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone (you may need to reload the area a few times).
Talk to Kenneth Haight beside the throne.
Exhaust Gostoc's dialogue in the back and buy the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone for 20,000 runes.
Talk to Bernahl in Volcano Manor to receive Gelmir's Fury.
Travel to Windmill Heights and head south-southeast to find Fire's Deadly Sin at the corner of the cliff (painting reward).
From the Underground Roadside, pick up a Golden Rune [11] and two pieces of the Bloodsoaked Set in the first room.
Descend the nearby ladder to find Freezing Grease on a wooden platform.
Jump onto the pipe for a corpse with Serpent Arrow x10.
Continue up the pipes to pick up Fire Grease x5 (you'll be ambushed by several Imps).
Follow the pipe down to a Somber Smithing Stone [6], then pick up the Smithing Stone [7] hanging off the wooden ledge at the end.
Drop onto a lower pipe below the wooden ledge to reach the bottom, then pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7] and Smithing Stone [7] x2 from the long side of the room.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [7]; Smithing Stone [7] x2

steps.instruction: Pick up Glass Shard x5 in front of a tube, then kill the scarab inside it for a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
steps.linkedRaw: Glass Shard x5; Somber Smithing Stone [7]

steps.instruction: Grab the Smithing Stone [7] x2 and Mohg's Shackle at the end of the room.
Go through the crack in the wall to enter Leyndell Catacombs:
Turn right before the lift to grab the Leyndell Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] from a corpse up two sets of stairs.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar and use it to reach a room with the Crucible Scale Talisman.
Head up the other path to find a Grave Glovewort [9] next to an Omen.
Pick up a Golden Rune [11] from the ledge at the end, then drop down for a Grave Glovewort [8] on top of a coffin.
Note: There may be a bug where the Golden Rune doesn't appear consistently for some players. If it's missing, try reloading the area or coming back later.
Head northwest first, then up some stairs to reach a room with Root Resin x4.
Go through the boss door to pick up a Ghost Glovewort [8] and a Golden Rune [11].
Head back and follow the other path. Ignore the fire-breathing pillar this time and go up the stairs instead for a Grave Glovewort [8].
Drop down at the end of the room again, then go up the stairs to pick up a Grave Glovewort [8].
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] in front of a statue, then a Grave Glovewort [9] where the pillar usually is.
Jump through the window and ride the pillar you ignored earlier to reach a ledge with Sacramental Bud x2 and the boss lever.
Kill Esgar, Priest of Blood for Lord of Blood's Exultation and 30,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Esgar, Priest of Blood; Lord of Blood's Exultation

steps.instruction: Use the lift outside the catacombs and pick up the Haligdrake Talisman +1 beside a Spiritcaller Snail past two illusory walls below the staircase.
Grab the Golden Rune [11] up the stairs, then pull the shortcut lever.
Go up the stairs to pick up Shadow Bait, then open a shortcut gate back to the first room.
Drop down the hole at the end of the first room to find a corpse with Preserving Boluses.
Pick up the Furlcalling Finger Remedy in the corner, then climb the ladder past the Miranda Blossoms for a Rune Arc.
Kill the large Fingercreeper in the ground for a Somber Smithing Stone [7] (first time), then pick up Lost Ashes of War from the corpse it's guarding.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [7]; Lost Ashes of War

steps.instruction: Unlock the cell and tell Dung Eater to leave his gaol.
Head back past the Miranda Blossoms and go through the pipe in the corridor. Drop down the hole to discover a room with a Stonesword Key.
Go through the tunnel past the door to end up on the other side of the hole. Pick up the Glass Shard in the corner.
Drop down a second hole, then kill the Revenant in the room for a Ghost Glovewort [6] (first time).
Loot the Grave Violet x5 and Smithing Stone [7] in the room.
Take the first right as you go through the tunnel to pick up Rainbow Stone Arrow (Fletched) x10 next to the second hole.
Past the barred doorway, take the first right to find a corpse with Fireproof Dried Liver.
At the end of the pipe, pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] guarded by three Omens in succession.
Climb the ladder to grab a Smithing Stone [7] in front of the statue. Pull the lever to unlock a shortcut gate back to the first room.
Open the door to a circular staircase with a Grace Mimic at the bottom.
Drop down from the top of the staircase, then kill the scarab to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Pick up the String down the stairs and the Warming Stone in the corner.
Go through the corridor to find a ladder and a corpse with Fire Grease x2.
Guarded by three Basilisks behind the Miranda Blossom is a corpse with Poisoned Stone x8.
Pick up Nomad Ashes from the ledge, but be wary of the Basilisk ambush.
Head back up the ladder past the Miranda Blossom to find a corpse with Preserving Boluses next to the stairs.
Go through the pipes until you come to a room with an Omen. Kill it to obtain Omen Bairn (first time).
Loot Glass Shard x4, Golden Centipede x2 and Dappled White Cured Meat from the four corpses.
steps.linkedRaw: Glass Shard x4; Golden Centipede x2; Dappled White Cured Meat

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder to reach a corpse with Poisoned Stone x3 and a shortcut back to the first room.
Climb the pipe opposite the shortcut door, then drop down at the end to pick up the Golden Rune [10] on a wooden ledge.
Kick down the ladder in the next room. Jump down the hole in the pipe below, then head southwest until you reach a Golden Rune [8].
Continue northwest toward the end of the pipe to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x4.
Retrace your steps and follow the tunnel with a Cerulean Tear Scarab near a barred doorway. Take the first left to find an Eye of Yelough at the end.
Follow the other tunnel to a doorway with a Warming Stone to the left of it, then grab the Smithing Stone [8] past it.
Return to where you dropped down and explore the other part of the pipe to find a corpse with a Golden Rune [11].
Don't drop down past the corpse. Go down the left tunnel instead to drop down the hole there, then turn around to pick up a Smithing Stone [5] and open the shortcut door.
Descend the ladder ahead and pick up the Ritual Pot guarded by several Living Jars.
Ride the lift to the bottom and grab the Forsaken Depths grace.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] on the way to the boss.
Kill Mohg, the Omen for Bloodflame Talons and 100,000 runes.
Dung Eater can be summoned if you released him from his cell and haven't dealt with his invasion yet.
Rest at the Cathedral of the Forsaken grace and talk to Melina.
Open the chest near the grace to obtain Erdtree's Favor +1.
Hit the altar behind the chest to reveal a secret path. Cross the plank to find a corpse with Grace Mimic x5.
Bait the Nomad into attacking the nearby tent to reveal a corpse with the Nomadic Merchant's Set.
Note: The tents can also be destroyed manually by standing next to them, then quitting and reloading the game.
Go down the stairs and pick up Eye of Yelough x5 from a breakable tent.
Grab the Golden Rune [11] at the bottom of a plank, then drop to the lower plank and pick up the Frenzied's Cookbook [2] at the top of it.
Pick up Hefty Beast Bone x3 from the corpse next a coffin.
Descend the coffins in the wall below the Nomad playing music to reach a coffin with Inescapable Frenzy. [See video]
Grab the Fingerprint Stone Shield around the corner and pick up Note: Miquella's Needle from the breakable tent.
steps.linkedRaw: Fingerprint Stone Shield; Note: Miquella's Needle

steps.instruction: Head down the stairs, then drop to the bottom to discover the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace.
Note: Don't interact with anything here, as doing so can lock you into a bad ending. It's better to return when choosing an ending after beating the game.
Talk to Melina at the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace.
Roll through the illusory wall near Hyetta to reveal a chest with a Rune Arc.
Behind the chest is another illusory wall, which leads to the Root-Facing Cliffs grace.
Kill the large-bellied ant on a lower cliff past the grace for a Numen's Rune and a Rune Arc.
On a lower root below the grace sits a corpse with a Smithing Stone [6].
Make your way down the roots to pick up Formic Rock from a corpse next to an ant.
On a lower root northwest of the corpse is a Golden Rune [8].
Continue down the roots, then double jump to a higher up root with a Golden Rune [8] at the tip.
On the ground below the three ants to the south lies a Golden Rune [5].
Drop onto the large root and pick up Golden Arrow x10 from the second branch on the left.
Talk to Roderika about the spirit's voices.
Read the message at Dung Eater's location in the library.
Talk to Blackguard near the outer moat about the Dung Eater.
Reload the area and exhaust Blackguards dialogue to obtain a Seedbed Curse, Blackguard's Bell Bearing, Iron Ball and Blackguard's Iron Mask.
steps.linkedRaw: Seedbed Curse; Blackguard's Bell Bearing; Iron Ball; Blackguard's Iron Mask

steps.instruction: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Braggart's Roar. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Kill Dung Eater after he invades to obtain the Sword of Milos.
Return to Roderika and select "Please take care".
Exhaust Dung Eater's dialogue in the library.
Reload the area and talk to Roderika about the spirits' voices.
Open the large door at the northeast end of the main street in Leyndell. Explore the area covered in ash to find Beast Blood x3.
Behind a building in the ash-covered area lies a Golden Rune [9].
Pick up Lightningproof Dried Liver from the corpse behind a carriage.
At the end of the ash-covered area, you'll find a Perfume Bottle.
Take a left when going up the stairs to find a corpse with Soporific Grease x2.
Behind a statue down the slope is a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Pick up Exalted Flesh and Nascent Butterfly x3 from the corpses by the stairs.
Take the lift up and grab the Flamedrake Talisman +1 in front of the left brazier.
Pick up Invigorating White Cured Meat from the corpse on the bridge.
Kill the scarab behind a broken statue to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Instead of using the lift at the end, explore the southeast bridge. When the area turns dark, grab the Golden Rune [9] in front.
Kill the Fell Twins for Omenkiller Rollo and 29,000 runes.
Activate the Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate grace outside the tower, then grab the Divine Tower of East Altus grace at the top.
steps.linkedRaw: Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate; Divine Tower of East Altus

links.label: Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate

steps.instruction: Interact with the rune at the top of the tower to restore the power of Morgott's Great Rune.
Return to the lift between the bridges and use it while facing southwest, then jump to a ledge with the Official's Attire.
Pick up the Blade of Calling from a table behind the door.
Drop down and head outside to grab the Forbidden Lands grace, then pass time until nightfall.
In the corner west of the grace sits a corpse with Drawstring Fire Grease x2.
Follow the cliff edge on the right to find a Golden Rune [7] on top of a fallen pillar.
Climb the nearby rock wall with a giant skull to find Dragonwound Grease on a pillar.
Kill the Night's Cavalry for Ash of War: Phantom Slash and 36,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Phantom Slash

steps.instruction: Continue until you see a golden tree in the distance, then turn right to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] in the mouth of a giant skull.
Pick up the Golden Seed next to the golden tree.
Kill the Black Blade Kindred for Gargoyle's Black Blades, Gargoyle's Black Axe, and 60,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Black Blade Kindred; Gargoyle's Black Blades; Gargoyle's Black Axe

steps.instruction: Millicent can be summoned if you gave her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Pick up Freezing Grease from the area to the left of the large staircase.
Head up the stairs and grab the Grand Lift of Rold grace.
Hoist the medallion at the grand lift, then turn around after arriving to find Beast Blood x2 behind the lift.
Follow the path down and pick up Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, West from the stele.
steps.linkedRaw: Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, West
linkedItemNames: Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, West

links.label: Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, West

steps.instruction: Grab the Zamor Ruins grace on the ledge just ahead.
Exhaust Shabriri's dialogue near the grace (appearing as Yura), then kill him to obtain the Ronin's Set.
Talk to Melina at any grace after exhausting Shabriri's dialogue.
Start by following the path through Zamor Ruins:
Pick up Invigorating Cured Meat from the lower end corner of the ruins.
At the upper end of the ruins is a corpse with Zamor Ice Storm.
Open the chest in the nearby cellar to obtain Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3].
Climb the rocky wall next to the cellar and follow the downhill path to a corpse with Sliver of Meat x2.
Next to a tree on the cliff overlooking the grand lift, you'll find a Golden Rune [10].
Return to the path and kill the scarab hanging behind a thorn totem on the left to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Continue ahead until you reach a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x4 next to a tree.
Pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from the ledge next to a Fire Prelate.
Farther along the ledge lies a corpse with Briars of Punishment.
Before you cross the bridge, turn right to find the entrance to Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Giants' Mountaintop Catacomb grace.
Enter the room straight ahead for a Grave Glovewort [7].
Continue to a lift and ride it down, then send it back up to reveal a secret lift:
After taking the new lift down, pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] below the stairs.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] from the room in the corridor with a frostbite pillar.
Hit the illusory wall on the right side of the corridor past the first pillar to reveal a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Open the chest at the end to obtain the Fire Monk Ashes.
Return to the lift and proceed forward until you reach a room with a Ritual Pot and a Grave Glovewort [7].
Grab the Stimulating Boluses in the previous room, then drop down the shaft to pick up a Nascent Butterfly from the ledge.
Drop down and follow the west path to a room with a Grave Glovewort [8] behind a Living Jar.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [7] from the room at the end.
Drop down the shaft and follow the north path to a lift. Ride it up to a room with Root Resin x5 and a Grave Glovewort [9].
Take the lift back down, then send it up to reveal an area below that leads to a Golden Rune [10] and the boss lever.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit for a Golden Seed, Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2], and 48,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ulcerated Tree Spirit; Golden Seed; Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]

steps.instruction: Open the chest in the room to obtain a Deathroot.
Make your way across the bridge and pick up the Lost Ashes of War along the way.
Pick up Golden Rune [7], Rainbow Stone x4, and Drawstring Holy Grease x2 from a lower ledge farther along the bridge.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [7]; Rainbow Stone x4; Drawstring Holy Grease x2

steps.instruction: Grab the Golden Rune [13] on a ledge next to the Archer Golem, then kill the large scarab up ahead for a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Pick up Soft Cotton x6 from a corpse against a broken pillar stone.
Head up the short bridge, then turn right to find a corpse with Formic Rock x2 on the cliff edge.
Turn back to discover the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins grace next to a bridge pillar.
Exhaust Millicent's dialogue next to the grace.

Invade Juno Hoslow (marked on your map). Let him finish his gesture first to learn the Hoslow's Oath gesture, then kill him for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Hoslow's Petal Whip, and Hoslow's Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Juno Hoslow; Hoslow's Oath; Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Hoslow's Petal Whip; Hoslow's Set

steps.instruction: Inside the shack is a corpse with the Traveling Maiden Set.
Pick up Smithing Stone [7], Warming Stone x3, and Invigorating White Cured Meat from the pile of Golem remains.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [7]; Warming Stone x3; Invigorating White Cured Meat

steps.instruction: Use the nearby spiritspring while facing southeast and head down the slope to find the Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).
Speak to Tanith to obtain the Taker's Cameo and accept her offer to see the lord.
Activate the Audience Pathway grace after arriving, then go through the fog gate to pick up the Serpent-Hunter (can be upgraded for an easier fight).
Kill Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy for Rykard's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Blasphemous, and 130,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy; Rykard's Great Rune; Remembrance of the Blasphemous

steps.instruction: Activate the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy grace in the middle and grab the Eye Surcoat near it.
steps.linkedRaw: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy; Eye Surcoat

steps.instruction: Return to Tanith and exhaust her dialogue.
Talk to Patches and Bernahl so that they both leave the manor.
Pick up the My Thanks gesture in the corridor.

If you gave Rya the Tonic of Forgetfulness, reload the area and she'll be in the drawing room. If you chose to spare her, you'll have to return to her room past the Temple of Eiglay. Refer to the multiple choice at the end of the Volcano Manor section.
Travel to Castellan's Hall and talk to Patches in the covered walkway to receive the Dancer's Castanets.
Speak to Tanith in Rykard's arena. You can give her the castanets, but it has no effect except losing the item.
Kill Tanith to be invaded by her knight, then kill him to obtain Aspects of the Crucible: Breath.
Loot the Consort's Set from Tanith's corpse.
Open Patches's chest in Murkwater Cave for Glass Shard x3. Upon recognizing you, he'll surrender and give the Patches' Crouch gesture.
Travel to the Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate and grab the Divine Tower of West Altus grace on the way to the top.
Restore Rykard's Great Rune at the top of the tower.
Return to Ancient Snow Valley Ruins. Follow the frozen river northeast, then turn right to find a Golden Seed.
Bait a Golem into attacking the statue near some icicles to obtain Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Go up the slope at the end of the river to discover the Freezing Lake grace next to a tree.
Head through the graveyard north of the grace until you reach the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace near a bridge.
On top of a broken pillar northeast of the grace is a corpse with Stimulating Boluses x3.
Cross the invisible bridge to enter Heretical Rise (look for the mist) and open the chest at the top to obtain Founding Rain of Stars.
Exit through the bottom entrance and head left around the tower to find Old Fang x5.
Pick up Thawfrost Boluses x2 from a lower ledge on the other side of the tower.
Pop the three balloons in the area south of the tower for 3x Golden Rune [12].
Return to Snow Valley Ruins Overlook and cross the bridge near the grace. Kill the Erdtree Avatar for Cerulean Crystal Tear, Crimson Bubbletear, and 70,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Erdtree Avatar; Cerulean Crystal Tear; Crimson Bubbletear

steps.instruction: Pick up a Rune Arc from the branch of the Minor Erdtree that extends past the cliff edge.
On the ledge of a pillar past the cliff southwest of the Minor Erdtree, you'll find a Golden Rune [10].
Continue across a second bridge to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] in a chair.
Talk to Corhyn and exhaust his dialogue about the noble Goldmask.
Note: You can offer him the tonic if you still have it. He'll refuse but remain on the bridge instead of moving to Leyndell later; it has no other effect.
Continue past the bridge and enter Stargazers' Ruins:
Approach the Spirit Jellyfish in the middle and summon the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes to learn the Fancy Spin gesture.
After summoning the ashes, loot the chest in the cellar to obtain the Primal Glintstone Blade.
In the back of the ruins is a corpse with Freezing Grease x2.
Return to Snow Valley Ruins Overlook and pick up the 2x Golden Rune [10] on the path west of the grace.
Kill the Tibia Mariner on the cliff near the second Golden Rune to obtain Helphen's Steeple and a Deathroot.
Return to the path to pick up Human Bone Shard x5 and a Golden Rune [11] from the corpses on either side.
steps.linkedRaw: Human Bone Shard x5; Golden Rune [11]

steps.instruction: Kill the Death Rite Bird farther downhill for Death Ritual Spear and 77,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Death Rite Bird; Death Ritual Spear

steps.instruction: In the area with the boss is an astrolabe with Starlight Shards.
Head toward the Wandering Mausoleum and grab the Castle Sol Main Gate grace in front of the entrance.
Take down the Mausoleum by hitting the skull formations around its feet. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
Behind the castle lies a cemetery with a Golden Rune [4], Golden Rune [5], and a Golden Rune [10].
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [4]; Golden Rune [5]; Golden Rune [10]

steps.instruction: Continue around the castle to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a ledge.
Feed Gurranq the two Deathroots to receive Gurranq's Beast Claw and Beastclaw Greathammer.
Kill the two Elder Lions in the castle for 2x Somber Smithing Stone [7], 2x Beast Blood, and 2x Old Fang x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [7]; Beast Blood; Old Fang x2

steps.instruction: Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the corner immediately on the right, then grab the Smithing Stone [5] below the wooden platform.
Go up the wooden stairs, then head around the left corner to find Freezing Grease x5 on the edge.
Drop down and follow the lower stairs to a Furlcalling Finger Remedy in the outside corridor.
Enter the nearby room to pick up a Nascent Butterfly, then climb the ladder to find Fan Daggers x5 between the battlement.
Follow the battlements to a Golden Rune [10], then continue past the ballistas to pick up a Smithing Stone [6] under a tent.
Descend the ladder and grab the "Sorcerer" Painting, as well as a shortcut door to the lower section.
Climb back up the ladder, then jump onto the smaller tent and over the east railing to reach a corpse with the Stormhawk Axe.
Drop down and pick up the Thawfrost Boluses x3 under a tent.
Continue through the next room, then up the stairs on the left to find a Golden Rune [10].
Go up the other stairs and into the church to grab the Church of the Eclipse grace in the left room.
Head back out and pick up Thawfrost Boluses from a crenel next to the wooden platform.
Climb the nearby ladder and cross the short stone bridge to find a Golden Rune [9].
Pick up a Stonesword Key from the top battlement past a wooden bridge.
Head back across to pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the edge at the end.
Enter the church room and pick up the Eclipse Shotel in front of the altar.
Head down the outside corridor until you reach a ladder. Jump onto the railing and run along the narrow ledge to a reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Run back across the ledge and drop to the area with a Rune Arc next to a campfire.
Pick up Smithing Stone [7] x3 from the corner of a room with multiple rats.
Climb the ladder in the room, then jump onto the rampart with an elite Banished Knight to pick up the Cerulean Amber Medallion +1.
Return to Church of the Eclipse and enter the other room in the outside corridor to find a Smithing Stone [6] up the stairs.
Activate the shortcut lift past the room.
Kill Commander Niall for Veteran's Prosthesis and 90,000 runes.
Activate the Castle Sol Rooftop grace after the fight.
Use the lift past the boss and pick up the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) at the end.
Travel to Snow Valley Ruins Overlook and head toward the bridge at the end of the graveyard to pick up Greathood (painting reward).
Tell Gideon Ofnir that the secret medallions are reunited.
Travel to Freezing Lake and kill the invisible scarab roaming the left side of the lake to obtain Ash of War: Seppuku.
Pick up a Golden Rune [11] from a rocky outcrop on the left-side edge of the lake.
Kill Borealis the Freezing Fog in the lake for Dragon Heart and 100,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Borealis the Freezing Fog; Dragon Heart

steps.instruction: Return to the grace and head along the right side of the lake to discover the entrance to Spiritcaller Cave:
Unlock the imp seal and grab the Spiritcaller Cave grace inside.
In the first room is a corpse with Arteria Leaf x5 (mind the cracks in the floor as you enter).
Continue ahead and take the first left to pick up a Rune Arc, Golden Rune [10], and Hero's Rune [1].
steps.linkedRaw: Rune Arc; Golden Rune [10]; Hero's Rune [1]

steps.instruction: Drop down in the next room to find Freezing Grease x2 and a Golden Rune [12].
Grab the Invigorating White Cured Meat, White Reed Set, and a Golden Rune [6] from the room with two Spiritcaller Snails.
steps.linkedRaw: Invigorating White Cured Meat; White Reed Set; Golden Rune [6]

steps.instruction: Kill the Spiritcaller Snail for Godskin Swaddling Cloth, Black Flame Ritual, and 70,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Spiritcaller Snail; Godskin Swaddling Cloth; Black Flame Ritual

steps.instruction: Exit the cave and continue along the right side until you reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8] next to a burrowed Crayfish.
At the end of the lake lies the First Church of Marika. Pick up the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] in front of it.
Grab the First Church of Marika grace and the Sacred Tear in front of the statue.
steps.linkedRaw: First Church of Marika; Sacred Tear

steps.instruction: Talk to Melina twice at the First Church of Marika grace.
Pick up Smithing Stone [7] x3 from a rocky outcrop next to the church.
Follow the path near the church to a cemetery with 2x Golden Rune [7] and a Golden Rune [10].
Use the spiritspring near the cemetery and kill Roundtable Knight Vyke in the evergaol for Vyke's Dragonbolt, Fingerprint Set, and 75,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Roundtable Knight Vyke; Vyke's Dragonbolt; Fingerprint Set

steps.instruction: Follow the snow-covered path down to find Explosive Greatbolt x5 next to a campfire past some spiked barricades.
Continue past the barricades to discover the Whiteridge Road grace.
Pick up the Stonesword Key next to a Fire Prelate up ahead.
Head up the nearby stairs to enter Guardians' Garrison:
Behind some crates on the outside ledge is a Golden Rune [10].
Go up the stairs to find a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x6.
Climb the ladder in a corner on the ground floor, then pick up the Smithing Stone [7] at the end.
Break some crates to reveal a gap in the battlement. Head up the scaffolding and kill Chief Guardian Arghanthy to obtain the One-Eyed Shield.
Open the chest at the top of a tower to obtain the Giant's Prayerbook.
Follow the wooden platforms below a hole in the battlement to reach a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x5.
Drop down from the wooden platform and pick up the Golden Rune [8] next to a thorn totem.
Kill the scarab hanging from a totem to obtain Ash of War: Prelate's Charge.
Cross the chain bridge at the end to grab the Giants' Gravepost grace and Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, East.
steps.linkedRaw: Giants' Gravepost; Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, East
linkedItemNames: Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, East

links.label: Map: Mountaintops of the Giants, East

steps.instruction: Follow the cliff edge on the right until the area evens out. Against some trees on the left sits a corpse with Invigorating White Cured Meat x3.
Pick up Drawstring Holy Grease x2 in front of a burrowed Fingercreeper down the slope.
At the bottom of the slope, you'll find a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Jump across the gap between the cliffs and enter Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave:
Ride the lift down and grab the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave grace.
Unlock the imp seal near the grace to pick up Flame, Protect Me.
Hit the illusory wall to the right of the Fire Monk to reveal a corridor, then pick up a Golden Rune [11] from one of the windows.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [7] in the room below, then grab the Grave Glovewort [9] down the stairs.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar ahead, then pick up the Freezing Grease up the stairs in the next room.
Unlock the imp seal and fall down the hole to reactivate the pillar and create a light zone. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] and Cranial Vessel Candlestand at the end.
Use the lift ahead, then send it up to reveal a secret lift. Pull the lever to ride the secret one down, then look behind it to find a Grave Glovewort [9].
Climb the ladder at the east end of the corridor and grab the Giant's Seal and a Great Grave Glovewort from the room with a Fire Prelate.
Return to the previous room and pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] at the west end of the corridor.
Climb the other ladder to a room with a Grave Glovewort [7] and a Grave Glovewort [8].
Drop down and send the lift up to create a light zone. Open the gate and kill the giant inside the zone to unlock the boss door.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9] in front of the boss door.
Kill the Ancient Hero of Zamor for Zamor Curved Sword, Zamor Set, and 83,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ancient Hero of Zamor; Zamor Curved Sword; Zamor Set

steps.instruction: Travel to Giants' Gravepost and head uphill to find Fan Daggers x5 and Warming Stone x2 on the slope.
steps.linkedRaw: Fan Daggers x5; Warming Stone x2

steps.instruction: Approach the church at the top right side of the slope to be invaded by Bloody Finger Okina. Kill him to obtain the Rivers of Blood and Okina Mask.
steps.linkedRaw: Bloody Finger Okina; Rivers of Blood; Okina Mask

steps.instruction: Grab the Church of Repose grace and the Sacred Tear in front of the statue.
Use the spiritspring behind the giant skull south of the church to reach a corpse with Ash of War: Troll's Roar on top.
In the mouth of the skull is an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
On top of the crag northeast of the skull is a teleporting scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [7] guarded by a Giant Crow below the crag, but be wary of the very large Fingercreeper...
Grab the Foot of the Forge grace behind the corpse of a giant close by.
Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from a recess in the cliff north of the grace.
Head up the northeast slope until you reach a Golden Seed.
An astrolabe with Starlight Shards sits at the edge of the cliff farther northeast.
Follow the curved cliff edge west to find a Golden Rune [10] partway along it.
At the center of the curved cliff formation, in front of the giant corpse, you'll find Grace Mimic x3.
Continue downhill and pick up the Golden Rune [10] below a giant corpse.
Follow the slope down a narrow pathway to reach a basin with the Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear.
Cross either chain bridge near the grace and kill the Fire Giant for Remembrance of the Fire Giant and 180,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Fire Giant; Remembrance of the Fire Giant

steps.instruction: Alexander can be summoned if you spoke to him at Mt. Gelmir.
Grab the Fire Giant grace at the top of the slope for later.
Travel to the Grand Lift of Rold and hoist the secret medallion to reach the Hidden Path to the Haligtree:
Go straight ahead to pick up Warming Stone x2 in front of an altar.
There's a gap in the balustrade up the stairs, but you'll want the grace first, so grab the Freezing Grease x5 at the top of the room.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [9] around the corner and grab the Hidden Path to the Haligtree grace just up the stairs.
steps.linkedRaw: Grave Glovewort [9]; Hidden Path to the Haligtree

steps.instruction: Drop onto an invisible bridge below the gap in the balustrade, then go through the south doorway to reach a Grave Glovewort [9].
Hit the illusory wall past the glovewort to reveal a chest with the Silver Scarab.
Walk across the invisible bridge and through the north doorway to pick up Sacramental Bud x3.
Follow the invisible bridge down to a room with a Grave Glovewort [9].
Drop to the stone platform below to pick up a Hero's Rune [1].
Jump through either window to land in a room with Old Fang x6 and the boss lever.
Below the stairs is a corpse with Root Resin x4, guarded by four Vulgar Militia.
Turn right before the boss room and ride the lift up to a corpse with Spelldrake Talisman +2.
Kill the Stray Mimic Tear for Blackflame Monk Amon and 50,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Stray Mimic Tear; Blackflame Monk Amon

steps.instruction: Loot the chest in the room to obtain the final Deathroot.
Feed Gurranq the last Deathroot to receive an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Kill the Black Blade Kindred outside the sanctum for Gargoyle's Blackblade, Gargoyle's Black Halberd, and 88,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Black Blade Kindred; Gargoyle's Blackblade; Gargoyle's Black Halberd

steps.instruction: Descend the roots in the cliff west of the sanctum, then make your way down to the second level to pick up Soft Cotton x3 from a corpse in the middle.
Carefully drop to the bottom level to grab the Cinquedea and Dragoncrest Shield Talisman.
Follow the downhill path outside the sanctum until you reach the Farum Greatbridge grace.
Behind four gravestones west of the grace is a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Kill Flying Dragon Greyll on the bridge for Dragon Heart and 80,000 runes.
At the far end of the bridge, turn right to find a lower ledge with a scarab that drops Bestial Constitution.
Kill the Putrid Avatar in front of the Minor Erdtree for Opaline Hardtear, Stonebarb Cracked Tear, and 91,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Putrid Avatar; Opaline Hardtear; Stonebarb Cracked Tear

steps.instruction: Descend the roots in the cliff south of the Minor Erdtree, then pick up Ash of War: Rain of Arrows from the cliff edge (painting reward).
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Rain of Arrows
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Rain of Arrows

links.label: Ash of War: Rain of Arrows

steps.instruction: Quickly grab the Rune Arc next to a Golem with sorcery-based attacks.
Pass time until nightfall and kill the Night's Cavalry on the bridge near Lenne's Rise for Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step and 42,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalry; Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step

steps.instruction: Head downhill from Lenne's Rise until you notice the entrance to Dragonbarrow Cave in the cliffside:
Enter to grab the Dragonbarrow Cave grace.
Pick up a Golden Rune [12] and Warming Stone from the first room.
Follow the tunnel at the southeast end of the room to grab the Bull-Goat's Talisman.
Turn back and head down the north room. Pick up the Golden Rune [8] and Beast Blood x3 guarded by wolves.
Kill the two Beastmen of Farum Azula for Flamedrake Talisman +2 and 65,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Beastmen of Farum Azula; Flamedrake Talisman +2

steps.instruction: Travel to Starscourge Radahn and head north to find War-Dead Catacombs at the end of the shoreline:
Head inside and activate the War-Dead Catacombs grace.
Pick up Magic Grease x3 and a Grave Glovewort [6] from the room with endlessly spawning enemies.
Go up the south stairs to find another Grave Glovewort [6].
Drop down the gap in the staircase and loot the chest on the bottom floor to obtain Collapsing Stars.
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] and Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot from the corpses on the bottom floor.
Head through the doorway at the bottom, which leads to a Ghost Glovewort [4].
Return to the main room and go up the north stairs until you reach a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [6].
Continue to a room at the end with a Grave Glovewort [6].
Drop down the window in the previous corridor, then pick up Radahn Soldier Ashes from the room up the stairs.
Jump through the window outside the room to reach a Grave Glovewort [6] and the boss lever.
Kill the Putrid Tree Spirit for Redmane Knight Ogha, Golden Seed, and 64,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Putrid Tree Spirit; Redmane Knight Ogha; Golden Seed

steps.instruction: Travel to Below the Well and unlock the lift up the stairs to reach the Deep Siofra Well grace.
Follow the south path past a Runebear to grab a Stonesword Key from the cliff edge.
Follow the other path and pick up the Spiked Palisade Shield next to an Archer Golem.
Talk to the Great Jar and he'll present three summon signs. Talk to him again after defeating all three summons without dying to receive the Great-Jar's Arsenal.
Note: If you're playing online, the summons will use randomized builds from other players who have completed the challenge.
Enter the colosseum behind the Great Jar to access it from the Marika statue in Roundtable Hold.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, pick up Ritual Thrusting Shield from the corpse inside the colosseum.
Travel to Dragonbarrow West and kill the exploding scarab on a branch in front of the divine tower to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Drop onto the tall root near the tower, then double jump to the ledge with a soldier. Cross the southeast arch to find a Stonesword Key.
Head back across and climb the ladder, then cross three consecutive arches along the left side to reach a Numen's Rune.
Go back one arch and climb the ladder to grab the Divine Tower of Caelid: Center grace.
Take the west path first to reach the top of the tower and activate Radahn's Great Rune.
Return to the grace and make your way down the tower:
After landing on a fragile platform, drop down below it to find a Golden Rune [12].
Use the caged lift below, then climb a ladder to open a shortcut back to the grace.
Climb back down and grab the Rune Arc at the end of the corridor.
Walk around the narrow ledge, then drop onto the fragile platform to reach the Divine Tower of Caelid: Basement grace down a lift.
Kill the Godskin Apostle for the Godskin Apostle Set and 94,000 runes.
Open the chest at the end to obtain the Godslayer's Greatsword.
