Pass time until nightfall and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter at the Isolated Merchant's Shack for Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing and 50,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Bell Bearing Hunter; Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing

steps.instruction: Just north of the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, you'll discover the Consecrated Snowfield grace.
Head directly east from the grace, then go up the slope on the right to find a Golden Rune [11].
Drop down toward west to find a Golden Rune [13] on the ledge below.
Return to the grace and head west-northwest to a cemetery. Kill the Rotten Duelist nearby for Rotten Battle Hammer and Rotten Duelist Helm.
steps.linkedRaw: Rotten Battle Hammer; Rotten Duelist Helm

steps.instruction: Loot the Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [3], Golden Rune [6], Golden Rune [9], and Golden Rune [11] in the cemetery.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [1]; Golden Rune [3]; Golden Rune [6]; Golden Rune [9]; Golden Rune [11]

steps.instruction: Return to the grace and head north-northeast to find a corpse with the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23] past three Wandering Nobles.
From the corpse, head directly west-northwest until you hear a singing voice. Pick up the Stalwart Horn Charm +1 next to a Shaman.
On the opposite (north) side of the large spire is a Golden Rune [13].
Head toward the ruins, then turn left toward the cliff to find a Smithing Stone [7].
Continue downhill near the cliff to find the entrance to Yelough Anix Tunnel:
Take the lift down and grab the Yelough Anix Tunnel grace.
After dropping down ahead, pick up Freezing Grease x3 from the frozen lift and a Smithing Stone [8] from the wall behind it.
Drop down in the next room and kill the Alabaster Lord to obtain the Alabaster Lord's Sword.
Loot the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, Rune Arc, and 3x Smithing Stone [8] around the lower level.
steps.linkedRaw: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone; Rune Arc; Smithing Stone [8]

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder and pick up the Golden Rune [10] near a gap.
Pick up the Explosive Stone Clump x6 and Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the next room.
steps.linkedRaw: Explosive Stone Clump x6; Somber Smithing Stone [8]

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder in the room to find a Smithing Stone [8] on the wall.
Grab the Hero's Rune [5], 2x Smithing Stone [8], Somber Smithing Stone [8], and Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the room with an Onyx Lord.
steps.linkedRaw: Hero's Rune [5]; Smithing Stone [8]; Somber Smithing Stone [8]; Somber Smithing Stone [9]

steps.instruction: Pick up a Smithing Stone [8] from the wall next to the shortcut door.
Kill Astel, Stars of Darkness for Meteorite of Astel and 120,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Astel, Stars of Darkness; Meteorite of Astel

steps.instruction: Return to the entrance and explore the ruins above the tunnel:
Pick up a Golden Rune [13] next to a sleeping Troll in a ruined building.
A corpse with Rimed Rowa x8 sits in the alley next to the building.
Double jump (or have a Troll destroy the walls) to get inside the ruin next to the corpse. Open the chest in the cellar to obtain Unendurable Frenzy.
Pick up a Stonesword Key guarded by four rats in a tower at the end of the ruins.
Approach the large spire in the flowery area past the ruins to be invaded by a Sanguine Noble that drops the Sanguine Noble Set.
A corpse with a Smithing Stone [8] sits behind a thinner spire, east of the large one.
Continue north to pick up Thawfrost Boluses x2 from the tip of a rock guarded by a Runebear.
Head southeast from the rock to find two dogs feasting on a corpse with Crystal Dart x4.
Continue east-southeast toward the cliff to pick up a Stonesword Key near two lightning orbs.
Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater should invade as you grab the key. Kill her to obtain a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
steps.linkedRaw: Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater; Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.instruction: Kill the invisible scarab chased by wolves on the opposite side of the river to obtain Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure

links.label: Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure

steps.instruction: Head toward the large spire nearby to pick up Map: Consecrated Snowfield.
On a ledge behind the sprire, you'll find a Smithing Stone [8].
From the spire, head south to grab the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace on a ledge across the frozen river.

Rest to reset the caravan and pass time until nightfall, then head southwest toward a caravan. Kill the two Night's Cavalries guarding it for Night's Cavalry Set, Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 84,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Night's Cavalries; Night's Cavalry Set; Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.instruction: Loot the chest in the back of caravan to obtain the Flowing Curved Sword.
Head up the slope where the caravan started and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] on a fallen spire, guarded by two lightning orbs.
Note: Each item in the blizzard is linked to its MapGenie location if you'd rather mark them on your own map.
You should now have enough upgrade materials to upgrade any weapon to max level.
Return to the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace and head southeast toward some nobles. Kill the one half-buried in snow and he'll become a Runebear that drops a Larval Tear.
Head northeast from the nobles to find a corpse with Miquella's Lily x3 next to a cluster of gravestones.
Guarded by three sorcerer balls farther north-northeast, you'll find the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8].

Continue northeast to find Albinauric Rise and summon your Fanged Imp Ashes to defeat the spectral ones around the tower. Alternatively, you can use Crystal Darts or Bewitching Branches to make them fight each other. When the seal breaks, loot the Graven-Mass Talisman at the top of the tower.
Jump to a lower ledge south from the tower stairs to reach a chest with a Rune Arc.
Descend the gravestones in the cliff near the tower to land on a ledge with Old Fang x3.
Travel to the Consecrated Snowfield grace and head northeast to find a scarab hanging onto a rock, which drops a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
Return to the grace to reset the nearby caravan, then head north-northeast to a large spire. Go around its right side to find a Golden Seed and a coffin with a Golden Rune [11].
Simply wait by the coffin and a caravan with St. Trina's Torch should walk right on by.
Just east of the coffin and to the left of a fallen spire, you'll encounter two Wandering Nobles. Kill the one carrying a chest for a Golden Rune [13] (first time).
Continue southeast to come across some nobles fighting wolves. Pick up Old Fang x2 from the ground.
Head northeast from the enemies, then go up the slope appearing on your right to find Lump of Flesh x4.
Continue uphill to discover the entrance to Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs:
Head inside and grab the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs grace.
Make your way past the first frostbite pillar and ride it up to a corpse with Rejuvenating Boluses.
Follow the path before the pillar to a room with Root Resin x4.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] from the east corridor, which also leads to a Grave Glovewort [9].
Follow the west corridor up some stairs to a room with Imp Head (Elder), Grave Glovewort [9], and Human Bone Shard x8.
steps.linkedRaw: Imp Head (Elder); Grave Glovewort [9]; Human Bone Shard x8

steps.instruction: Below the staircase is a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [8].
Disable the pillar upstairs and grab the Grave Glovewort [9] near the edge.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9] guarded by two Cleanrot Knights in the room close by.
Ride the pillar up to the boss lever, where you'll also find a Grave Glovewort [9] and a Golden Rune [12].
Kill the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist for Great Grave Glovewort x2, Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak, and 78,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Putrid Grave Warden Duelist; Great Grave Glovewort x2; Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak

steps.instruction: From the catacomb entrance, head north-northwest until you see a corpse with Fire Blossom x6 on your left.
Continue east-northeast uphill to discover two corpses with Hefty Beast Bone x2 and Golden Rune [9].
steps.linkedRaw: Hefty Beast Bone x2; Golden Rune [9]

steps.instruction: Climb the large cluster of gravestones northwest of the corpses to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8] at the top.
Go back down and run northeast for the sending gate at the end of the cliff. After arriving, head toward a dead tree with Tarnished Golden Sunflower x3 under it.
steps.linkedRaw: sending gate; Tarnished Golden Sunflower x3

steps.instruction: Pick up Warming Stone x4 from the corpse hanging on a root of the Minor Erdtree.
Kill the Putrid Avatar uphill from the Erdtree for Thorny Cracked Tear, Ruptured Crystal Tear, and 160,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Putrid Avatar; Thorny Cracked Tear; Ruptured Crystal Tear

steps.instruction: Go downhill from the Erdtree and head around the cliff on the left to reach a campsite with Dragonwound Grease x2.
Kill the invisible scarab on top of a gravestone cluster near the campsite for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Kill the two scarabs on the clusters below for a Somber Smithing Stone [7] and a Somber Smithing Stone [8].
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [7]; Somber Smithing Stone [8]

steps.instruction: On a lower ledge southeast of the scarabs is a corpse with Nascent Butterfly x3.
Take the first left when continuing downhill to find a corpse with Albinauric Bloodclot x2 at the end.
Descend the gravestones in the nearby cliff, then pick up the Strip of White Flesh x2 surrounded by crabs in the frozen river.
Bait a Giant Crab into attacking the statue on the side of the river to obtain Smithing Stone [8] x3.
Continue along the left crag to find the entrance to Cave of the Forlorn behind a Giant Land Octopus:
Unlock the imp seal and grab the Cave of the Forlorn grace.
Pick up a Golden Rune [7] and Freezing Grease x4 from the ice in the first room.
Follow the north path to grab another Freezing Grease.
Take the other path to pick up a Nascent Butterfly and Golden Rune [10] from either side of the room.
Continue ahead and grab the Hero's Rune [2] on top of an icy outcrop.
Proceed through the north tunnel, which leads to a room with a Rune Arc and Spiritflame Arrow x10.
Head back and descend the slope reached from an icy outcrop with a lily on top to find Miquella's Lily x3, Crystal Dart x8, and Thawfrost Boluses x2.
steps.linkedRaw: Miquella's Lily x3; Crystal Dart x8; Thawfrost Boluses x2

steps.instruction: Just around the corner sits a corpse with Thawfrost Boluses x3.
Descend the hole and pick up the Freezing Grease x6 on the way to the bottom.
Kill the Misbegotten Crusader for Golden Order Greatsword and 93,000 runes.
Exit the cave and kill Great Wyrm Theodorix at the end of the river for Dragon Heart x3 and 180,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Great Wyrm Theodorix; Dragon Heart x3

steps.instruction: Pick up the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone below the frozen waterfall.
Travel to Inner Consecrated Snowfield and follow the north-northwest path across the lake to reach Ordina, Liturgical Town:
Grab the Ordina, Liturgical Town grace next to the path.
Pick up the Golden Rune [10] in front of a shrine up the first set of stairs.
Jump onto the rooftops south of the shrine, then onto the flat-roofed building to reach a corpse with Cuckoo Glintstone x8.
From the rooftops, turn east and double jump onto either balcony at the far end. Pick up a Rune Arc from the third balcony facing away from town.
Break the wooden crates below the balcony to reveal a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
Interact with the imp seal up the second set of stairs from the shrine, then enter the evergaol:
Note: Equip the Sentry's Torch in your left hand to reveal the invisible enemies.
Kill the Black Knife Assassin below the staircase near the evergaol for a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Head around the town and kill the Black Knife Assassin southeast of the grace for a Ghost Glovewort [9].
Kill the Black Knife Assassin near the shrine for a Ghost Glovewort [9], then light the first candle (1/4).
Go around the building west of the shrine to find Crystal Dart x5.
Jump over the fence to pick up Freezing Grease x2 from a corpse in the middle.
Kill the Black Knife Assassin below the arch near the corpse for the final Ghost Glovewort [9].
Climb the ladder behind the building farthest from town and light the candle at the top (2/4).
Pick up a Golden Rune [12] from the roof below the candle.
Make your way across the rooftops and grab the Golden Rune [13] next to the first archer.
Drop down to find a corpse with Old Fang x3 directly below, then pick up a Golden Rune [13] from the opposite side of the building.
Climb the ladder on the southwest side of the stairs and light the candle at the top (3/4).
Pick up Slumbering Egg x3 from the snow-covered corner of a rooftop.
Continue across and light the final candle, kicking you out of the evergaol (4/4).
Pick up Invigorating Cured Meat from the corpse on the staircase near the evergaol, then grab the Black Knife Set under the stairs.
steps.linkedRaw: Invigorating Cured Meat; Black Knife Set

steps.instruction: Kill the Rotten Duelist on the cliff west-northwest of the stairs for Rotten Duelist Greaves and Rotten Greataxe.
Follow the cliff down a slope and pick up the Golden Seed near the river.

Approach the Wandering Mausoleum from the area northwest of the golden tree, then bring it down (don't approach from the ledge near the river; you will die). Optionally, mark its location on your map.
After taking down the Mausoleum, you can safely loot the Golden Rune [12] and Golden Rune [7] on the ledge near the river.
Grab the Apostate Derelict grace in the church near the Mausoleum and pick up the Silver Mirrorshield in front of Phillia, Towering Little Sister.
Look for the prompt to summon Latenna, then talk to her to receive a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Pass time until nightfall, then head toward the cliff east-northeast of the church to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Drop down to the lower ledge farther south to pick up a Golden Rune [13].
Kill the Death Rite Bird at the end of the river for Explosive Ghostflame and 220,000 runes.
Return to the Apostate Derelict and follow the southwest cliff edge until you reach a statue. A corpse with Golden Rune [1] x6 sits on top of the cliff to the left it.
Bait the sleeping Runebear into attacking the statue to obtain Smithing Stone [7] x3 and a Smithing Stone [8].
Continue along the cliff edge and pick up a Hero's Rune [2] from the tip of a fallen spire extending past the cliff.
Use the sending gate on the lower cliff south of the spire to reach Mohgwyn Palace.
After arriving from Consecrated Snowfield, exit the tunnel and drop down from the cliff to find a Golden Rune [11] next to a tree.
Activate the Palace Approach Ledge-Road grace just downhill.
Pick up a Golden Rune [11] from the slope with multiple Albinaurics.
Grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Bloodrose x5 farther down the slope.
Enter the first cave on the right side of the blood lake. Kill the scarab to obtain Ash of War: Blood Tax and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [9].
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Blood Tax; Somber Smithing Stone [9]

steps.instruction: A corpse with a Hero's Rune [4] sits in front of the spire next to the cave, near some stone bricks.
Beside the westernmost spire is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [8].
Pick up Blood-Tainted Excrement x8 from a corpse beside the spire near two campfires.
Loot the Hero's Rune [3], Blood-Tainted Excrement x8, and Drawstring Blood Grease x4 around the middle spire.
steps.linkedRaw: Hero's Rune [3]; Blood-Tainted Excrement x8; Drawstring Blood Grease x4

steps.instruction: Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] outside a cave near the middle spire and grab Swarm of Flies from a corpse inside.
In the last cave you'll find a Smithing Stone [6] and Golden Rune [13].
Head toward the area past the southwest corner of the lake to be invaded by a Nameless White Mask.
Pick up the Clarifying Boluses next to some bushes, then grab the Smithing Stone [6] and Golden Rune [13] next to a blood-sick Crow in the middle of the lake.
steps.linkedRaw: Clarifying Boluses; Smithing Stone [6]; Golden Rune [13]

steps.instruction: Grab the Golden Seed on a rocky platform in the lake; a second Nameless White Mask invades as you approach.
On the cliff at the end of the lake, you'll find a Ghost Glovewort [8] and the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [24].
Pick up Rot Grease x3 from a corpse in front of the large spire near the cliff, and Bloodrose x5 from the corpse behind it.
Kill the last Nameless White Mask that invades behind the spire to obtain the War Surgeon Set.
Head toward the area west of the lake and grab the Stonesword Key, Haligdrake Talisman +2, and Ghost Glovewort [9] in the graveyard.
steps.linkedRaw: Stonesword Key; Haligdrake Talisman +2; Ghost Glovewort [9]

steps.instruction: Pick up Holy Grease from the corpse guarded by a blood-sick Crow near the graveyard.
Follow the crag to a corpse with Arteria Leaf x4 guarded by blood-sick dogs.
Return to the blood lake teeming with Albinaurics and pick up the Golden Rune [12] and Smithing Stone [7] past the lake.
Go around the large spire to find a Rune Arc against the wall.
Loot the Golden Rune [12], Sacramental Bud, and Nascent Butterfly x3 in the wooded area.
steps.linkedRaw: Golden Rune [12]; Sacramental Bud; Nascent Butterfly x3

steps.instruction: Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [9] in front of a staircase, then go up the stairs to find a corpse holding the Map: Mohgwyn Palace.
Continue up and grab the Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance grace.
Head up the stairs to pick up a Smithing Stone [7] next to some gravestones.
A corpse with a Numen's Rune sits on the left-side cliff edge.
Grab the Stanching Boluses x3 behind a mound of putrid blood.
Turn right past the blood mound to find a Stonesword Key on the cliff.
Head back and pick up Bloodrose x8 from a corpse near the cliff edge at the end.
Take the first left inside the mausoleum to find the Imprisoned Merchant.
Pick up a Lord's Rune from a large gravestone, then grab the Great Ghost Glovewort in the lower area northeast of it.
A corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3 rests in an alcove on the left past the large gravestone.
Go up the stairs to find a Ghost Glovewort [9] next to a cluster of gravestones.
Continue up and grab the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint grace outside the mausoleum.
Invade Varre at the mausoleum exit for a Rune Arc and Furlcalling Finger Remedy, then exhaust his dialogue for Festering Bloody Finger x6 and Varre's Bouquet.
steps.linkedRaw: Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Festering Bloody Finger x6; Varre's Bouquet

steps.instruction: Note: You can get a second Varre's Bouquet if you quit out instead of picking up his loot. You should then see an additional pickup. Grab that one first, then pick up Varre's usual loot. [See video]
Loot a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone from the chest guarded by a group of enemies, then grab the Golden Rune [13] behind it.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone; Golden Rune [13]

steps.instruction: Take the lift up and kill Mohg, Lord of Blood for Mohg's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Blood Lord, and 420,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Mohg, Lord of Blood; Mohg's Great Rune; Remembrance of the Blood Lord

steps.instruction: Note: You can equip the Purifying Crystal Tear to your Physick and drink it before the fight to greatly reduce the damage taken from his "nihil" attack.
Activate the Cocoon of the Empyrean grace after the fight.
Note: You should now be able to access the realm of shadow if you own the DLC. If so, Leda should appear next to the grace.
Restore the power of Mohg's Great Rune at the Divine Tower of East Altus.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about Mohgwyn Palace, then about the Lord of Blood's cocoon to receive Fevor's Cookbook [3] and Law of Causality.
Use the sending gate at the top of Ordina, Liturgical Town, then grab the Haligtree Canopy grace after arriving.
Look behind the branch you arrived on to find a Stonesword Key at the tip.
On the branch below lies a corpse with Sacramental Bud x3.
Continue until you reach a Golden Rune [10] next to a large Oracle Envoy.
Drop onto the main branch with ants patrolling it, then go up the upper rightmost branch to find Dappled Cured Meat and a Smithing Stone [8] at the end.
Head up the middle branch to find a Golden Rune [10] and the Envoy Crown at the end.
When going downward, follow the thin branch on the right to find Aeonian Butterfly x2 on a higher up branch to the right.
Turn left at the top of the branch to grab Fire Grease x3, guarded by putrid Miranda flowers.
Go down the thin branch for a Stonesword Key at the tip.
Head back up and loot the corpse on a mushroom near three Oracle Envoys for Preserving Boluses.
Continue down the main branch and pick up the Warming Stone x4 beside a short offshoot.
Go up the branch near the offshoot to pick up Prattling Pate "My Beloved" from the top of a mushroom cluster.
When descending the main branch, drop onto the thin branch to the right and follow it to a Golden Rune [13].
Continue up and loot the Oracle Envoy Ashes guarded by a group of Oracle Envoys at the end.
Pick up Lost Ashes of War from a round platform at the lower end of the branch.
Drop back onto the main branch to pick up a Numen's Rune and Flaming Bolt x10 guarded by putrid Miranda Sprouts.
Descend the ladder at the base of the branch to discover the Haligtree Town grace inside a round building.
Pick up a Golden Rune [10] from the edge just past the grace.
Climb the ladder to a corpse with Rot Grease x2, then jump across the gap to grab the Pearldrake Talisman +2.
Head back down and enter the top floor of a building to find a Smithing Stone [8].
Loot the corpse down the stairs for Hefty Beast Bone x6, then grab the Golden Rune [13] on the balcony behind the stairs.
steps.linkedRaw: Hefty Beast Bone x6; Golden Rune [13]

steps.instruction: On a small bridge above two putrid Miranda Blossoms is a corpse with Fire Grease x5.
Continue ahead and pick up the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone in front of a statue.
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the left balcony, but watch for the enemies that may push you off the edge.
Cross the nearby bridge to grab a Golden Rune [12] and the Haligtree Town Plaza grace.
Drop onto the rooftop near the grace to pick up a Smithing Stone [6].
A Spiritcaller Snail hides below the south corner of the roof. Kill it, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [9] inside the building.
On the branch with ants patrolling it lies a corpse with Aeonian Butterfly x4.
Pick up the Golden Rune [10] next to a second Spiritcaller Snail. The last snail is on a ledge just southwest of the second one.
Jump onto the rooftop across the gap, then back over to enter the building's interior and find a Golden Rune [12] inside.
Farther inside is a chest with the Viridian Amber Medallion +2.
Jumb back across and climb the ladder to a Smithing Stone [6] near some Putrid Corpses.
Drop down ahead and enter the west building. In the first room is a corpse with a Sacramental Bud.
Run across the bridge past the opposite building for a Smithing Stone [7] and Smithing Stone [8], guarded by a Battlemage.
In the other circular building, you'll find a Hero's Rune [4].
Head across the third bridge to activate a shortcut lift to the Haligtree Town grace.
Kill Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree for Loretta's Mastery, Loretta's War Sickle, and 200,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree; Loretta's Mastery; Loretta's War Sickle

steps.instruction: Activate the Haligtree Promenade grace after the fight.
After descending a long ladder, head around the side of the tower for a chest containing an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Ride the lift down and pick up Holy Grease x3 from the corpse on the bridge.
Continue past the bridge to discover the Prayer Room grace.
Talk to Millicent near the grace and exhaust her dialogue.
Tell Gowry what Millicent said.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about using the secret medallions to receive Black Flame's Protection.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: From the Prayer Room, take the first left to find a Golden Rune [12] in front of a chalice.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Head up the second room on the left to reach a Smithing Stone [8] on a ledge.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Follow the branch near the ledge up to a corpse with the Miquellan Knight's Sword in a bell tower.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Descend the tower and kill the Erdtree Avatar patrolling the rampart to obtain the Rotten Staff.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up a Numen's Rune from the middle, then grab the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at the south end on the rampart.
steps.linkedRaw: Numen's Rune; Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Go up the opposite side of the rampart to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] next to a Crystalian.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Jump to the ledge outside the room with the Crystalian to reach a Golden Rune [10].

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up a Smithing Stone [7] from the corner of the room with two Cleanrot Knights.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: A corpse with Immunizing White Cured Meat sits just outside the room's southeast exit.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Jump onto the flying buttress next to the corpse, then drop to a ledge below it. Head down the room to find a Seedbed Curse.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Return to the grace and drop to the right after exiting the room. Drop down again and unlock the imp seal for a chest with Triple Rings of Light.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Enter the room on the left for a Smithing Stone [7] behind some wooden crates.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Go up the left staircase to find Lightning Greatbolt x5 on the broken section of the balustrade.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Jump onto the buttress below the balustrade and then toward the gazebo. Loot Cleanrot Knight Finlay from the chest in the nearby room.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Climb the buttress on the other side of the gazebo to reach a room with a chest containing a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Continue along the outside ledge to pick up the final Seedbed Curse.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Follow the branch below the ledge down to a corpse with Old Fang x5.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Descend either buttress below, then drop onto the lower ledge to reach the rampart's interior with Warming Stone x2 and Spiritflame Arrow x15.
steps.linkedRaw: Warming Stone x2; Spiritflame Arrow x15

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Continue up the stairs to pick up a Smithing Stone [8] next to the ballistas, and Haligtree Soldier Ashes in front of a chalice.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Head up the flying buttress next to the ballistas, then jump to the upper ledge to reach a corpse with the Haligtree Knight Helm.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Drop down and grab the Elphael Inner Wall grace and the Smithing Stone [6] close by.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Kill the Erdtree Avatar outside the gate to obtain a Lord's Rune.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up Sacramental Bud from a bush outside the gate, then grab the Arteria Leaf and Golden Rune [11] in front of the ballistas.
steps.linkedRaw: Sacramental Bud; Arteria Leaf; Golden Rune [11]

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Descend the ladder in the corner to find a Smithing Stone [8] in front of a tree.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Note: Along the road you'll encounter five Revenants, each dropping a Ghost Glovewort [9] (first time).

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Enter a small room on the side of the road side to pick up a Lord's Rune.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: In a dark room with three Crystalians, you'll find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] and a Pickled Turtle Neck.
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Smithing Stone [9]; Pickled Turtle Neck

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up Beast Blood x3 from a room on the side of the road.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up the Aeonian Butterfly x4 behind a tower and the Golden Rune [12] in front of an imp seal.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Unlock the imp seal and loot Marika's Soreseal from the chalice.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Return to Elphael Inner Wall and head left around the corner for a chest with the Rotten Crystal Sword, guarded by three Crystalians.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: A corpse with a Hero's Rune [5] sits behind a chalice at the opposite end of the hallway.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Head up the root and turn left where the rot begins to find a corpse with Rot Grease.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Follow the roots past the rot, then go through the doorway for a Golden Rune [10].

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Descend the ladder and grab the Drainage Channel grace just ahead.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Head back up and follow the top branch to a rot pond. Grab the Great Grave Glovewort and kill the Putrid Tree Spirit for a Golden Seed.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Ask Gowry why he's crying, then select "Become a flower?".

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: You'll now see two summon signs on the ledge near the pond:

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Challenge Millicent:

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Note: By choosing this option, you lock yourself out of being able to remove the frenzied flame.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Use the red summon sign and kill Millicent for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Millicent's Prosthesis.
steps.linkedRaw: Rune Arc; Furlcalling Finger Remedy; Millicent's Prosthesis

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Loot the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing from Gowry's corpse.
steps.linkedRaw: Flock's Canvas Talisman; Gowry's Bell Bearing

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Assist Millicent:

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Use the gold summon sign and help Millicent kill her sisters to receive the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Exhaust Millicent's dialogue next to the pond. Reload the area and loot the Unalloyed Gold Needle from her corpse.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Kill Gowry for the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing.
steps.linkedRaw: Flock's Canvas Talisman; Gowry's Bell Bearing

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: From the Drainage Channel, follow the branches and buttresses to a rooftop. Drop down the hole with rafters below it and loot the chest on the upper floor to obtain the Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Drop to the lower ledge on the east side to pick up a Nascent Butterfly from the top balcony.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up Aeonian Butterfly from a corpse on the bottom floor balcony.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Head out the northeast exit and explore the northwest side first to find a Ghost Glovewort [7] in front of a grave.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [8] and Numen's Rune near the Kindreds of Rot in the middle.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Grab the Ghost Glovewort [7] behind a tree and the Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3] and Ghost Glovewort [9] down the slope.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghost Glovewort [7]; Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]; Ghost Glovewort [9]

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Head back and explore the graveyard on the opposite side to find a corpse with Arteria Leaf x3.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Next to a tree farther down lies a Hero's Rune [5].

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Return to the building and ride the lift down to discover the Haligtree Roots grace.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Pick up the Traveler's Set from a scarlet bloom in the room near the grace.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Grab the shortcut lift back to the rampart with an Erdtree Avatar.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Kill Malenia, Blade of Miquella for Malenia's Great Rune, Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, and 480,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Malenia, Blade of Miquella; Malenia's Great Rune; Remembrance of the Rot Goddess

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Activate the Malenia, Goddess of Rot grace and rest at it to reload the area.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: If you assisted Millicent, return the needle to Malenia's scarlet bloom to receive Miquella's Needle and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
steps.linkedRaw: Miquella's Needle; Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Use the sending gate at the Divine Bridge in Leyndell, then ascend the tower to grab the Isolated Divine Tower grace.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Restore the power of Malenia's Great Rune at the top of the tower.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Return to Dung Eater in his cell and use the five Seedbed Curses to receive the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
steps.linkedRaw: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
linkedItemNames: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse

links.label: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Reload the area and loot the Omen Set from Dung Eater's corpse.

steps.objectiveName: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · Levels 150-155
steps.instruction: Talk to Gideon Ofnir about the Haligtree roots to receive Lord's Divine Fortification.
At the Four Belfries, unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked by the message "Crumbling Lands". Use the sending gate, then grab the Pearldrake Talisman on the bottom platform.
Travel to Fire Giant and cross the chain to the forge. Activate the Forge of the Giants grace at the north end of the forge.
Talk to Melina at the Forge of the Giants grace and tell her that you're ready. If you bear the frenzied flame, listen to the sounds of flame.
Grab the Smithing Stone [8] at the end of the bridge and a Golden Rune [9] from a platform below it.
Pick up the Old Fang x3 near an unlit brazier in the room with several Azula Beastmen.
A corpse with Lightningproof Dried Liver lies in the corner of the next room.
Head left in the corridor to grab the Crumbling Beast Grave grace.
Kill the Ancient Dragon on the long platform for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Grab the Smithing Stone [6], Smithing Stone [8], and Dragonwound Grease along the platform.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [6]; Smithing Stone [8]; Dragonwound Grease

steps.instruction: Pick up a Smithing Stone [8] from the arcade and activate the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths grace just past it.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [8]; Crumbling Beast Grave Depths

steps.instruction: On a coffin in the room ahead lies a Smithing Stone [7].
Jump to the roof out the balcony to reach the upper floor, where you can find Gravel Stone x3, Smithing Stone [6], and a Great Grave Glovewort.
steps.linkedRaw: Gravel Stone x3; Smithing Stone [6]; Great Grave Glovewort

steps.instruction: Pick up Lightning Greatbolt x14 from a set of stairs on the floor below.
Go up the opposite set of stairs to find a Golden Rune [12] hanging off a ledge.
Pick up the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook on the bottom floor, then head out the northeast exit to grab the Tempest-Facing Balcony grace.
Head back through the southwest exit to find a Hero's Rune [2] between two columns.
Take the lift down and jump across the platforms on the right for a Smithing Stone [8], guarded by an Ancient Dragon.
Jump back across and follow the upper left path to a corpse with Fulgurbloom x4 around the corner.
Behind the tree below, with Wormfaces around it, lies a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Climb the ladder behind the nearby bridge pillar to reach a Smithing Stone [8] on top of the broken bridge.
Descend the platforms below the bridge. Pick up Rejuvenating Boluses and Smithing Stone [8] from the water and the Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3] in the gazebo.
steps.linkedRaw: Rejuvenating Boluses; Smithing Stone [8]; Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]

steps.instruction: Head down the slope below a broken bridge to find Gravel Stone x5 around the end corner.
Return to the Tempest-Facing Balcony and pick up the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] beyond the broken balustrade.
Descend the cliff to a floating platform. Grab the Golden Rune [9] behind the arcade and the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on a separate platform.
Pick up Golden Arrow x14 from the tip of a platform on the way down, then drop into the hole in the bottom platform to find a Golden Rune [10] behind you.
After dropping down the hole, take the second left for a Golden Rune [12] at the edge.
Follow the other path to a ladder that leads to a Great Grave Glovewort on a coffin.
Drop back down to the platform with a hole. Pick up Gravel Stone x3 from the arcade and a Somber Smithing Stone [9] next to a beast-entwined pillar.
steps.linkedRaw: Gravel Stone x3; Somber Smithing Stone [9]

steps.instruction: Continue across the gap to grab the Dragon Temple grace.
Follow the left path past the grace to a Golden Rune [11], then take the other path to a Smithing Stone [6] at the edge.
Go down the first set of stairs and through a long hallway to find a Stonesword Key.
Pick up Dragonwound Grease x2 from a corpse hanging off the ledge at the end.
Drop down and grab the Golden Rune [12] on top of the broken staircase.
From the Dragon Temple grace, jump onto the stairs below the cliff, then drop to the area below the grace. Go left after dropping to pick up a Rune Arc.
Follow the other path to a coffin with the Azula Beastman Ashes.
On the edge past the west doorway lies a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Head through the east corridor to discover the Dragon Temple Transept grace.
Kill the Godskin Duo for Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4], Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado, and 170,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Godskin Duo; Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]; Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado

links.label: Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado

steps.instruction: Bernahl's summon sign can be found at the entrance near the grace.
Activate the Dragon Temple Altar grace after the fight.
From the grace, head out the north exit and continue until you reach a Golden Rune [11] below an arcade.
Jump through the arcade and pick up Old Fang x5 from a corpse hanging off the gap.
Go around the outside of the ruined structure to find a Hero's Rune [5] (mind the gap in the ledge).
Continue down to a corridor and pick up the Smithing Stone [7] behind a fallen pillar straight ahead.
Go around the outside ledge to find a corpse with Lightning Grease x5 at the end.
Ascend the earlier stairs, then go up the slanted pillar on the left to grab an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Head back across and explore the area on the left. Behind a fallen pillar lies a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Unlock the imp seal and take the lift up to reach the Dragon Temple Lift grace.
Pick up a Lord's Rune from the large basin in the area past the grace.
Next to a tree down the left side of a building sits a corpse with Nascent Butterfly x2.
Continue up the rocky slope to grab a Smithing Stone [7] behind the building and a Golden Rune [12] behind the tree.
Go up the nearby stairs and loot the Smithing Stone [8] hanging off the edge past a tree.
Pick up the Rune Arc and Golden Seed past the gazebo.
Head past the arches to find a scarab that drops Golden Lightning Fortification.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [8] in front of a sleeping dragon.
Go below the arches opposite the dragon to find a slope near the edge that leads to Dragonwound Grease x2.
Run across the top of the arches and past a fallen tower to find Alexander. Pick up the Golden Rune [12] next to him.
Note: If you haven't progressed his questline, you'll see a sleeping dragon instead of Alexander.
Exhaust Alexander's dialogue to duel him. Talk to him after beating him to receive Shard of Alexander and Alexander's Innards.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [7] from the large platform past Alexander.
Continue uphill and grab the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4] from the slanted tower at the top.
Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the platform next to the tower, then drop down below it to grab a Smithing Stone [8].
Talk to Jar-Bairn and give him Alexander's Insides. Exhaust his dialogue, then reload the area to find the Companion Jar on the porch.
Talk to Enia now that you've burned the Erdtree.
Talk to Roderika in front of the fireplace.
Exhaust Hewg's dialogue about the god-slaying weapon and ask him why he's still making weapons.
Talk to Roderika about Hewg.
Return to Hewg and ask him what happened to her.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir and exhaust his dialogue option.
Return to Dragon Temple Lift and take the lift back down. Follow the platforms below the staircase to a Golden Rune [12] hanging off the edge.
Jump to the platform on the opposite side to grab the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2.
Turn right up the stairs to find a corpse with Dappled Cured Meat.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [8] from a floating platform past the Crucible Knight ahead.
Grab the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace on the rooftop below.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [6] from the corpse guarded by two Stormhawks.
Descend the ladder and drop down the platform below the edge. Head around the side of the tower for a chest with the Drake Knight Set.
Ride the lift to the top to find Lightning Greatbolt x5 next to the balustrade.
Drop off during the ride back down and pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from a patch of flowers down the ladder.
Rush toward the Ancient Dragon and kill it for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Pick up the Fulgurbloom x8 and Golden Rune [12] around the dragon, then grab the Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone in the gazebo.
steps.linkedRaw: Fulgurbloom x8; Golden Rune [12]; Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.instruction: Among the arches north of the gazebo lies a Golden Seed and a Smithing Stone [7].
Descend the floating platforms below the cliff near the gazebo to reach a building, then pick up a Golden Rune [12] next to a ladder.
Climb the ladder and open the chest near the balustrade to obtain the Dragon Towershield.
Take the lift up to reach a ladder past a Crucible Knight. Pick up the Boltdrake Talisman +2 from the edge of a window.
Return to where you fought the dragon, then follow the southwest path to a Somber Smithing Stone [7] hanging off a lower ledge on the right.
Cross the fallen remains of a tower and enter the church to find the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [5] in front of an altar.
Continue up the lift to grab the Beside the Great Bridge grace.

Head back down and descend the platforms below the cliff outside the church until you reach the bottom. Lie down in front of the tempest, then kill Dragonlord Placidusax for Remembrance of the Dragonlord and 280,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Dragonlord Placidusax; Remembrance of the Dragonlord

steps.instruction: Activate the Dragonlord Placidusax grace after the fight.
Return to Beside the Great Bridge and cross the north side of the bridge to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a balcony.
Bernahl invades you on the bridge below the ladder. Kill him for Blasphemous Claw, Devourer's Scepter, and the Beast Champion Set.
steps.linkedRaw: Blasphemous Claw; Devourer's Scepter; Beast Champion Set

steps.instruction: Loot the chest at the end of the bridge to obtain the Old Lord's Talisman.
Return to Beside the Great Bridge and kill the Draconic Tree Sentinel on the bridge to obtain the Malformed Dragon Set.
Pick up the Golden Rune [12] and Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the bridge.
Kill Maliketh, the Black Blade for Remembrance of the Black Blade and 220,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Maliketh, the Black Blade; Remembrance of the Black Blade

steps.instruction: Note: This is the game's biggest point of no return. Killing Maliketh will cover the entire capital in ash, locking you out of several quests and items. Make sure you've at least completed the missable steps in Capital Outskirts, Leyndell, and Forbidden Lands before proceeding.
steps.warning: MISSABLE — Note: This is the game's biggest point of no return. Killing Maliketh will cover the entire capital in ash, locking you out of several quests and items. Make sure you've at least completed the missable steps in Capital Outskirts, Leyndell, and Forbidden Lands before proceeding.

steps.instruction: Note: To access the DLC, you need to have killed both Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood.
steps.linkedRaw: Starscourge Radahn; Mohg, Lord of Blood

steps.instruction: Talk to Leda at the Cocoon of the Empyrean.
Touch Miquella's withered arm to enter the realm of shadow. The Gravesite Plain grace lies just outside the cave where you spawn.
From the grace, head northeast to a stele with Map: Gravesite Plain by the road.
Just north of the stele lies the Scorched Ruins:
Pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot from the lower east side of the ruins.
Continue up the east side to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [1] on a broken staircase.
On a higher up ledge next to the staircase sits a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x5.
From the ledge, jump onto the west balcony, then toward the covered bridge connecting both sides of the ruins to reach a corpse with Black Pyrefly x3.
On the lower west side of the ruins, behind some breakable jars, lies a Shadow Realm Rune [2].
Go up the stairs near the jars and pick up Furlcalling Finger Remedy x2 from the roof around the right corner.
Head across the covered bridge and grab the Blade of Mercy from the tower at the end.
Grab the Scorched Ruins grace just north past the ruins and pass time until nightfall.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the graveyard to the east of the grace for a Scadutree Fragment and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Pick up Black Pyrefly x3 from the corpse in the graveyard.
Follow the cliff near the graveyeard southeast to reach a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Continue along the cliff edge to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves (that only appear at night).
From the blue spiritgraves, head southwest to find Lump of Flesh x2 behind a stone arch near the cliff edge.
Explore the woods east of the arch to encounter Logur, the Beast Claw. Kill him to obtain the Beast Claw.
steps.linkedRaw: Logur, the Beast Claw; Beast Claw

steps.instruction: His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Savage Claws. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Follow the road near the woods down to a wagon with a Glass Shard, Black Pyrefly, and Arrow x10 close by.
steps.linkedRaw: Glass Shard; Black Pyrefly; Arrow x10

steps.instruction: Kill the Black Knight in the church down the road for the Black Steel Greathammer, then grab the Scadutree Fragment x2 in front of the statue.
steps.linkedRaw: Black Steel Greathammer; Scadutree Fragment x2

steps.instruction: In a cave opening near the cliff behind the church, you'll find a Blessing of Marika.
On the other side of the church lies a small encampment. Pick up Fire Coil x2 from one of the tents.
Return to the Scorched Ruins and head northeast to an opening in the cliff and grab "The Sacred Tower" Painting inside.
Pick up the Backhand Blade beside a coffin in the middle of some spiral pillars.
This weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Blind Spot. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
From the coffin, continue north-northwest to a stone arch with a Grave Glovewort [5] next to it.
Head toward the Miquella's Cross near the road and exhaust Hornsent's dialogue to receive the Cross Map.
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to the cross and grab the Three-Path Cross grace.
Exhaust Freyja's dialogue next to the grace.
Follow the road west to discover another cross. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment next to it and grab the Main Gate Cross grace.
Exhaust Ansbach's dialogue, then reload the area and ask him about the person in verdigris armor.
Talk to Moore and buy an item from him to unlock some additional dialogue.
From the grace, head southeast to a path in the cliffside and pick up Smithing Stone [5] x4 from the ledge.
Continue up the cliffside path to reach the Cliffroad Terminus grace.
In the graveyard southwest of the grace, kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner for a Scadutree Fragment and Silver Horn Tender (first time).
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [5] from the corpse in the graveyard.
Look for a pot hanging from the cliff east of the corpse. Shoot it down with a ranged weapon and pick up the String-Seller's Bell Bearing.
In the ruins near the cliff, climb the wall covered in fabric to enter Prospect Town:
Pick up Beast Blood x2 from the open building.
Go up the stairs to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3 on the ground.
Head up the slanted pillar to reach the upper section, then kill one of the Bloodfiends for the Bloodfiend's Arm (first time).
Pick up Sanguine Amaryllis x2 from the arcade and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] down the stairs north of it.
steps.linkedRaw: Sanguine Amaryllis x2; Somber Smithing Stone [6]

steps.instruction: Loot the Outer God Heirloom from a chest in the top building.
Return to the grace, pass time until nightfall, then follow the east cliff edge to a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash.
Head up the hill southwest of the statue to find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Interact with the friendly Kindred of Rot (Forager Brood) on the hill to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [2] and Black Pyrefly x3.
steps.linkedRaw: Forager Brood Cookbook [2]; Black Pyrefly x3

steps.instruction: Note: Do not attack any of the Forager Brood. They are non-hostile, and killing them will end Moore's questline early.
Pick up Great Arrow x10, Sacred Bloody Flesh x2, and Smithing Stone [5] x4 from a small campsite with two corpses just below the hill.
steps.linkedRaw: Great Arrow x10; Sacred Bloody Flesh x2; Smithing Stone [5] x4

steps.instruction: Follow the path near the campsite into the woods to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [5] on some rocks next to a large sheep.
At the end of the woods are two paths. Climb the rocky slope first to grab the "Incursion" Painting from the shack at the top.
Head back and follow the cliffside path down to a church. Pick up the Blessed Blue Dew Talisman in front of the statue.
Grab the Oathseeker Knight Set and Pata from a corpse hanging off the cliff behind the church.
Travel to the Scorched Ruins and head west to a mausoleum. Kill the Knight of the Solitary Gaol inside for Greatsword of Solitude, Solitude Set, and 70,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Knight of the Solitary Gaol; Greatsword of Solitude; Solitude Set

steps.instruction: Kill the Furnace Golem near the Scorched Ruins for the Deflecting Hardtear and a Furnace Visage.
From the Three-Path Cross, head northwest along the cliff to reach a campsite with Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw.
steps.linkedRaw: Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw

links.label: Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw

steps.instruction: In the lower field northwest of the campsite, next to a stone arch by the cliff, lies a Shadow Realm Rune [1].
On the small hill just northeast of the stone arch, you'll find the Serpent Crest Shield (painting reward).
Kill the Ghostflame Dragon in the lake for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 100,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghostflame Dragon; Dragon Heart; Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.instruction: Grab the Great Katana from a corpse in front of the dragon.
This weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Overhead Stance. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
At the west end of the lake lies the entrance to Belurat Gaol:
Head inside and grab the Belurat Gaol grace down the stairs.
Enter the first cell on the left to pick up Frozen Maggot x6.
After the stairs collapse, enter the nearby cell for a Silver Horn Tender next to some crates.
Cross the narrow passage to find Frozen Maggot x4 on a corpse hanging off the ledge.
Jump through the hole in the next room, then continue to a Broken Rune between two tables.
Pick up Thawfrost Boluses from the ledge just outside the table room.
Continue to a circular room. Before dropping down, enter the cell to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3].
Descend the pots in the circular room and pick up Glass Shard from the corpse on top of a pot halfway down.
From the corpse, drop onto the west pot to reach a wooden ledge. Grab a Hefty Cracked Pot from the chest on the ledge.
Continue until the floor collapses, then follow the only path forward in the maze to find Lost Ashes of War in front of some boxes.
Follow either southwest path to a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x3. The nearby gate is the exit, so remember it for later.
Climb the slanted pots near the corpse to enter another maze, then climb the pots in the back to reach the Innard Meat and Hefty Cracked Pot on top of the pots.
Next to another set of slanted pots lies a corpse with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [11].
Climb the second set of slanted pots, then follow either path to a Hefty Cracked Pot on top of some pots at the end.
Drop down to return to the exit gate, then pick up Smithing Stone [6] x4 from a cage on the right.
Instead of dropping down to the boss, drop onto the west pot lift below the cliff and continue to an altar with the Greatjar on top.
Descend the pots below the east-side corner to return, then kill Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze for Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh and 80,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze; Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh

steps.instruction: From the gaol entrance, head north to find the Gravebird Armor in front of a stone arch.
Head east-northeast from the arch to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x3, guarded by two dogs.
Just past the corpse lies a shack with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [10].
On the ledge above the shack lies a corpse with Fly Mold x3.
Head around the ledge to discover the Greatbridge, North grace outside the Abandoned Ailing Village:
Pass time until nightfall, then grab the Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves near the cliff.
Follow the cliff edge up to a corpse with Black Pyrefly x2 and a statue holding a Revered Spirit Ash just past it.
steps.linkedRaw: Black Pyrefly x2; Revered Spirit Ash

steps.instruction: A corpse with Human Bone Shard lies on the upper ledge near the statue.
In a house west of the corpse, you'll find a Broken Rune.
Pick up the Ailment Talisman from a wooden platform at the top of the village.
Return to the grace and head below the greatbridge to find a shack with 2x Furnace Visage and Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2].
From the Three-Path Cross, follow the north-northeast road and loot the Ballista Bolt x5, Lost Ashes of War, and Shadow Realm Rune [1] on the greatbridge.
steps.linkedRaw: Ballista Bolt x5; Lost Ashes of War; Shadow Realm Rune [1]

steps.instruction: Pick up the Scadutree Fragment in front of a statue at the fork in the road, then grab the Castle Front grace next to the castle bridge.
Drop down to the left of the castle bridge, then follow the slope down to a castle room with the Spelldrake Talisman +3.
Head toward the top of the slope, then go north past some spiked barricades and pick up the Black Pyrefly x5 under a canopy.
On a higher up ledge past the canopy sits a corpse with Messmerfire Grease and Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Continue north until you reach the entrance to Fog Rift Catacombs:
Take the lift down and grab the Fog Rift Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [5] from the corpse in the first corridor.
Reach the room with a Bigmouth Imp firing at you from a ledge, then grab the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] from the east corridor.
Trigger the impaling mechanism down the opposite room without dropping, then jump onto it to reach a ledge with Knot Resin x3.
Go through the corridor on top of the mechanism to reach a room with a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Approach the closest arch outside the room without dropping to trigger the impaling mechanism, then jump across it to reach a coffin with Black Knight Commander Andreas.
Return to the room with the Bigmouth Imp on a ledge, then pick up Dragonbolt Grease x2 from the west room floor.
Take the lift down, then pick up Rada Fruit x4 from the corpse below the staircase.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [6] from the corpse in the west room.
In the large room, drop down the hole in the second alcove on the left. After landing, grab the Ghost Glovewort [5] at the east end.
Pick up Electrocharge from the corpse in the west room near the ladder.
Climb the ladder and return to the large room, then pick up Glass Shard from the third alcove on the left.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from the coffin at the south end of the room.
Stand near the balustrade to trigger the impaling mechanism, then jump inside it to reach a chest with Ash of War: Blinkbolt.
Run along the top of the mechanism to reach a stele with the Stone-Sheathed Sword.
Descend the ladder near the stele to enter a small room with a Ghost Glovewort [6].
Drop down to the large room, then enter the room on the west side for a Broken Rune below another impaling mechanism.
Take the lift down and kill the Death Knight for Death Knight's Twin Axes, Crimson Amber Medallion +3, and 110,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Death Knight; Death Knight's Twin Axes; Crimson Amber Medallion +3

steps.instruction: Travel to Castle Front and pick up Fire Knight's Cookbook [2] from a tent in the west-southwest part of the encampment.
In the encampment opposite the road sits a chest with the Firespark Perfume Bottle.
Drop down the ledges in the cliff southeast of the chest. Near the lower far-right cliff, in front of a tent, lies the Spread Crossbow.
At the edge of the cliff, just northwest from the tent, is a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x3.
Follow the cliff past the battlefield of enemies to reach the entrance to the Ruined Forge Lava Intake:
Enter the forge and grab the Ruined Forge Lava Intake grace.
After descending the ladder, take the first left to a room with Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithing Stone [6] x6.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [4]; Smithing Stone [1]; Smithing Stone [6] x6

steps.instruction: Head down to a balcony with Smithing Stone [3], Smithing Stone [1], and Smithing Stone [5] x4.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [3]; Smithing Stone [1]; Smithing Stone [5] x4

steps.instruction: Continue to a large room with a ladder. Pick up the Smithing Stone [4] and Smithing Stone [1] around the corner behind the ladder.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1], Smithing Stone [4], and 2x Smithing Stone [3] next to the Golem Smith near the ladder.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [1]; Smithing Stone [4]; Smithing Stone [3]

steps.instruction: Next to the staircase opposite the Golem Smith is a Somber Smithing Stone [5].
Grab the Smithing Stone [4] in the middle of the room, then pick up the Smithing Stone [1] at the end.
Head around the wall and grab the Smithing Stone [4], Smithing Stone [3], and Somber Smithing Stone [7] next to a Golem Smith.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [4]; Smithing Stone [3]; Somber Smithing Stone [7]

steps.instruction: Go up the stairs and pick up the Smithing Stone [3] and Greater Potentate's Cookbook [13] around the corner.
Head up the broken structure and pick up the Smithing Stone [7] x3 and 2x Smithing Stone [1] on the top platform.
Jump across the broken wall to reach a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x5 on the roof of the furnace.
Return to the top platform and descend the ladder there. Pull the lever, then grab the Smithing Stone [1] and Glass Shard behind it.
Drop down and loot the 2x Smithing Stone [4] and Smithscript Dagger on the ground.
Jump onto the pipe and climb it to the top room. Examine the altar to obtain the Anvil Hammer and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
steps.linkedRaw: Anvil Hammer; Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.instruction: From the forge entrance, head down the northeast slope until you reach a poison swamp. Then head south to find a corpse with Festive Grease in a patch of flowers.
Head back across the poison swamp and pick up Toxic Mossling x8 from a corpse against the rocks.
In the poison swamp farther east, behind a Miranda Blossom, lies the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [7].
Head along the southeast cliff until you reach a shack with Talisman of the Dread.
Destroy the stacked stones on the ledge northwest of the shack (or use Margit's Shackle) to unseal the spiritspring. It can be used to reach Scadu Altus without having to go through Castle Ensis.
Travel to Castle Front and follow the east-southeast road into the woods. Pick up the Swift Spear next to a campfire by the road.
Continue to a fork, then take the left path to discover the Pillar Path Cross grace and a Scadutree Fragment.
Talk to Thiollier sitting next to the cross.
Travel to the Main Gate Cross and talk to Moore to receive the Black Syrup.
Give Thiollier the Black Syrup, ask him about it, then tell him that you're weary of life to receive Thiollier's Concoction.
Return to the fork in the road and follow the other path to a Grave Glovewort [6] near some gravestones.
Continue uphill and grab the Pillar Path Waypoint grace at another fork in the road.
Pass time until nightfall, then head up south toward a stone platform with Gravebird Bracelets.
In the upper meadow southeast of the stone platform, you'll find a Larval Tear surrounded by blue spiritgraves.
Head toward the tower at the top. Below a ledge behind it is a small campsite with Smithing Stone [6] x4.
Take the lift inside the tower and loot the chest at the top for an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Return to Pillar Path Waypoint and talk to Igon near the grace.
Follow the path past Igon to be invaded by Ancient Dragon-Man. Kill him for 24,519 runes.
Look for a pot hanging from a cliff above one of the headless dragon statues. Shoot it down to obtain Herbalist's Bell Bearing.
Continue along the path to reach the entrance to Dragon's Pit:
Enter the cave and grab the Dragon's Pit grace.
Pick up Smithing Stone [7] x4 from the southwest end of the first room.
Continue to the next room and grab the Shadow Realm Rune [2] in front of the urn sculpture.
Kill the Magma Wyrm up the stairs in the next room to obtain a Dragon Heart and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
steps.linkedRaw: Dragon Heart; Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.instruction: Pick up Knot Resin x4 and Smithing Stone [5] x3 from the room with the Magma Wyrm.
steps.linkedRaw: Knot Resin x4; Smithing Stone [5] x3

steps.instruction: Go down the stairs in the previous room, then take the plunge. After landing, turn around for Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Kill Ancient Dragon-Man for the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana and 130,000 runes.
Open the door and grab the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace for later.
Ascend the stairs near Main Gate Cross and enter Belurat. Pick up Revered Spirit Ash x2 from the statue in the first room.
Behind the statue sits a corpse with a Shadow Realm Rune [1].
Grab the Fireproof Dried Liver guarded by a Spider Scorpion up the stairs.
Continue up the stairs for a corpse with Black Pyrefly x5.
At the top of the stairs, you'll discover the Belurat, Tower Settlement grace.
A corpse with Neutralizing Boluses lies in the room next to the grace.
Head through the alley and pick up the Stimulating Boluses in front of the fountain.
Grab the Knot Resin x3 in front of the waterfall, but watch out for the ambush.
Go up the stairs, then turn right for a Somber Smithing Stone [5] next to another fountain.
Take the first right at the street to find a corpse with Messmerfire Grease.
At the end of the street lies a corpse with Black Pyrefly x3.
Destroy the jars in the nearby room to reveal a Silver Horn Tender.
Head up the stairs and grab the Small Private Altar grace.
Take a left when exiting the room, then cross the rooftops closest to the grace to reach a Silver Horn Tender on the last roof.
Go back to the bridge, then cross the rooftops on the other side of the street to reach a corpse with Silver Horn Tender x2, Golden Horn Tender x2, and a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
steps.linkedRaw: Silver Horn Tender x2; Golden Horn Tender x2; Somber Smithing Stone [7]

steps.instruction: Return to the grace and take the other path up the stairs. Follow the street down to a plaza, where you'll be invaded by Fire Knight Queelign. Defeat him to obtain the Crusade Insignia.
Loot the Dewgem x3, Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow, and Black Pyrefly x3 in the plaza.
steps.linkedRaw: Dewgem x3; Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow; Black Pyrefly x3
linkedItemNames: Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow

links.label: Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow

steps.instruction: Climb the rubble in the corner of the plaza to reach a corpse with Arrow x10 above the entrance.
Exit the plaza and grab the Black Pyrefly x2 and Thin Beast Bones x4 on the rooftops near the street.
steps.linkedRaw: Black Pyrefly x2; Thin Beast Bones x4

steps.instruction: Go through the alley past the rooftops and pick up Redflesh Mushroom x5 from the corpse in the water.
At the brink of the waterfall lies a corpse with String x4.
Climb the ladder in the nearby room to find a corpse with the Storeroom Key.
Take a left down the stairs when exiting the room to find Throwing Dagger x3 at the end of the broken bridge.
From the top of the stairs, take a right onto the rooftops and pick up the Flight Pinion x4 on the first roof.
On the second roof lies a corpse with Smithing Stone [6] x2.
Drop onto the corner of the roof southwest of the corpse to reach a room with the Well Depths Key and Whiteflesh Mushroom x6
steps.linkedRaw: Well Depths Key; Whiteflesh Mushroom x6

steps.instruction: Return to the top of the stairs, then go left twice and ride the lift down the stairs. Pull the lever to unlock the door to the first grace.
Proceed through Belurat like before, but this time, descend the well near the second fountain. Pick up Messmerfire Grease from the pile of corpses there.
Unlock the well depths door and head southwest toward two fallen towers. Pick up Smithing Stone [6] x4 from the roof of a building near the towers.
Kill the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the area past the fallen towers for the Immunizing Horn Charm +2.
Loot the Thin Beast Bones x8, Sliver of Meat x2, Broken Rune, Smithing Stone [5] x2, and Poisonbone Dart x8 in the swamp.
steps.linkedRaw: Thin Beast Bones x8; Sliver of Meat x2; Broken Rune; Smithing Stone [5] x2; Poisonbone Dart x8

steps.instruction: Head the other direction until you come to a bridge. Grab the Neutralizing Boluses in the left corner between two buildings just before the bridge.
Pick up Serpent Arrow x8 from the top of a building on an island of rubble past the bridge.
Kill the Horned Warrior north of the building for the Horned Warrior's Sword, then grab the Beast Liver x3 he's guarding.
steps.linkedRaw: Horned Warrior's Sword; Beast Liver x3

steps.instruction: Grab the Poisoned Hand next to a building in the poison, then pick up Knot Resin x5 from the other island.
Head south-southeast toward a tower with a ladder, then continue south toward a tree in the poison. Just past it is a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x4.
Climb the ladder in front of the tower and unlock the shortcut back to the grace.
Ride the lift near the grace again, then at the top of the stairs, enter the room straight ahead to pick up the Bone Bow.
When exiting the room, climb the rubble on the left to reach a room with Thin Beast Bones x5.
Grab the Scadutree Fragment in the next room and touch the cross to unlock dialogue with Ansbach about the cross at the tower.
Exit the room and pick up Dried Bouquet from the small building outside.
Drop down west of the building and grab the Fly Mold x4, Redflesh Mushroom x8, Stanching Boluses, and Glass Shard around the water.
steps.linkedRaw: Fly Mold x4; Redflesh Mushroom x8; Stanching Boluses; Glass Shard

steps.instruction: Follow the water to a room with a Broken Rune and a ladder.
Climb the ladder, then take a left across the covered bridge and kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner for a Revered Spirit Ash and Golden Horn Tender (first time).
steps.linkedRaw: Revered Spirit Ash; Golden Horn Tender

steps.instruction: A corpse with Black Pyrefly x3 lies on the left after crossing the bridge.
Go back across the bridge and continue along the street. Pick up Black Pyrefly x4 from the corpse hanging off the left edge.
Pick up a Revered Spirit Ash from the statue on the nearby altar.
Enter the circular tower and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [5] on the bottom end of the staircase.
Make your way up the stairs and grab the Stagefront grace at the top.
Open the door and kill the Divine Beast Dancing Lion for Remembrance of the Dancing Lion and 120,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Divine Beast Dancing Lion; Remembrance of the Dancing Lion

steps.instruction: If you summon Freyja for the boss, she'll have some additional dialogue afterward.
Pick up the Divine Beast Head dropped by the boss, then grab the Theatre of the Divine Beast grace.
steps.linkedRaw: Divine Beast Head; Theatre of the Divine Beast

steps.instruction: Take the nearby lift, then after opening the door, pick up the Revered Spirit Ash on the statue.
Grab the Tower of Shadow Message at the top of the giant staircase.
Travel to the Small Private Altar and unlock the storeroom at the end of the bridge. Exhaust Hornsent Grandam's dialogue while wearing the Divine Beast Head to receive Watchful Spirit.
Open the shortcut door at the other side of the storeroom.
Talk to Hornsent Grandam after reloading the area to receive a Scorpion Stew.
Give Hornsent a Scorpion Stew, then talk to him again to receive Furnace Visage x3. If you've entered Scadu Altus, Hornsent will be located at the Highroad Cross.
Obtain another Scorpion Stew from Hornsent Grandam and attempt to give it to Hornsent.
If you summoned Freyja for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, ask her about the damage to her helm, then ask about that other man.
Talk to Ansbach about the cross at the tower.
From Castle Front, head east-southeast toward the mountain wall, then follow it to a Grave Glovewort [5] on the cliff edge.
Descend the ledges below the cliff to reach a Shadow Realm Rune [1] on a lower ledge.
Enter the tunnel at the bottom, then pick up Deep-Purple Lily from the corpse on the ledge.
Pick up the Revered Spirit Ash farther in, then grab the Ellac River Cave grace just past it.
steps.linkedRaw: Revered Spirit Ash; Ellac River Cave

steps.instruction: Follow the river northwest until you're ambushed by an Ulcerated Tree Spirit. Kill it to obtain Horned Bairn.
A Shadow Realm Rune [2] lies on the rock that juts from the water where you were ambushed.
Hug the right side while continuing upstream to discover an alcove with Fly Mold x3.
Continue along the river to find a Silver Horn Tender on top of a pile of corpses.
Go through the waterfall at the end to discover a room with the Two-Headed Turtle Talisman.
Head toward the cliff edge southwest of the waterfall, then turn around and shoot down the pot hanging from the cliff face to obtain Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [1].
On the opposite side of the cliff face lies the entrance to Rivermouth Cave:
Head inside and activate the Rivermouth Cave grace.
Pick up the Hefty Beast Bone x2 guarded by some wolves in the first room.
Past the first room, go right for an alcove with Sliver of Meat x3.
Step on the crack in the floor up the rocks in the next room. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [1] after landing.
Continue to a cavern, then follow the right path to a corpse with Sacred Bloody Flesh.
Return to the cavern. Pick up Sanguine Amaryllis x6 from the corpse in the alcove and Sacred Bloody Flesh x3 from the altar.
steps.linkedRaw: Sanguine Amaryllis x6; Sacred Bloody Flesh x3

steps.instruction: Kill the Chief Bloodfiend for Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes and 80,000 runes.
Travel to Ellac River Cave and head downstream. Pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [12] on a rocky platform past the waterfall.
Continue past the second waterfall and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [6] guarded by Gravebirds.
A Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone lies at the base of the second waterfall, guarded by a Crayfish that drops Smithing Stone [8] x3 and a Strip of White Flesh (first time).
steps.linkedRaw: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone; Smithing Stone [8] x3; Strip of White Flesh

steps.instruction: Drop down the third waterfall to find a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x6 next to a tall rock in the water.
Grab the Ellac River Downstream grace on dry land near the tall rock.
Shoot down the pot hanging in front of the last waterfall to obtain Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [2].
Head east into the woods to find a friendly Forager Brood near the cliff. Interact with it to receive Forager Brood Cookbook [3] and Yellow Fulgurbloom x3.
steps.linkedRaw: Forager Brood Cookbook [3]; Yellow Fulgurbloom x3

steps.instruction: Pick up the Lightning Perfume Bottle from the pond in the woods.
Kill the Furnace Golem patrolling the river for the Viridian Hidden Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Note: This one can also be killed from above in Charo's Hidden Grave if you're struggling.
Follow the wooded path on the other side of the river to the Cerulean Coast grace.
From the Cerulean Coast grace, head southwest toward a stone coffin shaped like a ship. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [9] on top of it.
Pick up another Grave Glovewort [9] from the stone coffin northwest of the first.
Continue west while sticking to the right side of the water to find a Grave Glovewort [7] near some Gravebirds.
Pick up Spiritgrave Stone x2, Lost Ashes of War, Shadow Realm Rune [3], and String x3 from the corpses in the water.
steps.linkedRaw: Spiritgrave Stone x2; Lost Ashes of War; Shadow Realm Rune [3]; String x3

steps.instruction: Grab the Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1] next to the large dead tree by the water.
In the area northwest of the dead tree, you'll discover the Cerulean Coast West grace.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [6] next to some graves just north-northwest of the grace.
Climb the stone coffin next to the grace and grab the Grave Glovewort [8] on top of it.
Head through the nearby ravine and pick up the Smithing Stone [6] x4 in front of a large gravestone, guarded by a Demi-Human Swordsman that drops Starlight Shards (first time).
Explore the dead end east of the gravestone to find a corpse with the Spirit Sword.
Return to the large gravestone, then head north while sticking to the right side to discover an alcove with a Scadutree Fragment.
Continue to the beach and kill Demi-Human Queen Marigga for the Star-Lined Sword and 100,000 runes.
Pick up a Great Grave Glovewort from the stone coffin on the beach.
Return to Cerulean Coast West and head southeast back to the large dead tree. Descend the cave below the tree, then follow the tunnel east to a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Continue up the tunnel to reach a stone coffin with a Great Grave Glovewort.
Go back down the tunnel and follow it to a corpse with Crab Eggs x2, guarded by a Crayfish.
Head through the rest of the tunnel, then grab the Perfumed Oil of Ranah from the top of the cave exit.
Enter the mausoleum on the other side of the island and kill the Dancer of Ranah for Dancing Blade of Ranah, Dancer's Set and 80,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Dancer of Ranah; Dancing Blade of Ranah; Dancer's Set

steps.instruction: Kill the Ghostflame Dragon south of the Cerulean Coast grace for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 120,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Ghostflame Dragon; Dragon Heart; Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone

steps.instruction: Loot the Human Bone Shard, Smithing Stone [7] x4, and Grave Cricket x6 on the outer edge of one of the islands.
steps.linkedRaw: Human Bone Shard; Smithing Stone [7] x4; Grave Cricket x6

steps.instruction: Grab another Grave Cricket x6 from the corpse in front of a large gravestone on the last island.
Go up the slope past the last island to find a stele with Map: Southern Shore.
From the stele, head south-southeast and up the hillside with the cross to discover the Cerulean Coast Cross grace.
Grab the Scadutree Fragment, then touch the cross to unlock dialogue with Ansbach about the cross at the coast.
Head northwest and climb the stone coffin above the map stele for a Grave Glovewort [9].
