Pick up the Ancient Ruins Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment by the Miquella's Cross to the southwest, then grab the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East grace.
steps.linkedRaw: Ancient Ruins Cross Message; Scadutree Fragment; Rauh Ancient Ruins, East

steps.instruction: Kill Crucible Knight Devonia near the grace for Devonia's Hammer and Crucible Hammer-Helm.
Quickly pick up Dewgem x4 and Flight Pinion x2 from the upper half of the bridge.
Kill the Furnace Golem for the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage.
Go south up a short hill to find the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace by the cliff.
Head into the ruins and pick up Kukri x6 from the first flight of stairs.
Kill the pot-carrying Shadow Commoner in the room upstairs for Spirit Calculus x3 (first time).
Pick up the Scadutree Fragment in front of the altar in the room.
Head through the southwest corridor to find a corpse with Spiritgrave Stone x2.
Take the lift up, then drop down twice to the left of it to reach a corpse with Four-Toed Fowl Foot x3.

Head across the thin platforms to a lift, but don't take it up yet. Instead, continue southeast across more platforms to reach a narrow passage. Open the chest inside to obtain the Talisman of All Crucibles.
Return through the next passage, then take the lift up to the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway grace.
Going down the stairs, hug the right side until you see a corpse with Spirit Calculus at the cliff's edge.
Return to the stairs and grab the Smithing Stone [7] x3 guarded by two dogs.
At the end of the stairway, drop down and continue to a Shadow Realm Rune [7].
Drop down southeast and kill the Divine Beast Dancing Lion for Divine Beast Tornado and 180,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Divine Beast Dancing Lion; Divine Beast Tornado

steps.instruction: Travel to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace and return to the altar. This time, head outside and pick up the Revered Spirit Ash in a gazebo.
Continue to an area with scarlet rot, then take the lift on the left side. Pick up the Scarlet Bud x6 to the right of a staircase.
Behind the staircase is a corpse with Pest-Thread Spears.
If you killed Messmer with Hornsent's help and exhausted his dialogue afterward, he'll invade on the staircase. Kill him for the Falx and the Hornsent Set.
Activate the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace up the stairs for later.
steps.linkedRaw: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance

links.label: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance

steps.instruction: Go back down the stairs and out the southeast exit, hugging the left wall until you see some stacked stones. Destroy them to unseal the spiritspring below.
From the stones, head south-southwest and pick up Divine Bird Feathers from a corpse in the water.
Jump onto the roof of the gazebo east-southeast of the corpse to reach a Shadow Realm Rune [4].
Drop down and head back through the scarlet rot to find Dappled White Cured Meat x2 at the end.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [8] x6, Immunizing Cured Meat x3, and Fly Mold x4 in the scarlet rot.
steps.linkedRaw: Smithing Stone [8] x6; Immunizing Cured Meat x3; Fly Mold x4

steps.instruction: Head outside to find the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [9] on some rocks beside the wall.
Cross the invisible bridge to reach a stele that can be used to raise your Stone-Sheathed Sword (or Sword of Darkness) into the Sword of Light.
Note: If you obtained the Stone-Sheathed Sword here, the Sword of Light is instead acquired at the stele in the Ruins of Unte.

Jump to the plateau beside the bridge, then, facing its west-southwest edge, drop down twice to an area with red trees. Continue down to a lift, then go past it to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] on some rocks.
Pick up Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom from a corpse guarded by Miranda flowers at the end.
Head back to the lift and take it up to a pot-carrying Shadow Commoner that drops a Revered Spirit Ash and a Silver Horn Tender (first time).
steps.linkedRaw: Revered Spirit Ash; Silver Horn Tender

steps.instruction: Drop down and go out the south-southeast exit to find Knot Resin x3 behind the second pillar.
Go up the first flight of stairs, then head northeast and kill the Chief Bloodfiend accompanied by dogs for Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 (first time).
Pick up a Golden Horn Tender from the corpse between two of the pillars.
Use the spiritspring in the middle while facing east, then pick up Beast Horn x2 from the roof of some connecting pillars to the south.
Head up the final sets of stairs to reach a chest containing the Mottled Necklace +2.
Travel to the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace and kill Romina, Saint of the Bud for Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud and 380,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Romina, Saint of the Bud; Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

links.label: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

steps.instruction: Dryleaf Dane's summon sign can be found next to the road outside.
Activate the Church of the Bud grace after the fight.
Continue ahead and use Messmer's Kindling to burn the Sealing Tree.
After burning the Sealing Tree to end up in Enir-Ilim, turn around for a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Activate the Enir-Ilim: Outer Wall grace next to the shut door and rest at it.
Travel to the Temple Town Ruins grace, then head up to the Northern Nameless Mausoleum. Halfway down the slope southwest of it, you'll now find the Spiraltree Seal (painting reward).
Return to Enir-Ilim and make your way into a tower with the First Rise grace inside.
Continue down the corridor to find some Messmerfire Grease on a flight of stairs.
You can send the shortcut lift down to Belurat, but it is already usable from both ends.
Head up the stairs near the grace to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a broken span.
Drop down from the roofs and go up the stairs. Pick up a Broken Rune from the ash on the right.
Jump over a branch in the nearby room to find a Rune Arc on a small altar.
Kill the large Inquisitor circling the fountain for a Revered Spirit Ash (first time).
Pick up the Budding Horn x4 surrounded by a group of Inquisitors.
In the courtyard's eastern corner is a corpse with Lightningproof Pickled Liver x2.
Looking north, jump over the fence to land next to a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x8.
Circle around the tree to pick up Whiteflesh Mushroom x3.
Follow one of the tree's roots to a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x4.
Pick up the Revered Spirit Ash x2 guarded by Man-Flies at the end.
Head up the stairs in the courtyard to continue. Before you encounter the Divine Beast Warrior, drop down onto the same tree for Furlcalling Finger Remedy x3 behind you as you drop.
Follow the tree's northern branch to a separate platform. Pick up Spira from the altar.
Past the Divine Beast Warrior is a corpse with a Dragonbolt Grease.
Head up the first set of stairs, then pick up a Drawstring Golden Grease from the left alcove.
Quickly grab the Fire Arrow x10 and Golden Bolt x10 when running up the rest of the stairs.
steps.linkedRaw: Fire Arrow x10; Golden Bolt x10

steps.instruction: Open the door, pick up the Scadutree Fragment, and activate the Spiral Rise grace.
Head back and down the stairs in the other alcove to discover a room with the Inquisitor Ashes.
To the right when exiting the room, jump down onto a bridge for Fireproof Pickled Liver x2.
From the tower, drop down and make your way across the arches to reach a Holyproof Pickled Liver.
Drop through the broken arch to land near a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3.
At the other end, drop down to another ledge and follow it up to a corpse with Lordsworn's Bolt x10.
Follow the ledge down to drop onto a staircase, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the tower.
Pick up the Fireproof Pickled Liver just down the stairs.
Do a running jump to the window below to land in Belurat. Head outside for a Scadutree Fragment.
Up the northeastern stairs is a lift that takes you back to Enir-Ilim.
Take the lift down the southeastern stairs, then continue until you reach a door with the Euporia inside.
Return to the Spiral Rise grace and go up the stairs to reach the rooftops. Pick up Smithing Stone [8] x5 from a raised roof on the right.
Continue to a room on the left with the last Revered Spirit Ash.
From the stairs, jump over the railing to land on a staircase with a Silver Horn Tender.
Pick up Horned Warrior Ashes, Stanching Boluses, and Neutralizing Boluses x2 from the room ahead.
steps.linkedRaw: Horned Warrior Ashes; Stanching Boluses; Neutralizing Boluses x2

steps.instruction: Climb the ladder to a corpse with a Golden Horn Tender hanging from the broken balustrade.
Climb the second ladder to get the high ground on the Divine Beast Warrior. In the room to the northwest, you'll find a Scadutree Fragment.
In the corner east of the room is a corpse with Sunwarmth Stone x2.
Continue up to a tower, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] at the bottom of the stairs.
Use the lift up the stairs while facing south-southwest. Jump off halfway to grab the Gravebird Helm. (If you failed the jump, it can also be reached from the broken staircase near the lift.)
Drop down, then head outside for a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at the end.
Take the lift back up, then kill the final Divine Beast Warrior for the Horned Warrior's Greatsword.
Activate the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace and grab the last Scadutree Fragment.
Note: This is your last chance to decide Moore's fate, pass St. Trina's final words to Thiollier, deliver Freyja's letter, and give Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll before exhausting his dialogue.
Enter the chamber and kill Needle Knight Leda and her allies for Leda's Sword and 300,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Needle Knight Leda and her allies; Leda's Sword

links.label: Needle Knight Leda and her allies

steps.instruction: Thiollier can be summoned if you passed on St. Trina's final words after his invasion. Summoning him unlocks a dialogue option with Ansbach (if he is also summoned).

Ansbach can be summoned if you gave him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhausted his dialogue. Summoning him causes him to appear before the final battle, allowing you to speak with him for some extra dialogue.
Sanguine Noble Nataan can be summoned if Ansbach is not available.
If Moore appeared in the fight, loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse.
steps.linkedRaw: Moore's Bell Bearing; Verdigris Greatshield; Verdigris Set

steps.instruction: If Freyja appeared in the fight, loot Freyja's Greatsword and Freyja's Set from her corpse.
If Hornsent appeared in the fight, loot the Falx and the Hornsent Set from his corpse.
Pick up Dane's Footwork from Dryleaf Dane's corpse.
Pick up Leda's Armor from her corpse beyond the room.
If you summoned Ansbach, he appears at the top of the last lift. Ask him about Mohg's death. If you also summoned Thiollier, you can also ask him about Thiollier.
Head up the final set of stairs to activate the Divine Gate Front Staircase grace.
Kill Promised Consort Radahn for Remembrance of a God and a Lord and 500,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Promised Consort Radahn; Remembrance of a God and a Lord

links.label: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

steps.instruction: Thiollier's and Ansbach's summon signs can be found outside the entrance if they were each summoned against Leda and her allies.
Activate the Gate of Divinity grace and rest at it to reload the area.
Pick up Thiollier's Hidden Needle and Thiollier's Set from his corpse.
Pick up Ansbach's Set, Obsidian Lamina, and Furious Blade of Ansbach from his corpse.
steps.linkedRaw: Ansbach's Set; Obsidian Lamina; Furious Blade of Ansbach

steps.instruction: If you didn't die to Radahn's grab attack, pick up the Let Us Go Together gesture beside the memory.
Touch Miquella's memory to view a short cutscene and obtain the Circlet of Light.
Travel to the Garden of Deep Purple grace and pick up St. Trina's Blossom from St. Trina's corpse.

If you forgot to make the choice for Moore's questline and he is still at the Main Gate Cross, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off for the Verdigris Greatshield and the Verdigris Set. Pick up Moore's Bell Bearing from where he usually sits.
steps.linkedRaw: Verdigris Greatshield; Verdigris Set; Moore's Bell Bearing

steps.instruction: Congratulations on completing Shadow of the Erdtree! Now return to the base game or prepare for NG+.
After the cutscene, grab the Leyndell, Capital of Ash grace just ahead.
Talk to Hewg about himself.
Talk to Roderika about what's happened to Hewg, then exhaust her dialogue option.
After Leyndell changes, several sites of grace become unavailable. However, the following can be reactivated:
The East Capital Rampart grace can be found again in Boc's room.
The Divine Bridge grace can be reached via the trap chest at the Tower of Return in Weeping Peninsula.
Enter the capital from the Forbidden Lands grace and pick up Erdtree's Favor +2 from a root in the ash-covered area with three Ulcerated Tree Spirits.
Return to Leyndell, Capital of Ash and head south-southwest to find a manhole. Drop through it to land on a rafter with the Crimson Amber Medallion +2.
Head back to the manhole and pick up the Tarnished Golden Sunflower through the doorway on the right.
Climb the ladder in the wall below Gransax to reach the West Capital Rampart. In front of Fortified Manor lies a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Return to the grace and head straight south to find a Rune Arc.
Continue past the giant spear to find a Golden Sunflower at the base of a statue's spear.

Next to the staircase farther south, a narrow path leads to a bridge. Cross it to find Goldmask's corpse holding the Mending Rune of Perfect Order. Reload the area and pick up Goldmask's Set from the corpse.
steps.linkedRaw: Mending Rune of Perfect Order; Goldmask's Set

steps.instruction: Head back to find Corhyn at the base of the giant spear. After talking to him, reload the area to pick up Corhyn's Bell Bearing, Flail, and Corhyn's Robe.
steps.linkedRaw: Corhyn's Bell Bearing; Flail; Corhyn's Robe

steps.instruction: Note: If you gave him the Tonic of Forgetfulness, he'll be on the bridge in Mountaintops of the Giants instead.
On one of the rooftops southeast of the giant spear sits a corpse with a Hero's Rune [4].
Go up the staircase and kill Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing for Scepter of the All-Knowing, All-Knowing Set, and 150,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing; Scepter of the All-Knowing; All-Knowing Set

steps.instruction: Reactivate the Erdtree Sanctuary grace after the fight.
Continue toward the throne to reactivate the Queen's Bedchamber grace and grab the Erdtree Heal on the bed.
Kill Godfrey, First Elden Lord for Remembrance of Hoarah Loux and 300,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Godfrey, First Elden Lord; Remembrance of Hoarah Loux

steps.instruction: Nepheli can be summoned if you completed her questline.
Shabriri can be summoned if you bear the frenzied flame.
Reactivate the Elden Throne grace and prepare to fight the final boss.
When you're ready, enter the Erdtree to kill Radagon of the Golden Order and Elden Beast for Elden Remembrance and 500,000 runes.
steps.linkedRaw: Radagon of the Golden Order; Elden Beast; Elden Remembrance

steps.instruction: After beating the final boss, turn around to activate the Fractured Marika grace.
You'll have a few options to finish the game:
Ending 1: Touch the fractured Marika and select one of the four options:
A: Mend the Elden Ring to achieve the Age of Fracture ending.
B: Use Mending Rune of Perfect Order to achieve the Age of Order ending.
C: Use Mending Rune of the Death-Prince to achieve the Age of the Duskborn ending.
D: Use Mending Rune of the Fell Curse to achieve the Blessing of Despair ending.
Ending 2: Summon Ranni to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.
Ending 3: Touch the fractured Marika while bearing the frenzied flame to achieve the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.
To get all three endings in one playthrough, it's required to make backups of your save file:

Note: Look up how to create backups on your specific platform, as blindly messing with save files can result in losing all your progress. If you don't have Miquella's Needle, you must pick the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending last. Otherwise, it will lock the other endings. This means you'll have to grab the other endings first using backups in between before finishing Hyetta's questline. The following steps assume that you pick the Frenzied Flame ending first and tame it afterward.
Talk to Hyetta at the Frenzied Flame Proscription.
Unequip your armor, then open the charred door to inherit the frenzied flame.
Touch Hyetta with the flame and exhaust her dialogue until she catches fire, dropping the Frenzied Flame Seal and Frenzyflame Stone x5.
steps.linkedRaw: Frenzied Flame Seal; Frenzyflame Stone x5

steps.instruction: Before choosing an ending, quit the game and make a copy of your save file.
With your copied file ready, touch the fractured Marika to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame.
Replace your save file with the copied one, then use Miquella's Needle (Inventory -> Tools) in Dragonlord Placidusax's arena to tame the flame of frenzy.
Make a new copy of the save file, then go with either of the two remaining endings.
Replace your save with the new copy and complete the game with the last ending.
Choose NO when asked to begin the next journey. This lets you finish any remaining content before NG+.
Congratulations, you've completed the game! Now go do the DLC or prepare for NG+.
After selecting an ending, it's safe to finish Hyetta's questline for the Frenzied Flame Seal.
Complete any unfinished steps in the Walkthrough and DLC Walkthrough.
Decide who to give Seluvis's Potion to in NG+.
Decide whether to kill Alexander in NG+ for the Warrior Jar Shard.
Note: You can kill him at any point during his questline, as long as you do it before triggering his duel when talking to him twice in Farum Azula.
Decide whether to assist or challenge Sellen in NG+.
Decide whether to assist or challenge Millicent in NG+.
Decide whether to assist Hornsent or assist Leda against both Hornsent and Ansbach in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to use Thiollier's Concoction on Florissax in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to use an Iris of Grace or Occultation on Queelign in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to use an Iris of Grace or Occultation on Jolan in NG+.SOTE
Decide whether to combine Jolan's Spirit Ash with Anna or keep them separate. Your choice becomes permanent once you start NG+, and you'll need a new Jolan to combine them again.SOTE
Decide whether to keep the Stone-Sheathed Sword or transform it into the Sword of Light or Darkness. Your choice becomes permanent once you start NG+, as you'll simply find a new one.SOTE
Respec if you want to change or optimize your build before Rennala has to be defeated again.
Farm runes to finalize your build or to afford stocking up on items.
Buy anything you want from Patches, then kill him for the Leather Set.
Use the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate your remembrances (old ones cannot be duplicated in NG+).
Exchange your remembrances for any Boss Equipment, or use them for extra runes.
Note: Remembrance items can only be obtained once per playthrough. For example, if you want two Marika's Hammers, you'll need to get the first one now and the second in NG+.
Buy any remaining Boss Armor from Enia before her inventory resets.
Give Miriel all scrolls and prayerbooks, then buy any remaining Spells before his inventory resets.
Buy any remaining Dragon Communion Incantations from the Cathedral (and Grand Altar in the DLC).
Offer your Bell Bearings to the Twin Maiden Husks. Their unlocked items carry over if turned in.
Stock up on items from the Twin Maiden Husks' NPC-specific inventories, as those don't carry over.
Buy any items you need from all other Merchants.
Confirm that you have 14 Flasks of Crimson/Cerulean Tears, upgraded to max level (+12).
If not, collect the required Sacred Tears and Golden Seeds.
Collect items with limited availability each playthrough:
Collect all Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones.
Collect all Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones.
Collect all Great Grave Gloveworts.
Collect all Great Ghost Gloveworts.
Collect all Lost Ashes of War.
Collect all Celestial Dews.
Collect all Larval Tears.
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials. [See playlist]
Over the course of three playthroughs, also complete the following sheets to achieve true 100%:
Complete the Achievements sheet.
Complete the Weapons sheet.
Complete the Armor sheet.
Complete the Ashes sheet.
Complete the Spells sheet.
Complete the Talismans sheet.
Complete the Miscellaneous Items sheet.
Complete the New Game Plus sheet.
Place any map markers you want to carry over into NG+ (105 total).
When you're done preparing, rest at the Table of Lost Grace and begin the next journey. To reset your Walkthrough progress, go to the Settings page and use the NG+ button.

phaseGates.title: Phase gate — Shadow of the Erdtree
phaseGates.message: The base-game walkthrough pauses after Maliketh, the Black Blade. Play the entire Shadow of the Erdtree route before returning to Leyndell, Ashen Capital. The pre-DLC base phase carries 167 missable steps; review them before leaving the Lands Between.
phaseGates.warning: The DLC does not lock the base game, but the endgame capital does. Finish Capital Outskirts, Leyndell, and Forbidden Lands missables before the Ashen Capital return.

phaseGates.title: Phase gate — Leyndell, Ashen Capital
phaseGates.message: The capital changes after Maliketh. Complete missable steps in Capital Outskirts, Leyndell, and Forbidden Lands before entering the endgame. Sections that still have unresolved missables are listed in the gate filter so the Journey page can deep-link straight to them. The base game holds 168 missables in total, including the endgame section.
phaseGates.warning: MISSABLE — Leyndell, Royal Capital is destroyed after Maliketh. Capital Outskirts, Leyndell, and Forbidden Lands pickups, NPC dialogue, and quest states can be lost permanently.

supplemental.action: After defeating Promised Consort Radahn, interact with Miquella's lingering memory in the arena and watch the final memory of Miquella and Radahn.
supplemental.trigger: After activating the Gate of Divinity grace and before leaving the final arena
supplemental.coverageNote: Roundtable tells the player to explore the battlefield for rewards but does not explicitly identify the optional final memory interaction.
supplemental.notes: Non-inventory finale scene that completes the DLC's central narrative. Collect the Circlet of Light and Remembrance as part of the primary guide's boss reward sequence.
supplemental.researchStatus: Validated against Roundtable's Final Stretch and final-boss reward references

supplemental.action: Certify the DLC before returning to the Lands Between: finish the final memory; collect the Let Us Go Together gesture; recover all available Leda-battle rewards; collect Thiollier and Ansbach's corpse rewards when eligible; return to St. Trina for St. Trina's Blossom; complete the Wand area audit; and verify all DLC remembrance, quest, and permanent-inventory results assigned to Journey 1.
supplemental.trigger: After defeating Promised Consort Radahn and before resuming Redmaw in Leyndell, Ashen Capital
supplemental.coverageNote: Roundtable routes the individual finale rewards; the companion consolidates them into a tracked handoff gate before returning to the base game.
supplemental.notes: Companion workflow checkpoint. This does not require obtaining mutually exclusive rewards assigned to later journeys.
supplemental.researchStatus: Companion-system gate validated against Roundtable's Final Stretch

supplemental.action: When entering the Erdtree Sanctuary for Sir Gideon Ofnir's final encounter, do not attack immediately. Remain outside melee range and allow Gideon to complete his entire opening monologue before beginning the fight; after defeating him, allow his final spoken line to finish.
supplemental.trigger: On first entering Gideon's arena in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, before dealing damage
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw routes the Gideon boss encounter but does not explicitly require preserving the full pre-fight monologue before attacking.
supplemental.notes: Damaging Gideon interrupts the opening speech, and defeating him permanently closes the encounter. This row tracks the complete final dialogue performance rather than the boss reward.
supplemental.researchStatus: Validated against Gideon's dialogue and Leyndell, Ashen Capital boss references

supplemental.action: During the Godfrey, First Elden Lord / Hoarah Loux encounter, watch the complete opening and phase-transition cutscenes without skipping. Witness Godfrey's farewell to Morgott, Morgott's body dissolve into grace directed toward the Tarnished, Serosh's restraint end, and Godfrey reclaim the name Hoarah Loux.
supplemental.trigger: When entering the Elden Throne arena and when phase two begins, before defeating Hoarah Loux
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw routes the boss encounter and rewards but does not explicitly require viewing the complete lore cutscenes.
supplemental.notes: These scenes become unavailable in the current journey after the boss is defeated. The phase transition is the explicit reveal of Godfrey's original warrior identity.
supplemental.researchStatus: Validated against Godfrey / Hoarah Loux encounter and dialogue references

supplemental.action: After defeating Hoarah Loux, stop at the Elden Throne before touching the golden light at the Erdtree. Spend or secure loose runes and confirm the final build and presentation: fashion, weapons, talismans, spells or incantations, flask allocation, Wondrous Physick, Great Rune, spirit ash, consumables, and any desired pre-finale screenshots.
supplemental.trigger: After activating the Elden Throne grace, immediately before entering the Erdtree for Radagon and the Elden Beast
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw routes Radagon and the Elden Beast; this companion step creates an explicit final loadout, rune-security, and presentation checkpoint.
supplemental.notes: This does not replace Redmaw's boss instructions. The permanent ending backup occurs later at Fractured Marika, after the final boss sequence.
supplemental.researchStatus: Companion workflow addition validated against Redmaw's Ashen Capital finale sequence

supplemental.action: At Fractured Marika, certify the point of no return: all six ending prerequisites are available, the automatic inventory audit and whole-world completion checks are finished, mutually exclusive rewards are assigned to later journeys, and no remaining Journey 1 free-roam task must occur before the ending sequence.
supplemental.trigger: After defeating the Elden Beast and activating the Fractured Marika grace, before touching Marika or Ranni's summon sign
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw routes the endings and save-copy method; the companion adds the definitive whole-journey certification gate.
supplemental.notes: Do not select an ending until this row is complete. Confirm the Frenzied Flame state and possession of Miquella's Needle before backing up.
supplemental.researchStatus: Companion-system gate validated against Redmaw's Endings and New Game Plus Preparation sections

supplemental.action: Quit cleanly to the title screen, close Elden Ring, and create Backup A — J1 Pre-Endings (Frenzied Flame Active) by copying the Steam save folder from %APPDATA%\EldenRing\<SteamID64> to a separately named archive folder. Verify the copied ER0000.sl2 file exists before relaunching.
supplemental.trigger: Immediately after the point-of-no-return certification and before selecting an ending
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw instructs the player to copy the save; this row standardizes the Steam/Windows backup name and verification step.
supplemental.notes: Keep Steam Cloud from resolving a conflict in the wrong direction. Always close the game before copying or restoring the save.
supplemental.researchStatus: PC-specific workflow corroborated by Redmaw and established Steam save-location references

supplemental.action: With the Frenzied Flame active, touch Fractured Marika and experience the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending. Watch the complete ending and verify the Steam achievement.
supplemental.trigger: From Backup A, before curing the Frenzied Flame
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw includes this achievement ending in its copied-save workflow.
supplemental.notes: This ending must occur before the flame is cured. Do not continue this branch as the permanent Journey 1 save.
supplemental.researchStatus: Ending requirements and achievement classification validated against current ending references

supplemental.action: Close the game, restore Backup A over the active Steam save, relaunch, travel to Dragonlord Placidusax's arena, and use Miquella's Needle to permanently tame the Frenzied Flame. Confirm the Frenzied Flame ending is no longer forced.
supplemental.trigger: After viewing Lord of Frenzied Flame
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw explicitly uses the copied save and Miquella's Needle to reopen the other ending choices.
supplemental.notes: Restoring the entire backed-up save folder is safer than replacing only a file. Preserve Backup A unchanged.
supplemental.researchStatus: Validated against Redmaw's ending reload sequence

supplemental.action: After curing the Frenzied Flame, quit and create Backup A2 — J1 Pre-Endings (Frenzy Cured). This becomes the recovery point for the four Elden Lord variants and Age of Stars.
supplemental.trigger: After using Miquella's Needle and returning to Fractured Marika
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw recommends making a new copied save after taming the flame.
supplemental.notes: Verify the backup before selecting Age of Fracture. Restore this same backup after each of the next four endings.
supplemental.researchStatus: Validated against Redmaw's ending reload sequence

supplemental.action: Experience Age of Fracture by touching Fractured Marika without choosing a Mending Rune. Watch the complete ending and verify the Elden Lord Steam achievement, then restore Backup A2.
supplemental.trigger: From Backup A2
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw covers the standard Elden Lord ending and achievement.
supplemental.notes: This is the first of four Elden Lord variants; only one is required for the achievement, but all four are companion goals.
supplemental.researchStatus: Ending requirements validated against current ending references

supplemental.action: Experience Blessing of Despair by using the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse. Watch the complete ending, then restore Backup A2.
supplemental.trigger: After restoring Backup A2 following Age of Fracture
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw covers the Fell Curse ending when its quest prerequisite is complete.
supplemental.notes: No separate Steam achievement; completion is tracked by this companion row.
supplemental.researchStatus: Ending requirements validated against current ending references

supplemental.action: Experience Age of the Duskborn by using the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince. Watch the complete ending, then restore Backup A2.
supplemental.trigger: After restoring Backup A2 following Blessing of Despair
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw covers the Duskborn ending when Fia's quest prerequisite is complete.
supplemental.notes: No separate Steam achievement; completion is tracked by this companion row.
supplemental.researchStatus: Ending requirements validated against current ending references

supplemental.action: Experience Age of Order by using the Mending Rune of Perfect Order. Watch the complete ending, then restore Backup A2.
supplemental.trigger: After restoring Backup A2 following Age of the Duskborn
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw covers the Perfect Order ending when Goldmask's quest prerequisite is complete.
supplemental.notes: No separate Steam achievement; completion is tracked by this companion row.
supplemental.researchStatus: Ending requirements validated against current ending references

supplemental.action: For the permanent Journey 1 conclusion, summon Ranni and experience Age of Stars. Watch the complete ending, verify the Age of the Stars Steam achievement, choose NO when prompted to begin the next journey, and do not restore Backup A2.
supplemental.trigger: After restoring Backup A2 following Age of Order
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw covers Ranni's ending and instructs the player to decline immediate NG+.
supplemental.notes: Canonical permanent ending for this companion. Postgame free-roam remains available after declining Journey 2.
supplemental.researchStatus: Ending requirements and post-ending continuation validated against current ending references

supplemental.action: Complete Redmaw's New Game Plus Preparation section and the companion's final world audit: finish unfinished NPC states, buy planned merchant and boss inventories, turn in Bell Bearings, spend or duplicate remembrances as planned, collect finite upgrade materials, assign remaining exclusive rewards to future journeys, and confirm every required Journey 1 purchase and audit is closed. Remain in Journey 1 after this checkpoint so the fully prepared world can be preserved as Backup B.
supplemental.trigger: During postgame free-roam after Age of Stars, before creating Backup B or selecting Begin Journey 2
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw supplies the detailed NG+ preparation list; the companion consolidates collection, choice, and backup certification.
supplemental.notes: This is the final mutable-state checkpoint. Backup B must be created only after this certification passes.
supplemental.researchStatus: Finale progression order corrected and certified during v8.0 Phase 1

supplemental.action: After the NG+ Readiness Certification passes, quit cleanly and create Backup B — J1 Complete (Age of Stars) by copying the Steam save folder to a separately named permanent archive. Verify the copied ER0000.sl2 file, preserve this archive as the fully prepared Journey 1 museum save, and optionally capture final build, fashion, equipment, and statistics screenshots.
supplemental.trigger: After CERT-J1-NG-002 and before selecting Begin Journey 2
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw leaves the player in postgame free-roam; this companion-only step preserves the canonical completed world.
supplemental.notes: Backup B contains the completed world after final purchases, remembrance decisions, audits, and future-journey assignments. Never overwrite it.
supplemental.researchStatus: PC save workflow and progression order certified during v8.0 Phase 1

supplemental.action: At the Table of Lost Grace, begin Journey 2. As soon as the new journey loads, quit cleanly and create Backup C — Journey 2 Start. Verify the archive before resuming play.
supplemental.trigger: Immediately after entering Journey 2
supplemental.coverageNote: Redmaw directs the player to begin the next journey; this companion-only step creates the clean NG+ starting archive.
supplemental.notes: Backup C is a rollback point for the untouched beginning of Journey 2. Backup B remains the permanent completed Journey 1 archive.
supplemental.researchStatus: PC-specific journey-transition workflow
